stages.name: deployments
stages.filter:
[ .deployments.items[]?
  | { name: .metadata.name,
      labels: (.metadata.labels // {}),
      wanted: (.spec.replicas // 1),
      status: (.status // {}),
      containers: [ (.spec.template.spec.containers // [])[] | { name: .name, image: .image, env: (.env // []) } ] } ]

restactions.filter:
def rel: (fromdateiso8601? // null) as $t | if $t == null then . else (now - $t) as $dt | (if $dt < 60 then "just now" elif $dt < 3600 then ((($dt/60)|floor|tostring) + "m ago") elif $dt < 86400 then ((($dt/3600)|floor|tostring) + "h ago") elif $dt < 5184000 then ((($dt/86400)|floor|tostring) + "d ago") else .[0:10] end) end;
def clip($n): if ((. // "") | length) > $n then ((.[0:$n]) + "…") else (. // "") end;
def errOf($e): if $e == null then "" else ($e | tostring | clip(120)) end;
def condLabel: if .status == "True" then .type elif .status == "False" then ("Not" + .type) else (.type + "Unknown") end;
def hostOf: if ((. // "") == "") then "" else (sub("^[A-Za-z0-9+.-]+://"; "") | split("/")[0] | split(":")[0]) end;
def pathOf: if ((. // "") == "") then "" else ((sub("^[A-Za-z0-9+.-]+://"; "") | split("/")) as $seg | (if (($seg | length) < 2) then "" else ("/" + ($seg[1:] | join("/"))) end) | rtrimstr("/")) end;
def matchesOf: ((.matches // []) | if length == 0 then [ {} ] else . end);
def pathHit($target): (.path // null) as $p | if $p == null then true else (($p.type // "PathPrefix")) as $t | (($p.value // "/") | rtrimstr("/")) as $v | (if $t == "Exact" then ($v == $target) elif $t == "PathPrefix" then ($v == "" or $target == $v or ($target | startswith($v + "/"))) else (try ($target | test($v)) catch false) end) end;
def pathRank: (.path // null) as $p | if $p == null then 0 else ((($p.value // "/") | rtrimstr("/") | length) + (if (($p.type // "PathPrefix") == "Exact") then 10000 else 0 end)) end;
def hostHit($h): any(((.headers // [])[]); ((.name // "") | ascii_downcase) == "x-kagent-host" and (.value // "") == $h);
def pathCands($rs; $gw; $target): [ $rs[] | select( any((((.spec.parentRefs // []))[]); (.name // "") == $gw) ) | . as $r | ((.spec.rules // [])[]) | . as $rule | ( [ (matchesOf | .[]) | select(pathHit($target)) ] ) as $mm | select(($mm | length) > 0) | { route: $r, rule: $rule, hdrs: ( [ $mm[] | ((.headers // []) | length) ] | min ), rank: ( [ $mm[] | pathRank ] | max ), nm: ($r.metadata.name // "") } ];
def selByHost($rs; $h): if $h == "" then null else ( [ $rs[] | . as $r | ((.spec.rules // [])[]) | . as $rule | select( any((matchesOf | .[]); hostHit($h)) ) | { route: $r, rule: $rule, hdrs: 1, rank: 0, nm: ($r.metadata.name // "") } ] | sort_by(.nm) | first ) end;
def selName($sel): if $sel == null then "" else ($sel.route.metadata.name // "") end;
def selBackends($sel): if $sel == null then "" else ( [ (($sel.rule.backendRefs // [])[]) | ((.kind // "Service") + " " + (.name // "") + (if (.port // null) != null then (":" + ((.port)|tostring)) else "" end)) ] | unique | join(" · ") ) end;
def selArrow($sel): if $sel == null then "" else (selName($sel) + (selBackends($sel) as $b | if $b == "" then "" else (" → " + $b) end)) end;
( .name // "" ) as $rn
| ( .namespace // "default" ) as $rns
| ( .agentError // null ) as $agentErr
| ( .modelsError // null ) as $modelsErr
| ( .serversError // null ) as $serversErr
| ( .peersError // null ) as $peersErr
| ( .routesError // null ) as $routesErr
| ( .deploymentsError // null ) as $depsErr
| ( .policiesError // null ) as $policiesErr
| ( [ (.routes.items // [])[] ] ) as $routes
| ( $routesErr == null ) as $routesReadable
| ( $routesReadable and (($routes | length) == 0) ) as $routesNone
| ( $routesReadable and (($routes | length) > 0) ) as $routesKnown
| ( [ (.policies.items // [])[] | select( (((.spec.traffic // {}).authorization) // null) != null ) | select( ((.spec.traffic.authorization.action) // "Allow") == "Allow" ) ] ) as $allowPols
| ( [ $allowPols[] | ((.spec.traffic.authorization.policy.matchExpressions // [])[]) ] ) as $allowExprs
| ( ($policiesErr == null) and (($allowPols | length) > 0) ) as $authzKnown
| ( $modelsErr == null ) as $modelsReadable
| ( $serversErr == null ) as $serversReadable
| ( $peersErr == null ) as $peersReadable
| ( $depsErr == null ) as $depsReadable
| ( [ (.deployments // [])[] ] ) as $allDeps
# snowplow's userAccessFilter EMPTIES a list the caller may not see rather than erroring, so an
# empty Deployment list is not evidence that nothing runs in this namespace. Same disjunction
# the HTTPRoute reads use ($routesNone), for the same reason and with the same wording.
| ( $depsReadable and (($allDeps | length) == 0) ) as $depsNone
| ( [ (.models.items // [])[] ] ) as $allModels
| ( [ (.servers.items // [])[] ] ) as $allServers
| ( [ (.peers.items // [])[] ] ) as $allAgents
| ( $peersReadable and (($allAgents | length) > 0) ) as $fleetListable
| ( .agent // {} ) as $a
| ( $a.metadata // {} ) as $md
| ( $a.spec // {} ) as $sp
| ( $sp.declarative // null ) as $d
| ( $a.status // {} ) as $st
| ( ($md.name // "") != "" ) as $found
| ( $md.name // $rn ) as $an
| ( $md.namespace // $rns ) as $ans
| ( $md.labels // {} ) as $lb
| ( $md.annotations // {} ) as $ann
| ( [ ($st.conditions // [])[] ] ) as $conds
| ( [ $conds[] | select( ((.type == "Ready" or .type == "Accepted") and .status == "True") | not ) ] ) as $exc
| ( if $d == null then "" else ($d.modelConfig // "default-model-config") end ) as $mcName
| ( ( [ $allModels[] | select((.metadata.name // "") == $mcName and (.metadata.namespace // "") == $ans) ] | first )
    // ( [ $allModels[] | select((.metadata.name // "") == $mcName) ] | first ) ) as $mc
| ( ($mc.spec // {}) ) as $mcs
| ( $mcs.openAI.baseUrl // $mcs.anthropic.baseUrl // $mcs.sapAICore.baseUrl // $mcs.azureOpenAI.azureEndpoint // $mcs.ollama.host // "" ) as $baseUrl
| ( $baseUrl | hostOf ) as $mHost
| ( $baseUrl | pathOf ) as $mPath
| ( if $mPath == "" then "/" else $mPath end ) as $mPathT
| ( $mHost | split(".")[0] ) as $mGw
| ( if $baseUrl == "" then [] else pathCands($routes; $mGw; $mPathT) end ) as $mCands
| ( [ $mCands[] | select(.hdrs == 0) ] | sort_by([ (0 - .rank), .nm ]) | first ) as $mSel
| ( [ $mCands[] | select(.hdrs > 0) ] ) as $mHdrCands
| ( [ $mHdrCands[] | select(.rank > 0) | .nm ] | unique ) as $mHdrNamed
| ( if ($mHdrNamed | length) > 0 then (" · also matched — but only for requests carrying specific headers, which cannot be evaluated from the manifests — by: " + ($mHdrNamed | join(", ")))
    elif ($mHdrCands | length) > 0 then (" · " + ($mHdrCands | length | tostring) + " header-scoped catch-all route(s) on this gateway also match the path, none declared for it")
    else "" end ) as $mHdrNote
| ( $mSel != null and (($mSel.rank // 0) == 0) and $mPathT != "/" ) as $mCatchAll
| ( ($an + "." + $ans) ) as $aHost
| ( selByHost($routes; $aHost) ) as $aSel
| ( ("'" + $aHost + "'") as $q
    | ( [ $allowExprs[] | select(contains($q)) ] ) as $mine
    | { card: ( ( [ $mine[] | select(contains("agent-card")) ] | length ) > 0 ),
        call: ( ( [ $mine[] | select(contains("agent-card") | not) ] | length ) > 0 ) } ) as $allow
| ( # Phrased to compose with EITHER route outcome. "allowed at the gateway" read as a flat
    # contradiction once appended to "cannot be reached through the gateway"; naming the
    # artefact states the half that is fine without denying the half that is not.
    if ($authzKnown | not) then " · the gateway's Allow rules are not readable"
    elif ($allow.card and $allow.call) then " · the gateway's Allow rules name it"
    elif $allow.call then " · but the agent-card GET is not allowed, so A2A discovery is refused before any call"
    elif $allow.card then " · but calls to it are not allowed, only the agent-card GET"
    else " · and the gateway's Allow rules do not name it at all" end ) as $authzNote
| ( $routesKnown and $authzKnown ) as $regKnown
| ( $regKnown and (($aSel == null) or (($allow.card and $allow.call) | not)) ) as $regBroken
| ( if $d == null then [] else ($d.tools // []) end ) as $tools
| ( [ $tools[] | select(.type == "McpServer") | .mcpServer ] ) as $mcps
| ( [ $tools[] | select(.type == "Agent") | { name: (.agent.name // ""), namespace: (.agent.namespace // $ans) } ] | unique ) as $delRefs
| ( [ ( [ $mcps[] | (.name // "") ] | unique )[]
      | . as $sn
      | ( [ $mcps[] | select((.name // "") == $sn) ] ) as $entries
      | ( [ $entries[] | ((.toolNames // [])[]) ] | unique ) as $bound
      | ( [ $entries[] | ((.requireApproval // [])[]) ] | unique ) as $gated
      | ( ( [ $entries[] | (.namespace // "") ] | map(select(. != "")) | first ) // $ans ) as $sns
      | ( ( [ $allServers[] | select((.metadata.name // "") == $sn and (.metadata.namespace // "") == $sns) ] | first )
          // ( [ $allServers[] | select((.metadata.name // "") == $sn) ] | first ) ) as $srv
      | ( $srv.spec // {} ) as $ss
      | ( [ (($srv.status // {}).discoveredTools // [])[] | (.name // "") ] ) as $disc
      | ( [ $bound[] | . as $bn | select( ($disc | index($bn)) == null ) ] ) as $undisc
      | ( ($ss.url // "") | hostOf ) as $sHost
      | ( selByHost($routes; $sHost) ) as $sSel
      | {
          server:   $sn,
          endpoint: ($ss.url // ""),
          transport: ( [ ($ss.protocol // ""), ($ss.timeout // "") ] | map(select(. != "")) | join(" · ") ),
          bound: ( ($bound | length | tostring)
                   + ( if ($serversReadable | not) then " bound · the RemoteMCPServer read failed, catalogue unchecked"
                       elif $srv == null then " bound · server not visible"
                       elif ($disc | length) == 0 then " bound · catalogue not discovered"
                       elif ($undisc | length) == 0 then (" of " + ($disc | length | tostring))
                       else (" bound · " + ($disc | length | tostring) + " discovered · "
                             + ($undisc | length | tostring) + " not in the catalogue") end ) ),
          boundIsException: ( ($serversReadable | not) or $srv == null or ($disc | length) == 0 or ($undisc | length) > 0 ),
          tools: ( $bound | join(" · ") | clip(110) ),
          gated: ( $gated | join(" · ") ),
          route: ( if ($routesReadable | not) or $sHost == "" then ""
                   elif $sSel != null then selName($sSel)
                   elif $routesNone then "no HTTPRoute is visible"
                   else "not routed" end ),
          routeIsException: ( $routesReadable and $sHost != "" and $sSel == null )
        } ] | sort_by(.server) ) as $serverRows
| ( [ $delRefs[]
      | . as $dr
      | ( ( [ $allAgents[] | select((.metadata.name // "") == $dr.name and (.metadata.namespace // "") == $dr.namespace) ] | first )
          // ( [ $allAgents[] | select((.metadata.name // "") == $dr.name) ] | first ) ) as $pa
      | ( ($pa.metadata.namespace // $dr.namespace) ) as $pns
      | ( [ (($pa.status // {}).conditions // [])[] | select( ((.type == "Ready" or .type == "Accepted") and .status == "True") | not ) ] ) as $pexc
      | ( selByHost($routes; ($dr.name + "." + $pns)) ) as $pSel
      | ( $pa == null and $fleetListable ) as $known404
      | {
          name: $dr.name,
          routeNs:   ( if $known404 then "" else $pns end ),
          routeName: ( if $known404 then "" else $dr.name end ),
          role: ( ($pa.spec.description // "") | clip(90) ),
          status: ( if $pa != null then ( [ $pexc[] | condLabel ] | join(" · ") )
                    elif $known404 then "NotFound"
                    else "" end ),
          statusColor: ( if $pa == null then (if $known404 then "red" else "" end)
                         elif ( [ $pexc[] | select(.status == "False") ] | length ) > 0 then "red"
                         elif ( $pexc | length ) > 0 then "orange"
                         else "" end ),
          route: ( if ($routesReadable | not) then ""
                   elif $known404 then ( if $pSel != null then (selName($pSel) + " — orphaned, the target does not exist") else "" end )
                   elif $pSel != null then selName($pSel)
                   elif $routesNone then "no HTTPRoute is visible"
                   else "not routed" end ),
          routeIsException: ( $routesReadable and (if $known404 then ($pSel != null) else ($pSel == null) end) )
        } ] | sort_by(.name) ) as $delegateRows
| ( if $d == null then null else ($d.memory // null) end ) as $mem
| ( if $d == null then null else (($d.context // {}).compaction // null) end ) as $comp
| ( if ($lb["krateo.io/composition-name"] // "") != ""
    then ( ($lb["krateo.io/composition-kind"] // "Composition") + " " + $lb["krateo.io/composition-name"]
           + ( if ($lb["krateo.io/composition-installed-version"] // "") != "" then (" · " + $lb["krateo.io/composition-installed-version"]) else "" end )
           + ( if ($lb["krateo.io/composition-namespace"] // "") != "" then (" · in " + $lb["krateo.io/composition-namespace"]) else "" end ) )
    elif ($ann["meta.helm.sh/release-name"] // "") != ""
    then ("Helm release " + $ann["meta.helm.sh/release-name"])
    else "not owned by a composition or a Helm release" end ) as $owner
| ( ($delRefs | length) > 0 ) as $isOrchestrator
| ( if $d == null then "" else ($d.systemMessage // "") end ) as $sysMsg
| ( if $d == null then null else ($d.systemMessageFrom // null) end ) as $sysFrom
| ( if $d == null then null else ($d.promptTemplate // null) end ) as $tmpl
| ( [ (($tmpl.dataSources // [])[]) | (((.kind // "ConfigMap") + " " + (.name // "")) + (if ((.alias // "") != "") then (" as " + .alias) else "" end)) ] ) as $promptSrcs
| ( [ (($d.a2aConfig // {}).skills // [])[]
      | { name: (.name // ""),
          id: (.id // ""),
          tags: ( [ (.tags // [])[] ] | join(" · ") ),
          # `examples` is deliberately NOT surfaced: a skill's examples are whole prompts a peer
          # agent would send, each far wider than a table cell, and a count of them tells a
          # reader nothing they can act on. They stay in the Manifest card, verbatim.
          description: ( (.description // "") | clip(150) ) } ] ) as $skillRows
# TOOL GATING, STATED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. The Gated column is exception-only and therefore says
# nothing at all for an agent that gates no tool — which leaves a reader unable to tell "this
# agent pauses for nobody" from "we did not look". The gap between the two is the whole point of
# a HITL column, so the absence is named here and given the one piece of context that makes it
# readable: how many OTHER readable agents do gate. Nothing is claimed about WHY this agent
# gates nothing (read-only tools is a plausible reason, not a provable one from manifests).
| ( [ $mcps[] | ((.requireApproval // [])[]) ] | length ) as $gatedCount
| ( [ $allAgents[]
      | select( ((.metadata.name // "") != $an) or ((.metadata.namespace // "") != $ans) )
      | { n: (.metadata.name // ""),
          c: ( [ ((.spec.declarative.tools // [])[]) | select(.type == "McpServer") | ((.mcpServer.requireApproval // [])[]) ] | length ) }
      | select(.c > 0) ] | sort_by(-.c, .n) ) as $peerGaters
| ( if ($serverRows | length) == 0 then ""
    elif $gatedCount > 0 then ( " " + ($gatedCount | tostring) + ( if $gatedCount == 1 then " bound tool requires human approval before it runs." else " bound tools require human approval before they run." end ) )
    elif ($peersReadable | not) then " No binding on this agent sets requireApproval, so nothing it calls pauses for a human; the Agent list read failed, so whether other agents gate theirs is unknown."
    elif ($peerGaters | length) > 0 then ( " No binding on this agent sets requireApproval, so nothing it calls pauses for a human — unlike "
                                           + ( [ $peerGaters[0:4][] | (.n + " (" + (.c | tostring) + ")") ] | join(", ") )
                                           + ( if ($peerGaters | length) > 4 then (" and " + (($peerGaters | length) - 4 | tostring) + " more") else "" end ) + "." )
    else " No binding on this agent sets requireApproval, and no other agent you can read gates a tool either — nothing on this cluster pauses for a human." end ) as $gatingNote
# THE WORKLOAD. Matched by the kagent controller's own label first and by name only as a
# fallback, so an agent whose Deployment is named differently is still found, and a Deployment
# that merely shares the agent's name is not claimed as this agent's without the label agreeing.
| ( ( [ $allDeps[] | select((.labels["kagent"] // "") == $an) ] | first )
    // ( [ $allDeps[] | select((.name // "") == $an) ] | first ) ) as $dep
| ( ($dep.containers // []) | first ) as $ctr
| ( ( [ (($dep.status // {}).readyReplicas // 0), 0 ] | max ) ) as $depReady
| ( ($dep.wanted // 0) ) as $depWanted
| ( [ (if $d == null then [] else (($d.deployment // {}).env // []) end)[] ] ) as $declEnv
| ( reduce (($ctr.env // [])[]) as $e ({}; .[$e.name] = $e) ) as $runEnv
| ( [ $declEnv[]
      | . as $e
      | ( $runEnv[$e.name] // null ) as $r
      | { name: ($e.name // ""),
          # A valueFrom env var is rendered as its SOURCE, never as a value: the value lives in
          # a Secret or ConfigMap this page deliberately does not read.
          declared: ( if (($e.value // "") != "") then $e.value
                      elif ($e.valueFrom != null) then ("from " + (($e.valueFrom | keys | first) // "a reference"))
                      else "" end ),
          running: ( if ($depsReadable | not) then "the Deployment read failed"
                     elif $depsNone then "no Deployment is visible"
                     elif $dep == null then "no Deployment matched"
                     elif $r == null then "absent from the running container"
                     elif (($r.value // "") != "") then $r.value
                     elif ($r.valueFrom != null) then ("from " + (($r.valueFrom | keys | first) // "a reference"))
                     else "" end ),
          # Gold only for a real contradiction between what the CR asks for and what the pod
          # got. An unreadable Deployment is NOT a drift finding and must not be coloured as one.
          drift: ( $depsReadable and $dep != null
                   and ( ($r == null) or ((($r.value // "") != ($e.value // "")) and ($e.valueFrom == null)) ) ) } ]
    | sort_by(.name) ) as $envRows
| ( ( ($ctr.env // []) | length ) - ($declEnv | length) ) as $injectedEnv
| {
    name: $an,
    namespace: $ans,
    found: $found,
    description: ( $sp.description // "" ),
    emptyText: ( if ($rn == "") then "No agent was named in the route."
                 elif ($agentErr != null) then ("The Agent " + $rns + "/" + $rn + " could not be read — " + errOf($agentErr) + ". That is a failed read, not evidence the agent is absent.")
                 else ("No Agent named " + $rn + " is readable in namespace " + $rns + " — it does not exist, or your permissions do not cover it.") end ),
    statusLabel: ( [ $exc[] | condLabel ] | join(" · ") ),
    statusColor: ( if ( [ $exc[] | select(.status == "False") ] | length ) > 0 then "red"
                   elif ( $exc | length ) > 0 then "orange"
                   else "" end ),
    orchestrator: $isOrchestrator,
    orchestratorLabel: ( if $isOrchestrator then ("orchestrator · " + ($delRefs | length | tostring) + " sub-agents") else "" end ),
    identity: {
      kind: ( ($a.kind // "Agent") + " · " + ($a.apiVersion // "kagent.dev/v1alpha2") ),
      namespace: $ans,
      type: ( $sp.type // "Declarative" ),
      runtime: ( if $d != null then ($d.runtime // "python")
                 elif ($sp.byo // null) != null then ("BYO container · " + ($sp.byo.deployment.image // "image not set"))
                 else "" end ),
      stream: ( if $d == null then "" elif ($d.stream // false) then "enabled" else "disabled" end ),
      owner: $owner,
      created: ( ($md.creationTimestamp // "") | if . == "" then "" else (.[0:10] + " " + .[11:16] + " UTC · " + rel) end ),
      conditions: ( [ $conds[] | condLabel ] | join(" · ") ),
      advisories: ( [ $exc[] | select((.message // "") != "") | (.type + " — " + .message) ] | join("  ") ),
      inboundRoute: ( ( if ($routesReadable | not) then ("x-kagent-host: " + $aHost + " — the HTTPRoute read failed (" + errOf($routesErr) + "), so reachability is unknown")
                        elif $aSel != null then (selArrow($aSel) + "  (x-kagent-host: " + $aHost + ")")
                        elif $routesNone then ("no HTTPRoute is visible to you — either this cluster routes nothing through a gateway, or your permissions do not cover HTTPRoutes (x-kagent-host: " + $aHost + ")")
                        else ("no HTTPRoute matches x-kagent-host: " + $aHost + " — this agent cannot be reached through the gateway") end )
                      # The route alone never earned the word "Reachable". This appends the
                      # authorization half in one clause, so the row states both conditions the
                      # gateway applies rather than the one that was easy to resolve.
                      + $authzNote )
    },
    # Consumed by alert.agent-detail-registration, which the page renders ONLY when this is
    # broken (sections.registration). Deliberately NOT rendered for the unknown case: on a
    # cluster where the reader holds no gateway grants every agent would carry the same warning,
    # and an alarm that fires on every page is one nobody reads. The unknown case is already
    # stated, once, in the identity row above.
    registration: {
      broken: $regBroken,
      title: ( if ($aSel == null) and (($allow.card or $allow.call) | not)
                 then "This agent is not registered at the gateway"
               elif $aSel == null then "This agent has no gateway route"
               elif (($allow.card or $allow.call) | not)
                 then "The gateway's Allow rules do not name this agent"
               elif ($allow.call | not) then "The gateway refuses calls to this agent"
               else "The gateway refuses A2A discovery of this agent" end ),
      detail: ( ( if ($aSel == null) and (($allow.card or $allow.call) | not)
                    then ("Nothing on the gateway names x-kagent-host " + $aHost
                          + ": no HTTPRoute matches it and the authorization policy carries no Allow clause for it. Every call is refused, whatever this page's other sections say.")
                  elif $aSel == null
                    then ("The gateway's Allow rules name x-kagent-host " + $aHost
                          + ", but no HTTPRoute matches it, so the gateway has no backend to forward to.")
                  elif (($allow.card or $allow.call) | not)
                    then ("HTTPRoute " + selName($aSel) + " matches x-kagent-host " + $aHost
                          + ", but the gateway's authorization policy carries no Allow clause for it at all — both the anonymous agent-card GET and every authenticated call are refused.")
                  elif ($allow.call | not)
                    then ("HTTPRoute " + selName($aSel) + " matches x-kagent-host " + $aHost
                          + ", but the gateway's authorization policy carries no Allow clause for calls to it — only the anonymous agent-card GET is permitted.")
                  else ("HTTPRoute " + selName($aSel) + " matches x-kagent-host " + $aHost
                        + " and calls are allowed, but there is no Allow clause for its /.well-known/agent-card.json. A2A discovery 403s before the first call, so an orchestrator that delegates here never gets as far as calling.") end )
                + " The Agent's own conditions are unaffected — it stays Ready and Accepted, which is why this is invisible everywhere else."
                + " Registration is rendered by the agentgateway-policies chart from its subAgents list, which the Installer derives from the deployed component fleet; an agent that is not a component is registered by adding it to componentValues.agentgateway-policies.extraSubAgents on the Installer." ) },
    model: {
      configName: $mcName,
      configFound: ( $mc != null ),
      provider: ( $mcs.provider // "" ),
      model: ( $mcs.model // "" ),
      resolved: ( if $mc != null then (($mcs.provider // "unknown provider") + " · " + ($mcs.model // "no model set"))
                  elif ($modelsReadable | not) then ($mcName + " — the ModelConfig read failed (" + errOf($modelsErr) + "), so neither the model nor the egress endpoint can be resolved")
                  else ($mcName + " — no ModelConfig of that name is readable (it does not exist, or your permissions do not cover it), so neither the model nor the egress endpoint can be resolved") end ),
      baseUrl: ( if $mc == null then ("unknown — " + $mcName + " is not readable, so the endpoint this agent's traffic leaves through cannot be determined")
                 elif $baseUrl == "" then "none — the provider SDK's own default endpoint is used"
                 else $baseUrl end ),
      apiKeyPassthrough: ( if $mc == null then "" elif ($mcs.apiKeyPassthrough // false) then "the caller's key is passed through" else "the ModelConfig's own key is used" end ),
      route: ( if $mc == null then ("unknown — the ModelConfig that would set the baseUrl is not readable, so its gateway route cannot be resolved")
               elif $baseUrl == "" then "not applicable — no baseUrl to route"
               elif ($routesReadable | not) then ("the HTTPRoute read failed (" + errOf($routesErr) + "), so the route for baseUrl host " + $mHost + " is unknown")
               elif $mSel != null then (selArrow($mSel) + "  (" + $mGw + " " + $mPathT + ")"
                                         + ( if $mCatchAll then (" · matched by a catch-all prefix, not a route declared for this path" + $mHdrNote) else "" end ))
               elif ($mHdrCands | length) > 0 then ("no HTTPRoute on " + $mGw + " matches " + $mPathT + " without a header condition" + $mHdrNote)
               elif $routesNone then ("no HTTPRoute is visible to you — either " + $mGw + " routes nothing, or your permissions do not cover HTTPRoutes")
               else ("no HTTPRoute on " + $mGw + " matches " + $mPathT + " — the baseUrl does not resolve to a gateway route") end )
    },
    memory: {
      store: ( if $mem == null then "Not configured — this agent keeps no long-term memory"
               else ( "embeddings via ModelConfig " + ($mem.modelConfig // "—")
                      + " · entries kept " + ( if ($mem.ttlDays // 0) > 0 then (($mem.ttlDays)|tostring) else "15" end ) + " days"
                      + ( if ($mem.ttlDays // 0) > 0 then "" else " (default)" end ) ) end ),
      compaction: ( if $comp == null then "Not configured — the full event history is sent every turn"
                    else ( "every " + (($comp.compactionInterval // 5)|tostring) + " invocations"
                           + " · overlap " + (($comp.overlapSize // 2)|tostring)
                           + ( if ($comp.eventRetentionSize // null) != null then (" · retain " + (($comp.eventRetentionSize)|tostring) + " events") else "" end )
                           + ( if ($comp.summarizer.modelConfig // "") != "" then (" · summarised by " + $comp.summarizer.modelConfig) else "" end ) ) end ),
      effective: ( if $comp != null and ( [ $conds[] | select(.type == "UnsupportedFeatures" and .status == "True") ] | length ) > 0
                   then ( [ $conds[] | select(.type == "UnsupportedFeatures" and .status == "True") | (.message // "") ] | first )
                   else "" end )
    },
    serverRows: $serverRows,
    delegateRows: $delegateRows,
    skillRows: $skillRows,
    envRows: $envRows,
    # The agent's standing instructions. systemMessage is a Go text/template when
    # promptTemplate is set, so what the CR carries is NOT the prompt the model finally sees —
    # the include() directives are resolved by the controller against the ConfigMaps named in
    # promptTemplate.dataSources, which this page does not read. Saying "this is the prompt"
    # would be the same mistake as printing a ModelConfig name as if it were a model, so the
    # card prints the template verbatim and names the sources that fill it in.
    prompt: {
      systemMessage: $sysMsg,
      caption: ( if ($sysMsg == "" and $sysFrom == null)
                 then "This agent sets no systemMessage — it runs on the kagent controller's built-in prompts alone."
                 elif ($sysMsg == "" and $sysFrom != null)
                 then ( "The standing instructions are not on the CR: it points at " + ($sysFrom.type // "ConfigMap") + " " + ($sysFrom.name // "") + " (key " + ($sysFrom.key // "") + "), which this page does not read." )
                 elif $tmpl != null
                 then ( "spec.declarative.systemMessage, verbatim. promptTemplate is set, so this is a Go text/template: each include() is replaced by the kagent controller from "
                        + ( if ($promptSrcs | length) > 0 then ($promptSrcs | join(", ")) else "the sources named in promptTemplate.dataSources" end )
                        + ", and the controller appends its own built-in prompts on top. What the model finally reads is longer than what is shown here." )
                 else "spec.declarative.systemMessage, verbatim — the controller appends its own built-in prompts on top." end )
    },
    skillsCaption: ( if ($skillRows | length) > 0
                     then ( "What this agent PUBLISHES about itself over A2A (declarative.a2aConfig.skills) — the description a peer agent, or the orchestrator, matches a task against before delegating to it. The Delegation card above is the other direction." )
                     else "This agent declares no a2aConfig.skills, so a peer that discovers it over A2A learns its name and nothing about what it can do. kagent still serves it; only the self-description is missing." end ),
    deployment: {
      workload: ( if ($depsReadable | not) then ("the Deployment read failed (" + errOf($depsErr) + "), so what is actually running is unknown")
                  elif $depsNone then ("no Deployment at all is visible to you in " + $ans + " — either nothing runs there, or your permissions do not cover Deployments")
                  elif $dep == null then ("no Deployment in " + $ans + " carries the label kagent=" + $an + " or that name — the controller may not have rendered one yet")
                  else ( ($dep.name // "") + " · " + ($depReady | tostring) + "/" + ($depWanted | tostring) + " ready" ) end ),
      # Exception-only, and only ever set when the read SUCCEEDED and found the workload: an
      # unreadable Deployment is not an unhealthy one.
      workloadIsException: ( $depsReadable and $dep != null and ($depReady < $depWanted) ),
      image: ( if ($depsReadable | not) or $dep == null then "" else ($ctr.image // "no container image on the pod template") end ),
      conditions: ( if ($depsReadable | not) or $dep == null then ""
                    else ( [ (($dep.status // {}).conditions // [])[] | condLabel ] | join(" · ") ) end ),
      envCaption: ( ( if ($declEnv | length) == 0
                      then "This agent declares no deployment.env of its own."
                      else ( (($declEnv | length) | tostring) + " variable" + (if ($declEnv | length) == 1 then "" else "s" end) + " set on the CR at declarative.deployment.env, each checked against the container that is actually running." ) end )
                    + ( if ($depsReadable | not) then (" The Deployment read failed (" + errOf($depsErr) + "), so the running column could not be filled.")
                        elif $depsNone then " No Deployment is visible to you here, so the running column could not be filled — either nothing runs in this namespace, or your permissions do not cover Deployments."
                        elif $dep == null then " No Deployment matched this agent, so the running column could not be filled."
                        elif $injectedEnv > 0 then ( " The running container carries " + ($injectedEnv | tostring) + " more that nobody declared here — the kagent controller and the kubelet's service links inject those." )
                        else "" end ) )
    },
    toolsCaption: ( "Bound tools per RemoteMCPServer, checked against each server's discovered catalogue"
                    + ( if ($routesReadable and ($routesNone | not)) then ", with the gateway route the server sits behind." else "." end )
                    + $gatingNote
                    + ( if ($serversReadable | not) then (" The RemoteMCPServer read failed (" + errOf($serversErr) + "), so every ratio here is unchecked.") else "" end )
                    + ( if ($routesReadable | not) then (" The HTTPRoute read failed (" + errOf($routesErr) + "), so Route is blank.")
                        elif $routesNone then " No HTTPRoute is visible to you, so no server here shows a gateway route — either nothing is routed, or your permissions do not cover HTTPRoutes."
                        else "" end ) ),
    delegatesCaption: ( "Sub-agents this agent may hand a task to (tools[].type=Agent)"
                        + ( if ($peersReadable | not) then (". The Agent list read failed (" + errOf($peersErr) + "), so target state is blank.")
                            elif $fleetListable then ", with the state of each target."
                            else ". This agent is visible but the Agent list came back empty, so your permissions do not cover the fleet and target state is blank." end ) ),
    sections: {
      found:     $found,
      # Exception-only, and FIRST on the page when it fires — an agent nothing can call is not a
      # footnote under its model and tool tables.
      registration: ( $found and $regBroken ),
      # The prompt card is rendered for every declarative agent INCLUDING one that sets no
      # systemMessage: "this agent has no standing instructions of its own" is a fact worth
      # stating, and its absence from the page would read as an authoring oversight.
      prompt:    ( $found and $d != null ),
      model:     ( $found and $d != null ),
      tools:     ( ($serverRows | length) > 0 ),
      delegates: ( ($delegateRows | length) > 0 ),
      # Same reasoning as prompt, and the reason this is NOT `($skillRows|length) > 0`: an agent
      # that publishes no skills is the interesting case, not the one to hide.
      skills:    ( $found and $d != null ),
      memory:    ( $found and $d != null ),
      # Unlike the cards above, this one asks about a DIFFERENT object. It is rendered whenever
      # the agent itself resolved, so a failed or empty Deployment read says so in the card
      # rather than silently dropping the section — which would read as "this agent runs no pod".
      deployment: $found
    },
    manifestJson: ( $a | if ($md.name // "") != "" then ((del(.metadata.managedFields, .metadata.annotations["kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration"])) | tojson) else "" end )
  }

restactions.name: agent-formdef

stages.name: namespaces
stages.filter: [ (.namespaces.items // [])[] | .metadata.name ]

restactions.filter:
def commonNames($byNs; $nsList):
  if ($nsList | length) == 0 then []
  else ( [ $nsList[] | (($byNs[.] // []) | unique) ]
         | reduce .[] as $x (null; if . == null then $x else (. - (. - $x)) end) ) // []
  end;
# A step that fails under continueOnError writes its reason to the declared errorKey as an
# ACCUMULATING SLICE — snowplow accumulateErrorKey (internal/resolvers/restactions/api/
# resolve.go:189) always stores []any, one entry per failed item — and each entry is either the
# apiserver Status envelope decoded to a map (response.AsMap, resolve.go:1149) or a bare message
# string. errText flattens all three shapes (slice / map / scalar) into one line, and returns ""
# when the key is absent, i.e. when the step SUCCEEDED. Never use `length > 0` on the payload to
# infer this: an empty list and a swallowed 404 are the same length.
def errText($e):
  if $e == null then ""
  else ( [ ( $e | if type == "array" then .[] else . end )
           | if type == "object" then ((.message // .reason // (. | tojson)))
             elif . == null then ""
             else tostring end ]
         | map(select(. != "")) | unique | join("; ") )
  end;
"v1alpha2" as $ver
# Read state of each list step, bound once and consulted by every description that could
# otherwise present a failed read as an empty cluster.
| (errText(.modelsError))     as $mcErr
| (errText(.serversError))    as $srvErr
| (errText(.agentsError))     as $agErr
| (errText(.namespacesError)) as $nsErr
| (.crd.spec.versions[]? | select(.name == $ver) | .schema.openAPIV3Schema.properties.spec) as $spec
| ($spec.properties.description // { type: "string" }) as $pDesc
| ($spec.properties.declarative.properties.runtime // { type: "string" }) as $pRuntime
| ($spec.properties.declarative.properties.systemMessage // { type: "string" }) as $pSysMsg
# ── namespaces × model configs ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
| ( [ (.namespaces // [])[] ] | unique ) as $nsCreate
| ( reduce ((.models.items // [])[]) as $m ({};
      .[$m.metadata.namespace] = ((.[$m.metadata.namespace] // []) + [$m.metadata.name])) ) as $mcByNs
| ( [ $nsCreate[] | select($mcByNs[.] != null) ] ) as $nsWithMc
| ( commonNames($mcByNs; $nsWithMc) ) as $mcCommon
| ( if ($nsWithMc | length) == 0 then []
    elif ($mcCommon | length) > 0 then $nsWithMc
    else $nsWithMc[0:1] end ) as $nsOpts
| ( if ($nsOpts | length) == 0 then []
    elif ($mcCommon | length) > 0 then ($mcCommon | sort)
    else (($mcByNs[$nsOpts[0]] // []) | unique) end ) as $mcOpts
| ( if ($nsOpts | index("default")) then "default" else ($nsOpts[0] // "") end ) as $nsDefault
| ( if ($mcOpts | index("default-model-config")) then "default-model-config" else ($mcOpts[0] // "") end ) as $mcDefault
# What each offered ModelConfig actually resolves to, folded into the field description.
# NOTE the `. as $m` bindings here and below: `$list | index(.foo)` evaluates its ARGUMENT with
# `.` already re-bound to $list by the pipe, so `.metadata.namespace` would index the array and
# abort the whole filter ("Cannot index array with string"). Bind the item first, always.
| ( [ (.models.items // [])[]
      | . as $m
      | select(($nsOpts | index($m.metadata.namespace)) and ($mcOpts | index($m.metadata.name)))
      | ($m.metadata.name + " → " + ($m.spec.model // "?")) ] | unique | join(" · ") ) as $mcHint
# ── tool catalogue (servers present in EVERY offered namespace) ──────────────────────────────
| ( reduce ((.servers.items // [])[]) as $s ({};
      .[$s.metadata.namespace] = ((.[$s.metadata.namespace] // []) + [$s.metadata.name])) ) as $srvByNs
| ( commonNames($srvByNs; $nsOpts) ) as $srvOpts
| ( [ (.servers.items // [])[]
      | . as $sv
      | select(($nsOpts | index($sv.metadata.namespace)) and ($srvOpts | index($sv.metadata.name)))
      | (($sv.status.discoveredTools // [])[] | .name)
      | ($sv.metadata.name + "/" + .) ] | unique ) as $toolOpts
# ── delegation targets ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Fan-out ORCHESTRATORS are excluded: the orchestrator is what routes work INTO this new agent
# (that is what krateo-autopilot's extraAgents does), so offering it back as a delegate target
# builds a cycle — autopilot → new agent → autopilot.
#
# The test is "delegates to MORE THAN ONE agent", not "delegates at all". On krateo-057 that
# excludes exactly autopilot (10 delegates) and autopilot-bench (3) while keeping
# frontend-agent, which sub-delegates to snowplow-agent alone — a specialist that calls one
# peer is a legitimate delegate target and an "any delegation at all" test wrongly hid it.
# This is a calibrated guard against the obvious cycle, not a hard invariant: a genuine
# specialist that fans out to two peers would also be withheld. If that ever bites, drop the
# filter rather than raising the threshold — the cycle is a judgement call for the author.
| ( [ (.agents.items // [])[]
      | select( ([ (.spec.declarative.tools // [])[] | select(.type == "Agent") ] | length) <= 1 ) ] ) as $delegatable
| ( reduce ($delegatable[]) as $a ({};
      .[$a.metadata.namespace] = ((.[$a.metadata.namespace] // []) + [$a.metadata.name])) ) as $agByNs
| ( commonNames($agByNs; $nsOpts) | sort ) as $agentOpts
# CASCADE. Every enum below is intersected across $nsOpts, so when $nsOpts is empty the tools
# and delegate pickers come back empty for a reason that has nothing to do with the servers or
# agents read. Without this, a failed modelconfigs read would make the Tools field claim "no
# RemoteMCPServer is readable" — an absence nobody observed. $nsBlocked names the real cause and
# every dependent description defers to it before reporting an emptiness of its own.
| ( if ($nsOpts | length) > 0 then ""
    elif $nsErr != "" then ("the namespace list could not be read (" + $nsErr + ")")
    elif $mcErr != "" then ("ModelConfigs could not be read (" + $mcErr + ")")
    else "no namespace you can create Agents in holds a ModelConfig you can read" end ) as $nsBlocked
# Per-user client draft key (localStorage), seeded as __owner but never rendered/validated —
# same mechanism as alert-create. .username is the snowplow-injected JWT principal
# (identityContext: [username] on the Form); absent → "anon".
| (((.username // "anon") | gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9_.-]"; "-")) + "__agent-create") as $draftKey
# $props is an ARRAY, not an object, and that is the whole point — see the header note. gojq
# preserves array order; it does NOT preserve object key order through tojson. The rendered
# order below IS the rendered order on screen (required partition first, then Advanced).
| [
    { k: "__agent_name__",
      v: {
        type: "string",
        title: "Name",
        description: "Name for the new Agent (metadata.name). This is also the Service name the gateway route has to be registered against, so pick it deliberately — renaming later means re-registering."
      } },
    { k: "__agent_namespace__",
      v: ({
        type: "string",
        title: "Namespace",
        description: ("Namespace to create the Agent in. Limited to namespaces you can create Agents in that also hold a readable ModelConfig — kagent resolves the model in the Agent's own namespace."
          + (if $nsErr != "" then (" The namespace list could not be read (" + $nsErr + "), so this picker is empty because that READ FAILED — not because you have no namespaces.")
             elif ($nsOpts | length) == 0 then
               (if $mcErr != "" then (" ModelConfigs could not be read (" + $mcErr + "), so no namespace could be qualified. This picker is empty because a READ FAILED, not because no namespace qualifies.")
                else " No namespace you can create Agents in holds a ModelConfig you can read." end)
             else "" end)),
        enum: $nsOpts
      } + (if $nsDefault == "" then {} else { default: $nsDefault } end)) },
    { k: "description",
      v: ($pDesc + {
        title: "What it is for",
        description: "One line the orchestrator reads when deciding whether to hand work to this agent. Write it as a capability (\"reads ClickHouse traces and correlates them with pod restarts\"), not as a name."
      }) },
    { k: "__model_config__",
      v: ({
        type: "string",
        title: "Model",
        description: ("The kagent ModelConfig backing this agent."
          + (if $mcErr != "" then (" ModelConfigs could not be read (" + $mcErr + ") — this picker is empty because that READ FAILED, not because none exist. Nothing can be created until the read succeeds; do not read the empty list as an absence.")
             elif $nsErr != "" then (" No namespace could be offered because the namespace list could not be read (" + $nsErr + "), so nothing could be qualified here. That is a FAILED READ, not an absence of models.")
             elif $mcHint == "" then " No ModelConfig is readable in a namespace you can create Agents in — this form cannot create a working agent until one exists and you can read it."
             else (" Available: " + $mcHint + ".") end)),
        enum: $mcOpts
      } + (if $mcDefault == "" then {} else { default: $mcDefault } end)) },
    { k: "runtime",
      v: ($pRuntime + { title: "Runtime" }) },
    # The CRD description for systemMessage is about promptTemplate/Go-template machinery this
    # form does not expose, so it would describe behaviour the user cannot reach. Type comes
    # from the CRD; the prose is written for what this form actually does.
    { k: "systemMessage",
      v: ($pSysMsg + {
        title: "System message",
        description: "The agent's standing instructions — its whole behaviour. Say what it may do, what it must refuse, and what it should hand back to the orchestrator."
      }) },
    # Tools BEFORE approvals: the approvals description refers to "the tools above", and the
    # Advanced collapse renders these in exactly this order.
    { k: "__tools__",
      v: {
        type: "array",
        title: "Tools",
        description: ("Tools this agent may call, as <server>/<tool> over the RemoteMCPServers on this cluster."
          + (if $srvErr != "" then (" The RemoteMCPServer list could not be read (" + $srvErr + ") — this list is empty because that READ FAILED, not because there are no tools. Add tools once the read works rather than concluding the cluster has none.")
             elif $nsBlocked != "" then (" Nothing could be offered here because " + $nsBlocked + " — see the Namespace field. This is not a statement about which tools exist.")
             elif ($toolOpts | length) == 0 then " No RemoteMCPServer is readable in the offered namespaces, so this agent would have no tools."
             else (" " + ($toolOpts | length | tostring) + " available.") end)),
        items: { type: "string", enum: $toolOpts }
      } },
    { k: "__approvals__",
      v: {
        type: "array",
        title: "Require human approval (HITL)",
        description: ("The subset of the tools above that must pause for a human to approve or reject before the agent may run them. Anything selected here that is not also selected above is dropped on submit."
          + (if $srvErr != "" then (" The tool list could not be read (" + $srvErr + "), so there is nothing to select here — that is a failed read, not an agent with no tools.")
             elif $nsBlocked != "" then (" Nothing could be offered here because " + $nsBlocked + " — see the Namespace field.")
             else "" end)),
        items: { type: "string", enum: $toolOpts }
      } },
    { k: "__delegates__",
      v: {
        type: "array",
        title: "Delegate to",
        description: ("Existing agents this one may hand work to. Fan-out orchestrators are excluded — delegating back to the agent that routes work here would build a cycle."
          + (if $agErr != "" then (" The Agent list could not be read (" + $agErr + ") — this list is empty because that READ FAILED, not because there are no agents to delegate to.")
             elif $nsBlocked != "" then (" Nothing could be offered here because " + $nsBlocked + " — see the Namespace field. This is not a statement about which agents exist.")
             elif ($agentOpts | length) == 0 then " No other agent is readable in the offered namespaces."
             else "" end)),
        items: { type: "string", enum: $agentOpts }
      } }
  ] as $props
| ["__agent_name__", "__agent_namespace__", "description", "__model_config__", "runtime", "systemMessage"] as $required
# Assembled as TEXT so the properties block never becomes a jq object. Each node still goes
# through tojson, where key order carries no meaning.
| ( "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{"
    + ( [ $props[] | ((.k | tojson) + ":" + (.v | tojson)) ] | join(",") )
    + "},\"required\":" + ($required | tojson) + "}" ) as $schemaString
| {
    schemaString: $schemaString,
    propertiesToHide: [],
    initialValues: { __owner: $draftKey },
    apiVersion: "kagent.dev/v1alpha2",
    kind: "Agent",
    resource: "agents",
    namespace: $nsDefault
  }

restactions.name: agents-gateway

stages.name: pods
stages.filter: [ .pods.items[]? | { metadata: { labels: { "app.kubernetes.io/name": (.metadata.labels["app.kubernetes.io/name"] // "") } }, status: { containerStatuses: [ (.status.containerStatuses // [])[] | { restartCount: (.restartCount // 0) } ] } } ]

restactions.filter:
def errText($e):
  if $e == null then ""
  else ( [ ( $e | if type == "array" then .[] else . end )
           | if type == "object" then ((.message // .reason // (. | tojson)))
             elif . == null then ""
             else tostring end ]
         | map(select(. != "")) | unique | join("; ") )
  end;
def urlHost: (. // "") | sub("^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*://"; "") | split("/")[0] | split(":")[0];
def bt: "`" + . + "`";
def plural($n; $one; $many): if $n == 1 then $one else $many end;

( errText(.agentsError)   ) as $agErr
| ( errText(.modelsError)   ) as $mcErr
| ( errText(.serversError)  ) as $srvErr
| ( errText(.routesError)   ) as $rtErr
| ( errText(.policiesError) ) as $polErr
| ( errText(.podsError)     ) as $podErr

| ( [ (.agents.items // [])[] | select((.metadata.name // "") != "") ] ) as $agents
| ( [ (.servers.items // [])[] | select((.metadata.name // "") != "") ] ) as $servers
| ( [ (.models.items // [])[] | select((.metadata.name // "") != "") ] ) as $models
| ( [ (.policies.items // [])[] ] ) as $policies

| ( [ (.routes.items // [])[] | . as $r
      | { name:     ($r.metadata.name // ""),
          gateways: ( [ ($r.spec.parentRefs // [])[] | select((.kind // "Gateway") == "Gateway") | .name ] | unique ),
          svcs:     ( [ ($r.spec.rules // [])[] | (.backendRefs // [])[] | select((.kind // "Service") == "Service") | .name ] | unique ),
          backends: ( [ ($r.spec.rules // [])[] | (.backendRefs // [])[] | select(.kind == "AgentgatewayBackend") | .name ] | unique ),
          hosts:    ( [ ($r.spec.rules // [])[] | (.matches // [])[] | (.headers // [])[]
                        | select(.name == "x-kagent-host") | .value // empty ] | unique ),
          paths:    ( [ ($r.spec.rules // [])[] | (.matches // [])[] | .path.value // empty ] | unique ) } ] ) as $rx

| ( def short: sub("^agentgateway-policies-"; "");
    [ $policies[] | . as $p | ($p.spec.targetRefs // [])[]
      | { kind: (.kind // ""), name: (.name // ""), pol: (($p.metadata.name // "") | short),
          retry:  ((($p.spec.traffic // {}).retry // null) != null),
          bauth:  (((($p.spec.backend // {}).auth) // null) != null) } ] ) as $ptargets
| ( reduce ($ptargets[] | select(.kind == "Gateway"))   as $t ({}; .[$t.name] += [$t.pol]) ) as $polByGw
| ( reduce ($ptargets[] | select(.kind == "HTTPRoute")) as $t ({}; .[$t.name] += [$t.pol]) ) as $polByRoute
| ( reduce ($ptargets[] | select(.kind == "Service"))   as $t ({}; .[$t.name] += [$t.pol]) ) as $polBySvc
| ( [ $ptargets[] | select(.kind == "HTTPRoute" and .retry) | .name ] | unique ) as $retriedRoutes
| ( [ $ptargets[] | select(.kind == "Service"   and .bauth) | .name ] | unique ) as $passthroughSvcs
| ( [ $policies[] | ((.spec.traffic // {}).authorization.policy.matchExpressions // [])[] ] ) as $authzExprs

| ( [ $agents[] | .metadata.name as $n
      | ((.spec.declarative.tools // [])[] | select(.type == "Agent") | (.agent.name // empty))
      | { target: ., by: $n } ] ) as $delegations
| ( reduce $delegations[] as $d ({}; .[$d.target] += [$d.by]) ) as $calledBy
| ( ( $delegations | map(.target) | unique ) ) as $delegateTargets
| ( [ $agents[] | select( ( [ (.spec.declarative.tools // [])[] | select(.type == "Agent") ] | length ) > 0 )
      | .metadata.name ] ) as $orchestrators
| ( [ $orchestrators[] | select( . as $o | ($delegateTargets | index($o)) == null ) ] ) as $rootOrch
| ( ( [ $agents[] | .metadata.name ]
      + [ $servers[] | (.spec.remote.url // .spec.url // "") | urlHost | split(".")[0] ] ) | unique ) as $planeSvcs

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CAN WE ASSERT ANYTHING ABOUT THE GATEWAY AT ALL? Three states, and only the third licenses a
# claim. The step ERRORED (errorKey set) — we read nothing. The step SUCCEEDED but came back
# EMPTY — snowplow's userAccessFilter refilter is silent (refilter.go drops items, it does not
# error), so "no routes exist" and "you may not list routes" are byte-identical here. Only a
# NON-EMPTY list licenses "this particular thing has no route": every object involved lives in
# one namespace, so a caller who can see one route can see them all, which makes a zero-match
# inside a non-empty set a real absence rather than a permissions artefact.
| ( ($rtErr  == "") and (($rx       | length) > 0) ) as $routesKnown
| ( ($polErr == "") and (($policies | length) > 0) ) as $policiesKnown
| def routesFor($names): [ $rx[] | select( any(.svcs[]; . as $s | ($names | index($s)) != null) ) ];
  def polsOf($rs):
    ( [ $rs[] | ($polByRoute[.name] // []) + ( [ .svcs[] | ($polBySvc[.] // []) ] | flatten ) | unique ] ) as $per
    | ( [ $rs[] | [ .gateways[] | ($polByGw[.] // []) ] | flatten | unique ] ) as $gwper
    | ( $rs | length ) as $m
    | ( [ ( $per | flatten | unique )[] as $p
          | { p: $p, n: ( [ $per[] | select(index($p)) ] | length ) }
          | .p + (if .n < $m then (" (" + (.n | tostring) + " of " + ($m | tostring) + ")") else "" end) ] ) as $own
    | ( [ ( $gwper | flatten | unique )[] as $p
          | { p: $p, n: ( [ $gwper[] | select(index($p)) ] | length ) }
          | .p + (if .n < $m then (" (" + (.n | tostring) + " of " + ($m | tostring) + ")") else "" end) ] ) as $gw
    | ( if $policiesKnown | not then "no policy visible here"
        else ( [ (if ($own | length) > 0 then ($own | join(", ")) else empty end),
                 (if ($gw  | length) > 0 then ("gateway-wide: " + ($gw | join(", "))) else empty end) ]
               | join(" · ") ) end );
  # "no route ON THIS GATEWAY" is a CLAIM about the cluster and is only made when the route list
  # was actually read. Without that guard an unreadable or refiltered-away list renders as seven
  # confident denials — the one failure mode this whole section exists to avoid. The fallback
  # "no route visible here" deliberately claims less: it is equally true of a route that does not
  # exist and of one the caller may not list, which is exactly what cannot be told apart.
  def routeCell($rs; $unit):
    ( if $routesKnown | not then "no route visible here"
      elif ($rs | length) == 0 then "**no route on this gateway**"
      elif ($rs | length) <= 2 then ( [ $rs[] | .name | bt ] | join(", ") )
      else (($rs | length | tostring) + " routes · one per " + $unit) end );

# The A2A front door, derived from the URL SPACE (/api/a2a), never from an object name: the route
# that serves it names the controller Service, and that name is then what identifies the in-mesh
# A2A route. Hardcoding "kagent-controller" or the chart's route prefix would silently mis-label
# every hop the day either is renamed.
  ( [ $rx[] | select( any(.paths[]; startswith("/api/a2a")) ) ] ) as $a2aEdge
| ( ( [ $a2aEdge[] | .svcs[] ] | unique ) ) as $ctrlSvcs
| ( [ $rx[] | select( any(.svcs[]; . as $s | ($ctrlSvcs | index($s)) != null) )
            | select( any(.paths[]; startswith("/api/a2a")) | not ) ] ) as $a2aMesh
| ( routesFor($rootOrch) ) as $orchRoutes
| ( routesFor($delegateTargets) ) as $delRoutes
| ( [ $rx[] | select( (.backends | length) > 0 and any(.paths[]; startswith("/llm")) ) ] ) as $llmRoutes
| ( [ $rx[] | select( (.backends | length) > 0 and any(.paths[]; startswith("/mcp")) ) ] ) as $mcpRoutes

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# FINDING 1 — a delegate the gateway cannot carry, or carries without full policy.
#
# Registration is FOUR artefacts, not one, and the failure that matters most is the partial one:
# an agent with a route, an authz clause and passthrough but no retry budget is reachable, works
# in a demo and drops the delegation on the first 503. That is the live state of the three bench
# delegates on krateo-057 — the policies chart targets its `subAgents` default with
# resiliency-a2a and its per-install `extraSubAgents` only with the other three.
#
# Each of the four is tested by SHAPE, never by policy name: a retry budget is a policy carrying
# traffic.retry that targets the route, token passthrough is a policy carrying backend.auth that
# targets the Service, and the authorization clause is the agent's own `<name>.<ns>` appearing
# quoted inside a CEL matchExpression (quoted, so `k8s-agent` cannot match `k8s-agent-bench`).
# Every one of them is skipped when its source could not be read — a gap that is really a 403 is
# not a gap, and printing it as one sends someone to fix a policy that is already correct.
| ( [ $delegateTargets[] as $t
      | ( [ $rx[] | select( any(.svcs[]; . == $t) ) ] ) as $rs
      | ( [ $rs[] | select( .name as $n | ($retriedRoutes | index($n)) != null ) ] | length ) as $retried
      | ( ($passthroughSvcs | index($t)) != null ) as $pass
      | ( ( [ $authzExprs[] | select(test("'" + $t + "\\.")) ] | length ) > 0 ) as $authz
      | { agent: $t, by: ($calledBy[$t] // []), hasRoute: (($rs | length) > 0),
          gaps: ( [ (if $routesKnown and ($rs | length) == 0 then "no HTTPRoute on the agent gateway" else empty end),
                    (if $routesKnown and $policiesKnown and ($rs | length) > 0 and $retried == 0 then "no retry budget on the A2A hop" else empty end),
                    (if $policiesKnown and ($pass  | not) then "the caller's token is not passed through to it" else empty end),
                    (if $policiesKnown and ($authz | not) then "no authorization clause names it" else empty end) ] ) }
      | select( (.gaps | length) > 0 ) ] ) as $unreachable

# FINDING 2 — configured and ignored. Self-retiring: the moment the runtime implements compaction
# the condition goes away and this line goes with it.
| ( [ $agents[] | select( ((.spec.declarative.context // {}).compaction // null) != null )
      | select( [ (.status.conditions // [])[] | select(.type == "UnsupportedFeatures" and .status == "True") ] | length > 0 )
      | .metadata.name ] | unique ) as $ignoredCompaction

# FINDING 3 — the model a name resolves to. Only names AGENTS ACTUALLY BIND are compared: an
# unused ModelConfig colliding with another is nobody's surprise.
| ( reduce $agents[] as $a ({}; .[($a.spec.declarative.modelConfig // "default-model-config")] += [$a.metadata.name]) ) as $agentsByMc
| ( [ $models[] | select( ($agentsByMc[.metadata.name] // []) | length > 0 ) | .spec.model // "" ]
    | group_by(.) | map(select(length > 1)) | map(.[0]) ) as $collidedModels
| ( [ $collidedModels[] as $mm
      | { model: $mm,
          names: ( [ $models[] | select((.spec.model // "") == $mm)
                     | select( ($agentsByMc[.metadata.name] // []) | length > 0 ) | .metadata.name ] | unique ) } ] ) as $aliases
| ( [ $models[] | select( ($agentsByMc[.metadata.name] // []) | length == 0 )
      | { name: .metadata.name, model: (.spec.model // "") } ] ) as $orphanModels

# FINDING 4 — an agent-plane workload restarting. Scoped by a JOIN, not a hardcoded list: a pod
# counts only when its app.kubernetes.io/name is an Agent or the Service host of a tool server.
| ( [ (.pods // [])[] | . as $p
      | ( ($p.metadata.labels // {})["app.kubernetes.io/name"] // "" ) as $wl
      | select( $wl != "" and ( ($planeSvcs | index($wl)) != null ) )
      | { workload: $wl, restarts: ( [ ($p.status.containerStatuses // [])[] | .restartCount // 0 ] | add // 0 ) } ]
    | group_by(.workload) | map({ workload: .[0].workload, restarts: (map(.restarts) | add) })
    | map(select(.restarts > 0)) | sort_by(-.restarts) ) as $restarting
| ( reduce $agents[] as $a ({};
      reduce ((($a.spec.declarative.tools // [])[] | select(.type == "McpServer") | .mcpServer.name // empty)) as $s
        (.; .[$s] += [$a.metadata.name])) ) as $agentsByServer
| ( reduce $servers[] as $s ({}; .[((($s.spec.remote.url // $s.spec.url // "") | urlHost | split(".")[0]))] = $s.metadata.name) ) as $serverByHost

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# A step that ERRORED is named, so the empty list underneath is never read as an absence.
| ( [ (if $agErr  != "" then "Agents" else empty end),
      (if $mcErr  != "" then "ModelConfigs" else empty end),
      (if $srvErr != "" then "RemoteMCPServers" else empty end),
      (if $rtErr  != "" then "HTTPRoutes" else empty end),
      (if $polErr != "" then "AgentgatewayPolicies" else empty end),
      (if $podErr != "" then "Pods" else empty end) ] ) as $unread
# The silent case: agents ARE readable, so this is a live agent plane, but its gateway objects
# came back empty with no error. That is either a cluster with no agent gateway at all or a
# caller who may not list them, and the two are indistinguishable on the wire — so the whole
# gateway half of this roll-up is off, and saying nothing would present a partial check as a
# complete one. Not raised on an empty cluster (no agents), where there is nothing to say.
| ( [ (if ($agents | length) > 0 and $rtErr  == "" and ($rx       | length) == 0 then "HTTPRoutes" else empty end),
      (if ($agents | length) > 0 and $polErr == "" and ($policies | length) == 0 then "AgentgatewayPolicies" else empty end) ] ) as $gwBlind

| ( [ (if ($unreachable | length) > 0 then
        ( "- **" + (($unreachable | length) | tostring) + " "
          + plural($unreachable | length; "agent is"; "agents are")
          + " delegated to but not fully carried by the gateway.**\n"
          + ( [ $unreachable[] | "    - " + (.agent | bt) + " — called by " + ([ .by[] | bt ] | join(", "))
                + "; " + (.gaps | join("; ")) + "." ] | join("\n") ) ) else empty end),
      (if ($ignoredCompaction | length) > 0 then
        ( "- **Context compaction is configured and silently ignored.** "
          + ([ $ignoredCompaction[] | bt ] | join(", ")) + " "
          + plural($ignoredCompaction | length; "sets"; "set") + " " + ("context.compaction" | bt)
          + " and " + plural($ignoredCompaction | length; "reports"; "report") + " "
          + ("UnsupportedFeatures" | bt)
          + ": the runtime does not implement it, so a long session is never summarised." ) else empty end),
      # The two model observations are ONE bullet when both hold: they are the same fact from two
      # sides (a ModelConfig name no longer identifies a model) and splitting them would inflate
      # the count in the heading, which is the number a reader acts on.
      ( ( if ($orphanModels | length) > 0 then
            ( " " + ([ $orphanModels[] | (.name | bt) + " (" + (.model | bt) + ")" ] | join(", "))
              + " " + plural($orphanModels | length; "is"; "are") + " bound to no agent you can read." )
          else "" end ) as $orphanTail
        | if ($aliases | length) > 0 then
            ( "- **A model name no longer says which model answers.** "
              + ([ $aliases[] | ([ .names[] | bt ] | join(" and ")) + " " + plural(.names | length; "resolves"; "both resolve") + " to " + (.model | bt) ] | join("; "))
              + "." + $orphanTail )
          elif ($orphanModels | length) > 0 then
            ( "- **" + (($orphanModels | length) | tostring) + " ModelConfig "
              + plural($orphanModels | length; "is"; "are") + " bound to no agent you can read.**"
              + $orphanTail )
          else empty end ),
      (if ($restarting | length) > 0 then
        ( "- **" + (($restarting | length) | tostring) + " agent-plane "
          + plural($restarting | length; "workload is"; "workloads are") + " restarting.** "
          + ([ $restarting[] | . as $w
               | ($w.workload | bt) + " · " + ($w.restarts | tostring) + " "
                 + plural($w.restarts; "restart"; "restarts")
                 + ( ($serverByHost[$w.workload] // "") as $sv
                     | if $sv == "" then ""
                       else ( " · serves " + (($agentsByServer[$sv] // []) | unique | length | tostring) + " "
                              + plural((($agentsByServer[$sv] // []) | unique | length); "agent"; "agents") ) end ) ]
             | join(", ")) + "." ) else empty end) ] ) as $findings

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# THE SEVEN HOPS. The bold lead of each line is NARRATIVE — authored here, in one place, never read
# from anything — and the line under it is DERIVED on this request. Keeping the two adjacent is the
# whole point: a hop whose route has gone away prints "no route on this gateway" under the same
# sentence, instead of the sentence quietly continuing to assert a path that no longer exists.
| ( [ { hop: "Portal → the platform gateway",
        why: "The rail posts the question to the gateway's A2A URL space over TLS. This is the only hop that crosses the cluster edge, and the only one where the caller's identity is established rather than carried.",
        rs: $a2aEdge, unit: "listener" },
      { hop: "→ the kagent controller",
        why: "The controller owns the session: it holds the conversation, and the caller's token is forwarded unchanged so every hop below still knows who asked.",
        rs: $a2aMesh, unit: "listener" },
      { hop: "→ an orchestrator agent",
        why: "The orchestrator answers nothing itself. It decides which specialist to ask, in what order, and when it has enough to reply.",
        rs: $orchRoutes, unit: "orchestrator" },
      { hop: "→ the model",
        why: "Every model turn re-crosses the gateway. This is the hop where prompt guardrails run, where the token budget is spent, and where cost is attributed to a user.",
        rs: $llmRoutes, unit: "model backend" },
      { hop: "→ a specialist agent, over A2A",
        why: "The delegate is selected by an exact `x-kagent-host` header, so each one is a route of its own and can be authorized, retried and revoked on its own.",
        rs: $delRoutes, unit: "delegate" },
      { hop: "→ a tool, over MCP",
        why: "The tool call goes through the gateway too. That is what makes an individual tool call attributable in the access log, and what lets a write tool be held for approval.",
        rs: $mcpRoutes, unit: "tool server" } ]
    | to_entries
    | [ .[] | "" + ((.key + 1) | tostring) + ". **" + .value.hop + ".** " + .value.why + "  \n   "
              + routeCell(.value.rs; .value.unit)
              + ( (polsOf(.value.rs)) as $p | if $p == "" then "" else (" — " + $p) end ) ] ) as $hopLines
| ( "7. **→ the kube-apiserver, as the caller.** The tool reaches the apiserver as the person who asked, not as itself: their token is replayed as a client certificate, so their own RBAC decides what the evidence may contain.  \n   not a gateway hop — no route carries it, and no policy on this page governs it" ) as $hop7

| ( [ (if ($unread  | length) > 0
        then ( "- **This check could not read " + ($unread | join(", "))
               + ".** Deviations of that kind are not listed here — silence above is not a clean bill of health." )
        else empty end),
      (if ($gwBlind | length) > 0
        then ( "- **No " + ($gwBlind | join(" and no ")) + " are visible, though agents are.**"
               + " Either this cluster has no agent gateway, or you may not list them; the two look the same from here."
               + " Nothing below is checked against the gateway." )
        else empty end) ] ) as $caveats

| { attention: (
      if ($findings | length) == 0 and ($caveats | length) == 0 then ""
      else ( ($findings + $caveats) | join("\n") ) end ),
    # Rendered by paragraph.agents-attention-head. Carries the count so the Markdown below can be
    # bullets only: one heading, not two. The count is of FINDINGS: a caveat is a statement about
    # this page's own reach, not a thing wrong with the cluster, and counting it as one would
    # send a reader looking for a deviation that was never claimed.
    attentionHead: (
      if ($findings | length) == 0 and ($caveats | length) == 0 then ""
      elif ($findings | length) == 0 then "Some of this page's checks could not run"
      else ( (($findings | length) | tostring) + " "
             + plural($findings | length; "thing deviates"; "things deviate") + " from the intended shape" )
      end ),
    # danger is reserved for the two states that make the page itself unreliable: an agent the
    # gateway cannot carry at all, and a check that could not run. Everything else is warning.
    attentionType: (
      if ($caveats | length) > 0 or ( [ $unreachable[] | select(.hasRoute | not) ] | length ) > 0
      then "danger" else "warning" end ),
    # A failed gateway read must be stated INSIDE the same string as the hops. Split across two
    # widgets it can be scrolled past, and the derived line under each hop would then read as a
    # complete answer when it is a truncated one.
    flow: (
      ( ( if $rtErr != "" and $polErr != ""
          then [ "**Neither the gateway's routes nor its policies could be read, so every line below is narrative only.**\n" ]
          elif $rtErr != ""
          then [ "**The gateway's HTTPRoutes could not be read, so no hop below can name the route it crosses.**\n" ]
          elif $polErr != ""
          then [ "**The gateway's AgentgatewayPolicies could not be read, so no hop below can name what it enforces.**\n" ]
          else [] end )
        + $hopLines + [$hop7] ) | join("\n") ) }

restactions.name: agents-list
restactions.filter:
# snowplow writes a swallowed step error to its errorKey as an ACCUMULATING SLICE
# (accumulateErrorKey, internal/resolvers/restactions/api/resolve.go:189), each entry being the
# apiserver Status decoded to a map or a bare message string. Flatten all three shapes; "" means
# the step SUCCEEDED.
def errText($e):
  if $e == null then ""
  else ( [ ( $e | if type == "array" then .[] else . end )
           | if type == "object" then ((.message // .reason // (. | tojson)))
             elif . == null then ""
             else tostring end ]
         | map(select(. != "")) | unique | join("; ") )
  end;
( errText(.agentsError) )  as $agErr
| ( errText(.modelsError) )  as $mcErr
| ( errText(.serversError) ) as $srvErr
| ( errText(.routesError) )   as $rtErr
| ( errText(.policiesError) ) as $polErr
| ( [ (if $agErr  != "" then ("Agents (" + $agErr + ")") else empty end),
      (if $mcErr  != "" then ("ModelConfigs (" + $mcErr + ")") else empty end),
      (if $srvErr != "" then ("RemoteMCPServers (" + $srvErr + ")") else empty end) ] ) as $failed
# ── gateway registration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The set of x-kagent-host values the gateway actually routes. Header matches are EXACT string
# equality in Gateway API (type defaults to Exact and these rules set no other type), so the
# membership test below is the whole of the routing question — no path semantics are involved.
# Header NAMES are case-insensitive per HTTP, hence the ascii_downcase; values are not.
| ( [ (.routes.items // [])[] | (.spec.rules // [])[] | (.matches // [])[] | (.headers // [])[]
      | select( ((.name // "") | ascii_downcase) == "x-kagent-host" ) | (.value // "") ]
    | unique ) as $routedHosts
# Allow-action authorization policies ONLY. A Require or Deny policy carrying the same host is
# not an allowance, and reading its expressions as one would report a locked-down agent as open.
| ( [ (.policies.items // [])[]
      | select( (((.spec.traffic // {}).authorization) // null) != null )
      | select( ((.spec.traffic.authorization.action) // "Allow") == "Allow" ) ] ) as $allowPols
| ( [ $allowPols[] | ((.spec.traffic.authorization.policy.matchExpressions // [])[]) ] ) as $allowExprs
# READABLE, not merely error-free. An empty list is snowplow's silent userAccessFilter refilter
# (a caller without the grant gets [], never a 403), so with nothing visible we can prove
# nothing and must flag nobody — see the header.
| ( ($rtErr  == "") and (((.routes.items // []) | length) > 0) ) as $routesKnown
| ( ($polErr == "") and (($allowPols | length) > 0) ) as $authzKnown
| ( $routesKnown and $authzKnown ) as $gatewayKnown
| ( [ (if $rtErr != "" then ("the HTTPRoute read failed — " + $rtErr)
       elif ((.routes.items // []) | length) == 0 then "no HTTPRoute is visible to you"
       else empty end),
      (if $polErr != "" then ("the AgentgatewayPolicy read failed — " + $polErr)
       elif ($allowPols | length) == 0 then "no gateway Allow policy is visible to you"
       else empty end) ] | join("; ") ) as $gatewayUnknownWhy
| ( reduce ((.models.items // [])[]) as $m ({}; .[$m.metadata.name] = ($m.spec.model // "")) ) as $modelOf
| ( if $srvErr != "" then null
    else ( [ (.servers.items // [])[] | (.status.discoveredTools // []) | length ] | add // 0 ) end ) as $toolsDiscovered
| ( (.servers.items // []) | length ) as $serverCount
| { rows: [ (.agents.items // [])[]
    | . as $a
    | select( (($a.metadata.name // "") != "") and (($a.metadata.namespace // "") != "") )
    | (.spec.declarative // {}) as $d
    | (($d.tools // [])) as $tools
    | ( $a.metadata.labels // {} ) as $lb
    | ( [ ($a.status.conditions // [])[]
          | select( ((.type == "Ready" or .type == "Accepted") and .status == "True") | not )
          | { label: ( if .status == "True" then .type
                       elif .status == "False" then ("Not" + .type)
                       else (.type + "Unknown") end ),
              bad:   ( .status == "False" ) } ] ) as $exc
    | ( $d.modelConfig // "default-model-config" ) as $mc
    # The gateway addresses an agent by `<name>.<namespace>`, carried in x-kagent-host. This is
    # the join key for both halves of the registration check.
    | ( ($a.metadata.name // "") + "." + ($a.metadata.namespace // "") ) as $host
    | ( ($routedHosts | index($host)) != null ) as $routed
    # The two Allow clauses are told apart by the path they gate, because they fail differently
    # and a reader has to know WHICH one is missing. The agent-card clause carries
    # `request.path.endsWith('/.well-known/agent-card.json')`; the call clause is the bare
    # x-kagent-host match. Missing the call clause leaves only the anonymous card GET, so nothing
    # can actually USE the agent. Missing only the agent-card clause means calls would pass but
    # A2A discovery 403s first — the agent is reachable and never reached, which is precisely
    # how krateo-blueprint-agent failed, so it is reported as its own state rather than folded
    # into "not allowed".
    | ( ("'" + $host + "'") as $q
        | ( [ $allowExprs[] | select(contains($q)) ] ) as $mine
        | { card: ( ( [ $mine[] | select(contains("agent-card")) ] | length ) > 0 ),
            call: ( ( [ $mine[] | select(contains("agent-card") | not) ] | length ) > 0 ) } ) as $allow
    # The cell names the MISSING ARTEFACT, not a verdict, because each one is fixed somewhere
    # else. "no Allow rule" is reserved for an agent the policy does not mention at all;
    # "calls not allowed" is the narrower case where only the agent-card clause survives.
    | ( if ($gatewayKnown | not) then ""
        elif ($routed | not) and (($allow.card or $allow.call) | not) then "not routed · no Allow rule"
        elif ($routed | not) then "not routed"
        elif (($allow.card or $allow.call) | not) then "no Allow rule"
        elif ($allow.call | not) then "calls not allowed"
        elif ($allow.card | not) then "agent card refused"
        else "" end ) as $gw
    | {
        name:        $a.metadata.name,
        namespace:   $a.metadata.namespace,
        routeName:   ( $a.metadata.name // "" ),
        routeNs:     ( $a.metadata.namespace // "default" ),
        role:        ( ($a.spec.description // "") | if (. | length) > 120 then (.[0:120] + "…") else . end ),
        modelConfig: $mc,
        # Three distinct states, never collapsed into one dash: the ModelConfig read FAILED;
        # it succeeded but this agent's config was not among the ones we can read (deleted, or
        # outside the caller's grant); it resolved.
        model:       ( if $mcErr != "" then "not readable"
                       else ( $modelOf[$mc] // "unresolved" ) end ),
        runtime:     ( $d.runtime // "python" ),
        tools:       ( [ $tools[] | select(.type == "McpServer") | .mcpServer as $m | (($m.toolNames // [])[]) | { s: $m.name, t: . } ] | unique | length ),
        servers:     ( [ $tools[] | select(.type == "McpServer") | .mcpServer.name ] | unique | length ),
        delegates:   ( [ $tools[] | select(.type == "Agent") ] | length ),
        approvals:   ( [ $tools[] | select(.type == "McpServer") | .mcpServer as $m | (($m.requireApproval // [])[]) | { s: $m.name, t: . } ] | unique | length ),
        # WHO SHIPPED THIS AGENT. Read from the same label bag as `bench`, because the two
        # answer the same question from opposite ends: an agent rendered by a composition
        # carries krateo.io/composition-name + -installed-version, and an agent that is NOT
        # (the four bench ones) falls back to app.kubernetes.io/managed-by, which the kagent
        # chart sets to "Helm". Without this column the page cannot say which upgrade would
        # change an agent — every row looks hand-made. The version is appended rather than
        # given its own column: name and version are one fact (what to bump), and a second
        # column would be a column of repeated composition versions.
        owner:       ( if ($lb["krateo.io/composition-name"] // "") != ""
                       then ( $lb["krateo.io/composition-name"]
                              + ( if ($lb["krateo.io/composition-installed-version"] // "") != ""
                                  then (" " + $lb["krateo.io/composition-installed-version"]) else "" end ) )
                       else ( $lb["app.kubernetes.io/managed-by"] // "—" ) end ),
        # An agent that binds tools[].type=Agent hands work to other agents rather than doing
        # it itself. That is the one structural distinction on this page the Delegates COUNT
        # does not name — a reader scanning a 15-row table sees "10" and not "this is the
        # thing the portal talks to, everything else is downstream of it".
        orchestrator: ( ( [ $tools[] | select(.type == "Agent") ] | length ) > 0 ),
        bench:       ( ( $lb["krateo.io/composition-id"] ) == null ),
        # Exception-only, and blank in TWO different situations that must not be confused:
        # registered (nothing to say) and unchecked (nothing we may say). The difference is
        # carried by the subtitle, not by this cell — a per-row "unknown" would put the same
        # sentence on every line of the table.
        gateway:      $gw,
        gatewayColor: ( if $gw == "agent card refused" then "orange" elif $gw != "" then "red" else "" end ),
        statusLabel: ( [ $exc[].label ] | join(" · ") ),
        statusColor: ( if ( [ $exc[] | select(.bad) ] | length ) > 0 then "red"
                       elif ( $exc | length ) > 0 then "orange"
                       else "" end )
      } ]
    | sort_by( (if .bench then 1 else 0 end), .name ) }
| ( [ .rows[] | select(.orchestrator) ] | sort_by(-.delegates, .name) ) as $orch
| ( [ .rows[] | select((.gateway // "") != "") ] ) as $unreg
| . + { total: (.rows | length),
        benchCount: ( [ .rows[] | select(.bench) ] | length ),
        orchCount: ( $orch | length ),
        unregisteredCount: ( $unreg | length ),
        # Counted separately from unregisteredCount because they are INDEPENDENT failures and
