        # the header now shows one pill per cause. `subtitleType` alone cannot tell them apart:
        # it is danger when EITHER is non-zero, so a page with both would have reported only the
        # one the expression happened to test first.
        failedCount: ( $failed | length ),
        gatewayKnown: $gatewayKnown,
        toolsDiscovered: $toolsDiscovered,
        # Rendered verbatim by paragraph.agents-subtitle. A failed read is stated FIRST and in
        # full, because the table underneath it is the thing that would otherwise be misread.
        subtitle: (
          ( if ($failed | length) > 0 then
              ( "Some of this page's reads FAILED — " + ($failed | join("; "))
                + ". What is missing from the table below is missing because a read failed, not because it is not there." )
            else
              ( "Every agent you can read on this cluster, the model it resolves to, the tools and tool servers it may call, and who it delegates to — read from the Agent, ModelConfig and RemoteMCPServer resources. "
                + (.rows | length | tostring) + " readable; "
                + ($toolsDiscovered | tostring) + " tools discovered across "
                + ($serverCount | tostring) + " tool servers."
                # The fan-out shape is the first thing worth knowing about a fleet, so it is
                # stated here rather than left to be inferred from the Delegates column. Names
                # the orchestrators explicitly: "one orchestrator" and "three" are different
                # clusters, and so is a cluster where nothing delegates at all.
                + ( if ($orch | length) == 0
                    then " No agent you can read delegates to another — each one works alone."
                    else ( " " + ($orch | length | tostring)
                           + ( if ($orch | length) == 1 then " agent hands work to others: " else " agents hand work to others: " end )
                           + ( [ $orch[] | (.name + " → " + (.delegates | tostring)) ] | join(", ") ) + "." ) end ) )
            end )
          # Appended, never substituted: a gateway finding does not replace a failed read, and a
          # withheld verdict has to be SAID. Silence here would let an unchecked fleet read as a
          # clean one — the whole failure mode this check exists for.
          + ( if ($unreg | length) > 0 then
                ( "  " + ($unreg | length | tostring)
                  + ( if ($unreg | length) == 1 then " of them is Ready but not fully registered at the agent gateway"
                      else " of them are Ready but not fully registered at the agent gateway" end )
                  + " — " + ( [ $unreg[] | .name ] | join(", ") )
                  + ". The Gateway column says what each one is missing; until it is fixed the gateway refuses the traffic." )
              elif ($gatewayKnown | not) then
                ( "  Gateway registration could not be checked (" + $gatewayUnknownWhy
                  + "), so no agent here is shown as unreachable — that is a gap in this page, not a clean bill of health." )
              else "" end ) ),
        # Paragraph.type is a hard CRD enum (secondary|success|warning|danger) — never "".
        # Exception-only: `secondary` is the healthy default, `danger` only on a real failure.
        # An agent the gateway refuses IS a real failure, so it turns the subtitle red on the
        # same footing as a failed read. A merely UNCHECKED registration does not: the sentence
        # it adds is a caveat, and colouring a caveat red would train the reader past the colour.
        subtitleType: ( if ($failed | length) > 0 or ($unreg | length) > 0 then "danger" else "secondary" end ) }

restactions.name: agents-policies
restactions.filter:
( (.policiesError // null) == null ) as $policiesOK
| ( (.routesError // null) == null ) as $routesOK
| ( reduce ((.routes.items // [])[]) as $r ({};
    .[($r.metadata.namespace + "/" + $r.metadata.name)] =
      { paths:   ( [ ($r.spec.rules // [])[] | (.matches // [])[] | .path.value // empty
                     | select(. != "" and . != "/") ] | unique ),
        headers: ( [ ($r.spec.rules // [])[] | (.matches // [])[] | (.headers // [])[]
                     | ((.name // "?") + ": " + (.value // "")) ] | unique ) } ) ) as $routeIdx
| ( { "Seconds": "s", "Minutes": "min", "Hours": "h", "Days": "d" } ) as $U
| ( [ (.policies.items // [])[] | (.spec.targetRefs // [])[] ] ) as $allTargets
| ( [ $allTargets[] | select(.kind == "Gateway")   | .name ] | unique | length ) as $gwCount
| ( [ $allTargets[] | select(.kind == "HTTPRoute") | .name ] | unique | length ) as $rtCount
| ( [ $allTargets[] | select(.kind == "Service")   | .name ] | unique | length ) as $svcCount
| ( [ (.policies.items // [])[] | select((((.spec.targetSelectors // []) | length) > 0)) ] | length ) as $selCount
| { rows: [ (.policies.items // [])[]
    | . as $p
    | ($p.metadata.namespace) as $ns
    | ($p.spec.traffic  // {}) as $t
    | ($p.spec.backend  // {}) as $b
    | ($p.spec.frontend // {}) as $f
    | ($p.spec.targetRefs // []) as $tr
    | ($p.spec.targetSelectors // []) as $tsel
    | ( [ $tr[] | select(.kind == "Gateway")   | .name ] ) as $gw
    | ( [ $tr[] | select(.kind == "HTTPRoute") | .name ] ) as $rt
    | ( [ $tr[] | select(.kind == "Service")   | .name ] ) as $svc
    # Every spec block the object carries, named. This is the fallback summary for anything the
    # branches below do not read, so a block we do not understand is still visible as itself.
    | ( [ (($p.spec.traffic  // {}) | keys[] | "traffic."  + .),
          (($p.spec.backend  // {}) | keys[] | "backend."  + .),
          (($p.spec.frontend // {}) | keys[] | "frontend." + .) ] | unique ) as $blocks
    | ( if   ($b.ai.promptGuard // null) != null                                              then "guardrail"
        elif (($t.jwtAuthentication // null) != null or ($t.authorization // null) != null
              or ($t.apiKeyAuthentication // null) != null or ($t.basicAuthentication // null) != null
              or ($t.extAuth // null) != null)                                                then "identity"
        elif (((($t.rateLimit.local // []) | length) > 0) or ($t.rateLimit.global // null) != null
              or ((($t.rateLimit.conditional // []) | length) > 0) or ($t.buffer // null) != null) then "limits"
        elif ($t.retry // null) != null                                                       then "resiliency"
        elif ($t.cors // null) != null                                                        then "cors"
        elif (($f.accessLog // null) != null or ($f.metrics // null) != null or ($f.tracing // null) != null) then "observability"
        elif ($b.auth // null) != null                                                        then "passthrough"
        else "other" end ) as $role
    | ( [ ($p.status.ancestors // [])[] | (.conditions // [])[]
          | select( ((.type == "Accepted" or .type == "Attached" or .type == "Ready") and .status == "True") | not )
          | { label: ( if   .status == "True"  then .type
                       elif .status == "False" then ("Not" + .type)
                       else (.type + "Unknown") end ),
              bad: (.status == "False") } ] | unique ) as $exc
    | ( if $role == "identity" then
          [ ( if ($t.jwtAuthentication // null) != null then
                ( "JWT " + ($t.jwtAuthentication.mode // "?")
                  + ( ( [ ($t.jwtAuthentication.providers // [])[] | .issuer // empty ] | unique | join(", ") )
                      | if . == "" then "" else (" · issuer " + .) end )
                  + ( ( [ ($t.jwtAuthentication.providers // [])[] | .jwks.remote.cacheDuration // empty ] | unique | join(", ") )
                      | if . == "" then "" else (" · JWKS cache " + .) end ) )
              else empty end ),
            # matchExpressions are CONJUNCTS, not rules: the CRD defines them as "CEL expressions
            # that must all evaluate to true for the rule to match", under a singular `policy`
            # ("The authorization rule"). Rendering the count as "N rules" inverted AND into OR
            # on the one column that answers "who may call what" — and hid the second reading,
            # that a policy whose conjuncts are mutually exclusive matches nothing at all.
            ( if ($t.authorization // null) != null then
                ( ( [ ($t.authorization.policy.matchExpressions // [])[] ] | length ) as $n
                  | ($t.authorization.action // "Allow") + " · " + ($n | tostring)
                    + ( if $n == 1 then " CEL expression" else " CEL expressions, all must match" end ) )
              else empty end ),
            ( if ($t.apiKeyAuthentication // null) != null then
                ("API key " + ($t.apiKeyAuthentication.mode // "?")) else empty end ),
            ( if ($t.basicAuthentication // null) != null then
                ("Basic auth " + ($t.basicAuthentication.mode // "?")) else empty end ),
            ( if ($t.extAuth // null) != null then
                ("external authorization → " + ($t.extAuth.backendRef.name // "?")) else empty end ) ]
        elif $role == "guardrail" then
          ( ($b.ai.promptGuard) as $pg
            | [ ( if (($pg.request // []) | length) > 0 then
                    ( "request: " + ( [ ($pg.request // [])[]
                                        | if   (.regex             // null) != null then (.regex.action // "Mask")
                                          elif (.webhook           // null) != null then "webhook"
                                          elif (.openAIModeration  // null) != null then "OpenAI moderation"
                                          elif (.googleModelArmor  // null) != null then "Model Armor"
                                          elif (.bedrockGuardrails // null) != null then "Bedrock guardrails"
                                          else "unrecognised guard" end ]
                                      | group_by(.) | map( (length | tostring) + " " + .[0] ) | join(", ") ) )
                  else empty end ),
                ( if (($pg.response // []) | length) > 0 then
                    ( "response: " + ( [ ($pg.response // [])[]
                                         | if   (.regex             // null) != null then (.regex.action // "Mask")
                                           elif (.webhook           // null) != null then "webhook"
                                           elif (.googleModelArmor  // null) != null then "Model Armor"
                                           elif (.bedrockGuardrails // null) != null then "Bedrock guardrails"
                                           else "unrecognised guard" end ]
                                       | group_by(.) | map( (length | tostring) + " " + .[0] ) | join(", ") ) )
                  else empty end ),
                ( if ($pg.streaming // "") != "" then ("streaming " + ($pg.streaming | ascii_downcase)) else empty end ) ] )
        elif $role == "limits" then
          [ ( ($t.rateLimit.local // [])[]
              | if (.requests != null) then
                  ( (.requests | tostring) + " req/" + ($U[.unit // ""] // (.unit // ""))
                    + ( if (.burst != null) then (" · burst " + (.burst | tostring)) else "" end ) )
                elif (.tokens != null) then
                  ( ( (.tokens | tostring) as $s | ($s | length) as $L
                      | [ range(0; $L) | . as $i
                          | $s[$i:$i+1] + ( if ((($L - 1 - $i) > 0) and ((($L - 1 - $i) % 3) == 0)) then "," else "" end ) ]
                      | join("") )
                    + " tokens/" + ($U[.unit // ""] // (.unit // "")) )
                else empty end ),
            # rateLimit has three sibling shapes in the CRD. Reading only `.local` filed a
            # global-only policy under "Rate & token limits" with an empty cell — the card
            # asserting we understood a budget we had not read.
            ( if ($t.rateLimit.global // null) != null then
                ( "global limit → " + ($t.rateLimit.global.backendRef.name // "?")
                  + ( if ($t.rateLimit.global.domain // "") != "" then (" · domain " + $t.rateLimit.global.domain) else "" end )
                  + ( (($t.rateLimit.global.descriptors // []) | length) as $d
                      | if $d > 0 then (" · " + ($d | tostring) + (if $d == 1 then " descriptor" else " descriptors" end)) else "" end )
                  + ( if ($t.rateLimit.global.failureMode // "") != "" then (" (" + $t.rateLimit.global.failureMode + ")") else "" end ) )
              else empty end ),
            ( (($t.rateLimit.conditional // []) | length) as $c
              | if $c > 0 then (($c | tostring) + (if $c == 1 then " conditional limit" else " conditional limits" end)) else empty end ),
            ( if ($t.buffer.request.maxBytes // null) != null then
                ( ($t.buffer.request.maxBytes) as $mb
                  | ( if   ($mb % 1048576) == 0 then (($mb / 1048576 | floor | tostring) + " MiB")
                      elif ($mb % 1024)    == 0 then (($mb / 1024    | floor | tostring) + " KiB")
                      else (($mb | tostring) + " B") end )
                  + " request buffer"
                  + ( if ($t.buffer.request.failureMode // "") != "" then (" (" + $t.buffer.request.failureMode + ")") else "" end ) )
              else empty end ),
            ( if ($t.timeouts.request // "") != "" then ($t.timeouts.request + " timeout") else empty end ) ]
        elif $role == "resiliency" then
          [ ( ($t.retry.attempts // 0) as $n
              | ($n | tostring) + ( if $n == 1 then " retry" else " retries" end ) ),
            ( if ($t.retry.backoff // "") != "" then (($t.retry.backoff) + " backoff") else empty end ),
            ( if ((($t.retry.codes // []) | length) > 0) then
                ( "on " + ( [ ($t.retry.codes // [])[] | tostring ] | join("/") ) ) else empty end ),
            ( if ($t.timeouts.request // "") != "" then ($t.timeouts.request + " timeout") else empty end ) ]
        elif $role == "observability" then
          [ ( if ($f.accessLog // null) != null then
                ( "access log → " + ($f.accessLog.otlp.protocol // "OTLP") + " "
                  + ($f.accessLog.otlp.backendRef.name // "?") + ":" + (($f.accessLog.otlp.backendRef.port // 0) | tostring)
                  + " · " + ((($f.accessLog.attributes.add // []) | length) | tostring) + " attributes" )
              else empty end ),
            ( if ($f.metrics // null) != null then
                ( (($f.metrics.attributes.add // []) | length) as $n
                  | "metrics · " + ($n | tostring) + ( if $n == 1 then " attribute" else " attributes" end )
                    + ( ( [ ($f.metrics.attributes.add // [])[] | .name // empty ] | join(", ") )
                        | if . == "" then "" else (" (" + . + ")") end ) )
              else empty end ),
            ( if ($f.tracing // null) != null then
                ( "traces → " + ($f.tracing.protocol // "OTLP") + " "
                  + ($f.tracing.backendRef.name // "?") + ":" + (($f.tracing.backendRef.port // 0) | tostring)
                  + ( if ($f.tracing.randomSampling // "") != "" then (" · " + ($f.tracing.randomSampling | tostring) + "% sampled") else "" end )
                  + " · " + ((($f.tracing.attributes.add // []) | length) | tostring) + " attributes"
                  + ( if ($f.tracing.filter // "") != "" then (" · filter: " + $f.tracing.filter) else "" end ) )
              else empty end ) ]
        elif $role == "passthrough" then
          [ ( "backend auth: " + ( ($b.auth // {}) | keys | join(", ") ) ) ]
        elif $role == "cors" then
          [ ( if ((($t.cors.allowMethods // []) | length) > 0) then ("methods " + (($t.cors.allowMethods // []) | join(", "))) else empty end ),
            ( if ((($t.cors.allowOrigins // []) | length) > 0) then ("origins " + (($t.cors.allowOrigins // []) | join(", "))) else empty end ),
            ( if ((($t.cors.allowHeaders // []) | length) > 0) then ("headers " + (($t.cors.allowHeaders // []) | join(", "))) else empty end ),
            ( "credentials " + ( if ($t.cors.allowCredentials // false) then "allowed" else "denied" end ) ),
            ( if ($t.cors.maxAge // null) != null then ("max-age " + (($t.cors.maxAge) | tostring) + "s") else empty end ) ]
        else [] end ) as $frag
    # The route scope: real paths first; when every targeted route matches "/" (or the routes
    # step was denied) fall back to the single distinct header match, and otherwise say nothing.
    | ( [ $rt[] | ($routeIdx[$ns + "/" + .] // {}) | (.paths // [])[] ] | unique ) as $paths
    | ( [ $rt[] | ($routeIdx[$ns + "/" + .] // {}) | (.headers // [])[] ] | unique ) as $hdrs
    | ( if   ($paths | length) > 0 then (" · " + ($paths | join(", ")))
        elif ($hdrs  | length) == 1 then (" · " + $hdrs[0])
        else "" end ) as $scope
    | ( if ($gw | length) > 0 then
          ( ( if ($gw | length) == 1 then "Gateway " else "Gateways " end ) + ($gw | join(", ")) )
        elif ($rt | length) > 0 then
          ( ( if ($rt | length) == 1
              then ("Route " + ($rt[0] | ltrimstr("agentgateway-policies-")))
              else (($rt | length | tostring) + " routes") end ) + $scope )
        elif ($svc | length) > 0 then
          ( ($svc | length | tostring) + ( if ($svc | length) == 1 then " service" else " services" end ) )
        else "" end ) as $byRef
    # targetSelectors is the CRD's OTHER attachment mechanism, and the one it recommends for
    # exactly the fan-out this chart has ("Prefer targetRefs when reconciliation latency is
    # important, especially when many policies target the same resource"). Reading only
    # targetRefs rendered a selector-attached policy as attached to nothing.
    | ( [ $tsel[] | ((.kind // "?") + "s labelled "
                     + (((.matchLabels // {}) | to_entries | map(.key + "=" + .value) | join(","))))
          + ( if (.sectionName // "") != "" then (" · section " + .sectionName) else "" end ) ] | unique ) as $bySel
    | {
        name:    ($p.metadata.name | ltrimstr("agentgateway-policies-")),
        namespace: $ns,
        role:    $role,
        attaches: ( ( [ $byRef, ($bySel | join(" · ")) ] | map(select(. != "")) | join(" · ") )
                    | if . == "" then "not attached" else . end ),
        enforces: ( if   ($frag   | length) > 0 then ($frag | join(" · "))
                    elif ($blocks | length) > 0 then ("carries " + ($blocks | join(", ")))
                    else "no traffic, backend or frontend block" end ),
        statusLabel: ( [ $exc[].label ] | unique | join(" · ") ),
        statusColor: ( if   ( [ $exc[] | select(.bad) ] | length ) > 0 then "red"
                       elif ( $exc | length ) > 0 then "orange"
                       else "" end )
      } ]
    | sort_by(.name) }
| . + { total:        (.rows | length),
        byRole:       ( reduce (.rows[]) as $r ({}; .[$r.role] = ((.[$r.role] // 0) + 1)) ),
        gatewayCount: $gwCount,
        routeCount:   $rtCount,
        serviceCount: $svcCount,
        selectorCount: $selCount,
        policiesReadable: $policiesOK,
        routesReadable:   $routesOK }
| . + { roleCount: (.byRole | keys | length) }

restactions.name: agents-policy-formdef
restactions.filter:
# A step that fails under continueOnError writes its reason to the errorKey as an ACCUMULATING
# SLICE (snowplow accumulateErrorKey always stores []any), each entry either the apiserver Status
# envelope decoded to a map or a bare string. errText flattens all three shapes and returns ""
# when the step SUCCEEDED. Never infer this from `length > 0` on the payload: an empty list and
# a swallowed 403 are the same length.
def errText($e):
  if $e == null then ""
  else ( [ ( $e | if type == "array" then .[] else . end )
           | if type == "object" then ((.message // .reason // (. | tojson)))
             elif . == null then ""
             else tostring end ]
         | map(select(. != "")) | unique | join("; ") )
  end;
(errText(.namespacesError)) as $nsErr
| (errText(.gatewaysError))  as $gwErr
| (errText(.routesError))    as $rtErr
| (errText(.servicesError))  as $svcErr
| ( [ .crd.spec.versions[]? | select(.served) | .name ] ) as $served
| ( if ($served | index("v1alpha1")) then "v1alpha1" else ($served[0] // "v1alpha1") end ) as $ver
| ( [ (.namespaces // [])[] ] | unique | sort ) as $nsOpts
| ( if ($nsOpts | index("default")) then "default" else ($nsOpts[0] // "") end ) as $nsDefault
# ── the target enum ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# "<Kind>/<namespace>/<name>" so the Form can rebuild a targetRef that cannot be mismatched.
| ( [ (.gateways.items // [])[] | "Gateway/" + .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name ] | sort ) as $gwOpts
| ( [ (.routes.items // [])[]   | "HTTPRoute/" + .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name ] | sort ) as $rtOpts
| ( [ (.services.items // [])[] | "Service/" + .metadata.namespace + "/" + .metadata.name ] | sort ) as $svcOpts
| ( $gwOpts + $rtOpts + $svcOpts ) as $targetOpts
| ( [ (if $gwErr != "" then "Gateways could not be read (" + $gwErr + ")" else empty end),
      (if $rtErr != "" then "HTTPRoutes could not be read (" + $rtErr + ")" else empty end),
      (if $svcErr != "" then "Services could not be read (" + $svcErr + ")" else empty end) ]
    | join("; ") ) as $targetErr
# ── the role -> spec-block map, stated once and rendered into the two descriptions ───────────
# Every one of the seven is grounded in a block some live policy actually uses on this cluster:
# traffic.authorization x10, traffic.jwtAuthentication x7, traffic.retry x5, backend.auth x4,
# traffic.timeouts x4, traffic.rateLimit x3, traffic.buffer x3, backend.ai x1, traffic.cors x1,
# frontend.accessLog/metrics/tracing x1 each.
| (errText(.policiesError)) as $polErr
# Which sub-keys each role owns, and therefore which live block is an example OF that role.
# The lists are the blocks actually in use here (traffic.authorization x10, jwtAuthentication x7,
# retry x5, backend.auth x4, timeouts x4, rateLimit x3, buffer x3, backend.ai x1, cors x1,
# frontend accessLog/metrics/tracing x1 each), so every role can be exemplified.
| { identity:      { top: "traffic",  keys: ["jwtAuthentication","authorization"] },
    guardrail:     { top: "backend",  keys: ["ai"] },
    limits:        { top: "traffic",  keys: ["rateLimit","buffer"] },
    resiliency:    { top: "traffic",  keys: ["retry"] },
    observability: { top: "frontend", keys: ["accessLog","metrics","tracing"] },
    passthrough:   { top: "backend",  keys: ["auth"] },
    cors:          { top: "traffic",  keys: ["cors"] } } as $roleKeys
| ( [ (.policies.items // [])[] ] ) as $live
# For a role: the smallest live block that contains one of its keys, projected down to just the
# keys that role owns. Smallest so the example is readable; projected so a policy that carries
# two roles' blocks does not teach the wrong one. tojson is safe here (this is an EXAMPLE string,
# key order carries no meaning) -- unlike the schema itself, which must stay an ordered array.
# $roleOrder, NOT `$roleKeys | keys_unsorted`. snowplow runs a gojq fork that does not implement
# keys_unsorted at all — the query fails to COMPILE ("function not defined: keys_unsorted/0"),
# which takes the whole form down to a skeleton with no error on screen. Local jq (jqlang)
# HAS it, so this passed at a shell and failed on the engine that runs it — the same trap
# restaction.agent-formdef's header documents for object key ORDER. An explicit list is better
# anyway: it fixes the order rather than depending on one, and matches the Role enum.
| ["identity","guardrail","limits","resiliency","observability","passthrough","cors"] as $roleOrder
| ( reduce ($roleOrder[]) as $r ({};
      . as $acc
      | ( $roleKeys[$r] ) as $rk
      | ( [ $live[]
            | ( .spec[$rk.top] // {} ) as $blk
            | ( $blk | with_entries(select(.key as $k | $rk.keys | index($k))) ) as $proj
            | select(($proj | length) > 0)
            | ($proj | tojson) ]
          | sort_by(length) ) as $cands
      | $acc + { ($r): ($cands[0] // "") } ) ) as $examples
# A LENGTH CAP, and an offered-or-not decision rather than a truncation. The live guardrail block
# is one policy carrying every secret-masking regex on the cluster — well over a thousand
# characters. Cutting a JSON object mid-string yields something that looks copy-pasteable and is
# not, which is worse than saying nothing, so an over-long example is WITHHELD and named as
# withheld. The policies page renders the full live values for the roles skipped here.
| 200 as $exampleCap
| ( [ $roleOrder[] as $r
      | select($examples[$r] != "") | select(($examples[$r] | length) <= $exampleCap)
      | ($r + " " + $examples[$r]) ] | join("  ") ) as $exampleText
| ( [ $roleOrder[] as $r
      | select($examples[$r] != "") | select(($examples[$r] | length) > $exampleCap)
      | $r ] ) as $tooLong
| ( $examples["limits"] // "{}" ) as $blockDefault
| [ "identity  -> spec.traffic (jwtAuthentication, authorization)",
    "guardrail -> spec.backend.ai (promptGuard, Model Armor, moderation)",
    "limits    -> spec.traffic (rateLimit, buffer, timeouts)",
    "resiliency-> spec.traffic (retry, timeouts)",
    "observability -> spec.frontend (accessLog, metrics, tracing)",
    "passthrough   -> spec.backend (auth)",
    "cors      -> spec.traffic (cors)" ] as $roleMap
| [
    { k: "__policy_name__",
      v: { type: "string", title: "Name",
           description: "metadata.name. Must not collide with a policy the agentgateway-policies composition already renders — those are reconciled and a name clash is a permanent conflict, not a one-off 409.",
           minLength: 1 } },
    { k: "__policy_namespace__",
      v: { type: "string", title: "Namespace",
           description: ("Where the policy object is created. Only namespaces you may CREATE an AgentgatewayPolicy in are offered."
             + (if $nsErr != "" then (" The namespace list could not be read (" + $nsErr + ") — this select is empty because that READ FAILED, not because you have no namespaces.")
                elif ($nsOpts | length) == 0 then " No namespace grants you create on agentgatewaypolicies.agentgateway.dev, so this policy cannot be created anywhere from here."
                else "" end)),
           enum: $nsOpts, default: $nsDefault } },
    { k: "__role__",
      v: { type: "string", title: "Role",
           description: ("Picks WHICH spec block the JSON below is written into — the policy kind is one CRD with many optional blocks, and the role is how the fleet names them. " + ($roleMap | join(" · ")) + "."),
           enum: ["identity","guardrail","limits","resiliency","observability","passthrough","cors"],
           default: "limits" } },
    { k: "__target__",
      v: { type: "string", title: "Attached to",
           description: ("The object this policy binds to, as Kind/namespace/name — one field so the kind and the name cannot disagree. Gateways and HTTPRoutes are listed cluster-wide; Services are listed for default only, which is where every live Service target sits."
             + (if $targetErr != "" then (" " + $targetErr + " — this list is short because a READ FAILED, not because those objects do not exist.")
                elif ($targetOpts | length) == 0 then " Nothing readable to attach to. That is a permissions answer, not a cluster with no gateways."
                else "" end)),
           enum: $targetOpts } },
    { k: "__block__",
      v: { type: "string", title: "Policy body (JSON)",
           description: ("The block's contents as a JSON object, written under the key your Role selects. Authored as JSON because the CRD's spec schema is ~298 KB across 37 optional blocks and the form renderer has no conditional branches: a control per field would render all 37 blocks at once, 36 of them irrelevant to the role you picked. The apiserver STRICT-decodes this kind — an unknown or misspelled field is a BadRequest on submit, never a silently ignored one — so start from a block that is already accepted here rather than from memory."
             + (if $polErr != "" then (" The live policies could not be read (" + $polErr + "), so no worked example could be offered — that is a failed read, not a cluster with no policies to copy from.")
                elif $exampleText != "" then ("  Currently accepted on this cluster, one per role: " + $exampleText
                  + (if ($tooLong | length) > 0 then ("  No example is shown for " + ($tooLong | join(", ")) + ": the live block is longer than " + ($exampleCap | tostring) + " characters and a clipped JSON object is not copy-pasteable. The policies page shows it in full.") else "" end))
                elif ($live | length) == 0 then "  No policy is readable here, so there is no worked example to copy."
                else "" end)),
           minLength: 2, default: $blockDefault } }
  ] as $props
| ["__policy_name__", "__policy_namespace__", "__role__", "__target__", "__block__"] as $required
# Assembled as TEXT so the properties block never becomes a jq object — see the header.
| ( "{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{"
    + ( [ $props[] | ((.k | tojson) + ":" + (.v | tojson)) ] | join(",") )
    + "},\"required\":" + ($required | tojson) + "}" ) as $schemaString
| {
    schemaString: $schemaString,
    propertiesToHide: [],
    initialValues: {},
    apiVersion: ("agentgateway.dev/" + $ver),
    kind: "AgentgatewayPolicy",
    resource: "agentgatewaypolicies",
    namespace: $nsDefault
  }

restactions.name: agents-servers
restactions.filter:
( [ { k: "servers",  what: "Tool servers (remotemcpservers.kagent.dev)",             e: .serversError  },
    { k: "agents",   what: "Agents (agents.kagent.dev)",                             e: .agentsError   },
    { k: "backends", what: "Gateway backends (agentgatewaybackends.agentgateway.dev)", e: .backendsError },
    { k: "routes",   what: "HTTPRoutes (gateway.networking.k8s.io)",                 e: .routesError   } ]
  | map( ( if (.e | type) == "array" then (.e[0] // null) else .e end ) as $v
         | . + { failed: (.e != null),
                 why: ( if ($v | type) != "object" then "could not be read"
                        elif (($v.reason // "") == "NotFound") or (($v.code // 0) == 404) then "are not installed on this cluster"
                        elif (($v.reason // "") == "Forbidden") or (($v.code // 0) == 403) then "could not be read (permission denied)"
                        else ( "could not be read (" + ( ($v.reason // "") | if . == "" then (($v.code // 0) | tostring) else . end ) + ")" ) end ) } )
  | reduce .[] as $x ({}; .[$x.k] = $x) ) as $err
| ( $err.servers.failed ) as $serversDenied
| ( $err.agents.failed ) as $agentsDenied
| ( ($err.backends.failed) or ($err.routes.failed) ) as $gwDenied
| ( [ ((.servers.items // [])[].metadata.namespace),
      ((.agents.items // [])[].metadata.namespace),
      ((.backends.items // [])[].metadata.namespace),
      ((.routes.items // [])[].metadata.namespace) ] | map(select(. != null)) | unique ) as $knownNs
| ( [ (.routes.items // [])[] | .metadata.namespace as $rns | (.spec.rules // [])[] | (.backendRefs // [])[]
      | select((.kind // "") == "AgentgatewayBackend") | ($rns + "/" + .name) ] | unique ) as $routed
| ( [ (.backends.items // [])[] | select(.spec.mcp != null)
      | .metadata.namespace as $bns
      | select( ($bns + "/" + .metadata.name) as $k | $routed | any(. == $k) )
      | (.spec.mcp.targets // [])[] | { t: ., bns: $bns } ] ) as $mcpTargets
| ( [ $mcpTargets[] | .bns as $bns | .t as $t
      | ( if (($t.static.backendRef.name) // "") != "" then ($bns + "/" + $t.static.backendRef.name)
          elif (($t.static.host) // "") != "" then
            ( ($t.static.host | split(":") | .[0] | split(".")) as $hp
              | ( if ($hp | length) > 1 and ($hp[1] != "svc") then $hp[1] else $bns end ) + "/" + $hp[0] )
          else empty end ) ] | unique ) as $exposed
| ( [ $mcpTargets[] | select( ((.t.static.backendRef.name // "") == "") and ((.t.static.host // "") == "") ) ] | length > 0 ) as $gwOpaque
| ( ( [ (.backends.items // [])[] | select(.spec.mcp != null) ] | length ) > 0 ) as $gwSeen
| ( ($gwDenied | not) and $gwSeen and ($gwOpaque | not) ) as $gwKnown
| ( reduce ((.servers.items // [])[]) as $s ({};
      .[$s.metadata.namespace + "/" + $s.metadata.name] = [ ($s.status.discoveredTools // [])[] | .name ]) ) as $discovered
| ( [ (.agents.items // [])[]
      | .metadata.name as $an | .metadata.namespace as $ans
      | ( (.spec.declarative.tools // [])
          | map(select((.type == "McpServer") and ((.mcpServer.name // "") != ""))) ) as $ts
      | ( [ $ts[] | { ns:   (.mcpServer.namespace // $ans),
                      n:    .mcpServer.name,
                      kind: (.mcpServer.kind // "RemoteMCPServer"),
                      grp:  (.mcpServer.apiGroup // "kagent.dev") } ] | unique )[] as $ref
      | ( [ $ts[] | select( ((.mcpServer.namespace // $ans) == $ref.ns)
                            and (.mcpServer.name == $ref.n)
                            and ((.mcpServer.kind // "RemoteMCPServer") == $ref.kind)
                            and ((.mcpServer.apiGroup // "kagent.dev") == $ref.grp) ) ] ) as $refs
      | ( ($ref.kind == "RemoteMCPServer") and ($ref.grp == "kagent.dev") ) as $isRemote
      | ( [ $refs[] | (.mcpServer.toolNames // [])[] ] | unique ) as $bound
      | ( [ $refs[] | (.mcpServer.requireApproval // [])[] ] | unique ) as $appr
      | ( if $isRemote then ($discovered[$ref.ns + "/" + $ref.n]) else null end ) as $disc
      | { agent: $an, ans: $ans, name: $ref.n, ns: $ref.ns, kind: $ref.kind, isRemote: $isRemote,
          key: ( if $isRemote then ($ref.ns + "/" + $ref.n) else "" end ),
          bound: $bound, approvals: $appr,
          served: ( if ($isRemote | not) or $disc == null or ($disc | length) == 0 then null
                    else [ $bound[] | select( . as $t | $disc | any(. == $t) ) ] end ) } ] ) as $bindings
| ( ( [ ((.agents.items // [])[].metadata.namespace),
        ((.servers.items // [])[].metadata.namespace),
        ($bindings[].ns) ] | map(select(. != null)) | unique | length ) > 1 ) as $multiNs
| ( [ (.servers.items // [])[]
      | . as $s
      | ( .metadata.namespace ) as $ns
      | ( .spec.url // "" ) as $url
      | ( $url | split("://") | (if length > 1 then .[1] else .[0] end) | split("/") | .[0] | split(":") | .[0] ) as $host
      | ( $host | split(".") ) as $hp
      | ( $hp[0] // "" ) as $svc
      | ( if ($hp | length) > 1 and ($hp[1] != "svc") then $hp[1] else $ns end ) as $hns
      | ( ($hp | length) == 1
          or ($host | endswith(".svc"))
          or ($host | endswith(".svc.cluster.local"))
          or ($host | endswith(".cluster.local"))
          or ( ($hp | length) == 2 and ($knownNs | any(. == $hp[1])) ) ) as $inCluster
      | ( ($inCluster | not)
          and ( (($hp | length) == 2) or ( [ ($hp | last) | tonumber? ] | length > 0 ) ) ) as $hostUnsure
      | ( [ $bindings[] | select(.isRemote and (.key == ($ns + "/" + $s.metadata.name))) ] ) as $cons
      | ( [ ($s.status.conditions // [])[]
            | select( ((.type == "Ready" or .type == "Accepted") and .status == "True") | not )
            | { label: ( if .status == "True" then .type
                         elif .status == "False" then ("Not" + .type)
                         else (.type + "Unknown") end ),
                bad: (.status == "False") } ] ) as $exc
      | ( if $url == "" then null
          elif $hostUnsure then null
          elif ($inCluster | not) then "external endpoint"
          elif ($gwKnown | not) then null
          elif ( ($hns + "/" + $svc) as $x | $exposed | any(. == $x) ) then null
          else "no gateway route" end ) as $gw
      | { name:       ( if $multiNs then ($ns + "/" + $s.metadata.name) else $s.metadata.name end ),
          endpoint:   ( if $url == "" then "—" else $url end ),
          protocol:   ( ($s.spec.protocol // "") | if . == "" then "—" else . end ),
          timeout:    ( ($s.spec.timeout // "") | if . == "" then "—" else . end ),
          discovered: ( ($s.status.discoveredTools // []) | length | tostring ),
          inUse:      ( if $agentsDenied then "not readable"
                        else ( [ $cons[] | (.served // [])[] ] | unique | length | tostring ) end ),
          agents:     ( if $agentsDenied then "not readable"
                        else ( ( [ $cons[] | (if $multiNs then (.ans + "/" + .agent) else .agent end) ] | unique ) as $names
                               | if ($names | length) == 0 then "—"
                                 elif ($names | length) <= 2 then ($names | join(" · "))
                                 else (($names | length | tostring) + " agents") end ) end ),
          statusLabel: ( [ ($exc[].label), ($gw // empty) ] | join(" · ") ),
          statusColor: ( if ( [ $exc[] | select(.bad) ] | length ) > 0 then "red" else "orange" end ) } ]
    | sort_by(.name) ) as $serverRows
| ( [ $bindings[]
      | { server: ( ( if $multiNs then (.ns + "/" + .name) else .name end )
                    + ( if .isRemote then "" else (" (" + .kind + ")") end ) ),
          agent:  ( if $multiNs then (.ans + "/" + .agent) else .agent end ),
          bound:  ( if (.bound | length) == 0 then "—" else (.bound | length | tostring) end ),
          served: ( if (.bound | length) == 0 then "—"
                    elif (.isRemote | not) then "—"
                    elif $serversDenied then "not readable"
                    elif .served == null then "—"
                    else (.served | length | tostring) end ),
          approvals: ( if (.approvals | length) > 0 then (.approvals | length | tostring) else "—" end ),
          tools: ( if (.bound | length) == 0 then "not specified"
                   else ( (.bound[0:5] | join(", "))
                          + ( if (.bound | length) > 5 then (" +" + (((.bound | length) - 5) | tostring) + " more") else "" end ) ) end ) } ]
    | sort_by(.server, .agent) ) as $bindingRows
# ------------------------------------------------------------------ THE MATRIX
# "Who may call what" is a two-dimensional question and $bindingRows answers it one dimension at
# a time: it is one row per agent x server pair, so seeing which of the nine servers an agent may
# call means reading nine rows scattered through a sorted list of ~40. The matrix below is the
# same data pivoted -- one row per agent, one COLUMN per tool server -- which is the shape the
# question actually has. The pair list stays underneath it: it carries the bound TOOL NAMES,
# which a matrix cell cannot hold.
#
# Computed here, server-side, because the Table widget cannot pivot: `columns` is a plain list
# and the SPA renders exactly what it is given. Both the column list and the cells are emitted
# from this jq, which is also why the column set is DERIVED (the union of the readable servers
# and the servers something actually binds) rather than written down -- a tenth server appearing
# on the cluster grows a tenth column with no edit here.
#
# valueKeys are positional (c0..cN), never the server name: a name carries "/" and "." on a
# multi-namespace install, and the SPA keys cells by exact string match.
| ( if $serversDenied then [] else [ $serverRows[] | .name ] end ) as $listedServers
| ( [ $bindingRows[] | .server ] | unique ) as $boundServers
| ( ( $listedServers + $boundServers ) | unique | sort ) as $matrixServers
# SHORT titles, and only where shortening stays unambiguous. Full names run 20-35 chars
# ("core-provider-chart-gate-mcp-server") and nine of them beside an Agent column do not fit a
# screen: the first render ellipsised every header to "CLICKHOUS...", "ITBENCH-S...", so a cell
# could be read but not attributed to a server — which is the entire job of a matrix. A trailing
# "-mcp-server" / "-server" is dropped, and ONLY if every shortened name is still distinct;
# otherwise the full names are kept and the table scrolls rather than becoming ambiguous. The
# tool-server table directly above carries the full names either way.
| ( [ $matrixServers[] | sub("-mcp-server$"; "") | sub("-server$"; "") ] ) as $shortNames
| ( if ($shortNames | unique | length) == ($matrixServers | length) then $shortNames else $matrixServers end ) as $colTitles
| ( [ $matrixServers | to_entries[] | { key: ("c" + (.key | tostring)), title: ($colTitles[.key]) } ] ) as $matrixCols
| ( [ $matrixServers | to_entries[] | { key: .value, value: ("c" + (.key | tostring)) } ] | from_entries ) as $colOf
| ( [ $bindingRows[] | { key: (.agent + " @@ " + .server), value: . } ] | from_entries ) as $byPair
# Every agent gets a row, including one that binds nothing: "this agent calls no tools" is a fact
# about the fleet, and dropping the row would make it look like the agent was not readable.
| ( if $agentsDenied then []
    else ( [ (.agents.items // [])[]
             | ( if $multiNs then ((.metadata.namespace // "") + "/" + .metadata.name) else .metadata.name end ) ]
           | unique | sort ) end ) as $matrixAgents
# Cell vocabulary, in the mockup's own terms and no stronger:
#   U+00A0  nothing bound. A NON-BREAKING SPACE, not "". The SPA renders a FALSY cell as a dash
#           (ui/src/widgets/Table/Table.tsx:180, `if (!stringValue) { return '-' }`) and "" is
#           falsy — so the first render produced a GRID OF DASHES, which is precisely what
#           burying 37 filled cells among 135 looks like. A space is truthy and renders blank.
#           The durable fix is that frontend line (`stringValue === undefined`); until it lands
#           this is the only way to get a blank cell out of the widget set.
#   8       eight tools bound
#   8 !     some of them gated by requireApproval (a human approves the call)
#   8 ?     some bound name is not in the server's discovered list. NOT automatically a fault --
#           it is also what a deliberate forward/backward-compatible binding looks like -- so it
#           is marked, never coloured red and never called broken.
| ( [ $matrixAgents[] as $a
      | { agent: $a,
          cells: ( [ $matrixServers[] as $sv
                     | ( $byPair[$a + " @@ " + $sv] ) as $b
                     | { key: $colOf[$sv],
                         value: ( if $b == null then "\u00a0"
                                  else ( ( if $b.bound == "—" then "0" else $b.bound end )
                                         + ( if $b.approvals != "—" then " !" else "" end )
                                         + ( if ( $b.served != "—" and $b.served != "not readable"
                                                  and $b.bound != "—"
                                                  and (($b.served | tonumber) < ($b.bound | tonumber)) )
                                             then " ?" else "" end ) ) end ) } ] ) } ] ) as $matrixRows
| ( ( [ $matrixRows[] | .cells[] | select(.value | endswith("!")) ] | length ) > 0 ) as $anyHitl
| ( ( [ $matrixRows[] | .cells[] | select(.value | endswith("?")) ] | length ) > 0 ) as $anyUndisc
| { servers: ( if $serversDenied
               then [ { name: "Tool servers are not readable — the RemoteMCPServer list did not answer",
                        endpoint: "—", protocol: "—", timeout: "—", discovered: "—", inUse: "—", agents: "—",
                        statusLabel: "Not readable", statusColor: "default" } ]
               else $serverRows end ),
    bindings: ( if $agentsDenied
                then [ { server: "Agent bindings are not readable — the Agent list did not answer",
                         agent: "—",
                         bound: "—", served: "—", approvals: "—", tools: "—" } ]
                else $bindingRows end ),
    notice: ( ( [ $err.servers, $err.agents, $err.backends, $err.routes ]
                | map(select(.failed)) | map(.what + " " + .why + ".") )
              + ( if ($serversDenied or $agentsDenied) then ["Counts in this section are incomplete, not zero."] else [] end )
              + ( if (($gwDenied | not) and $gwSeen and $gwOpaque)
                  then ["At least one gateway backend selects its targets by label, which this page cannot resolve."] else [] end )
              + ( if ($gwDenied or ($gwSeen and $gwOpaque)) then ["Status does not report unrouted endpoints."] else [] end )
              | join(" ") ),
    serverCount:   ( if $serversDenied then null else ($serverRows | length) end ),
    bindingCount:  ( if $agentsDenied then null else ($bindingRows | length) end ),
    # Consumed by table.agents-servers-matrix: `matrixCols` becomes its `columns`, `matrixRows`
    # its `dataSource`. Both are null-safe -- a denied read yields an EMPTY matrix and the widget
    # renders its own not-readable notice, rather than an empty grid that would read as "nobody
    # calls anything".
    matrixCols:    ( if ($agentsDenied or (($matrixCols | length) == 0)) then [] else $matrixCols end ),
    matrixRows:    ( if $agentsDenied then [] else $matrixRows end ),
    matrixLegend:  ( if $agentsDenied
                     then "Agent bindings are not readable - the Agent list did not answer, so this matrix is empty rather than sparse."
                     else ( "Each cell is the number of tools that agent binds on that server."
                            + ( if $anyHitl then "  ! some of them are gated by requireApproval and pause for a human." else "" end )
                            + ( if $anyUndisc then "  ? at least one bound name is not in the server's discovered list, which is not automatically a fault - a deliberate compatibility binding looks the same." else "" end ) ) end ),
    consumerCount: ( if $agentsDenied then null else ([ $bindings[].agent ] | unique | length) end ) }
