restactions.filter:
def cdField($k):
  [ split("\n")[]
    | select(test("^\\s+" + $k + ":"))
    | sub("^\\s+" + $k + ":\\s*"; "") | sub("\\s+#.*$"; "") | sub("\\s+$"; "")
    | ltrimstr("\"") | rtrimstr("\"") | ltrimstr("'") | rtrimstr("'") ]
  | first // "";
def indexEntry($bp): (((.catalog.entries[$bp]?) // (.operators.entries[$bp]?) // [])[0]);
def builderFile($bp):
  if $bp == "" then ""
  else ([ ((.builderCds // []) | if type == "array" then . else [] end)[]
          | select(((.publish) // "") == ("publish-" + $bp)) | ((.cd) // "") ] | first // "") end;
# The publish's status projection, or null: parsed, and only when it has the three parts Install
# applies — a malformed bundle is no projection, so the install is the plain one.
def builderProjection($bp):
  if $bp == "" then null
  else ([ ((.builderProjections // []) | if type == "array" then . else [] end)[]
          | select(((.publish) // "") == ("publish-" + $bp)) | ((.projection) // "") ] | first // "") as $t
       | (if $t == "" then null else (try ($t | fromjson) catch null) end)
       | (if type == "object" and ((.restaction | type) == "object") and ((.apiRef | type) == "object")
               and ((.statusDataTemplate | type) == "array") then . else null end) end;
def builderChart($bp):
  ((indexEntry($bp).urls[0]?) // "") as $indexUrl
  | (if $indexUrl != "" then "" else builderFile($bp) end) as $file
  | { url: ($file | cdField("url")),
      version: ($file | cdField("version") | if . == "CHART_VERSION" then "" else . end) };
# What the install form holds, in the person's words: "controller" for a chart the Controller
# Builder published (krateo.io/builder on its registration file) and the form pre-fills, where the
# step is called Register; "blueprint" for everything else, an index chart included.
def installNoun($bp):
  if (builderChart($bp).url // "") == "" then "blueprint"
  else ([ ((.builderCds // []) | if type == "array" then . else [] end)[]
          | select(((.publish) // "") == ("publish-" + $bp)) | ((.builder) // "") ] | first // "")
       | if . == "controller" then "controller" else "blueprint" end end;
def ending($pr):
  if $pr == null then ""
  elif (($pr.merged) // false) == true then "merged"
  elif ((($pr.state) // "") != "closed") then ""
  elif ((($pr.mergedKnown) // false) | not) then "closed?"
  else "closed" end;
(.name // "") as $bp
| builderChart($bp) as $b
| (($b.url // "") != "") as $fromBuilder
# A builder publish of this name exists, but the name is a helm-index chart's, so the form
# holds that chart instead (builderChart); the author was sent here by their row all the same.
| ((($b.url // "") == "") and ((builderFile($bp) | cdField("url")) != "")) as $indexName
| ([ ((.builderPrs // []) | if type == "array" then . else [] end)[]
     | select(($fromBuilder or $indexName) and ((.publish) // "") == ("publish-" + $bp)) ] | first) as $pr
| (($pr.url) // "") as $url
| ending($pr) as $end
# "which merged on 2026-09-30" when the provider dated it; the day is enough for a sentence.
| (if $end == "merged" and ((($pr.mergedAt) // "") | length) >= 10 then (" on " + ($pr.mergedAt[0:10])) else "" end) as $on
# A page set's merge releases nothing — its version comes from a tag the person pushes, as
# the version field below says — so "its release" would send them waiting for one.
| (if ($b.version // "") == "" then "a release you tagged on main is green" else "its release is green" end) as $released
# A controller is registered, not installed (installNoun): the header and the note say so.
| installNoun($bp) as $noun
| (if $noun == "controller" then "Register" else "Install" end) as $verb
# The header's maturity and version: the blueprints index entry, as marketplace-detail reads it.
| ((((.catalog // {}).entries // {})[$bp] // [])[0] // {}) as $latest
| { noun: $noun,
    title: ($verb + " " + (if $bp != "" then $bp else $noun end)),
    subtitle: ([ (($latest.annotations // {})["krateo.io/maturity"] // empty),
                 (if ($latest.version // "") != "" then ("v" + $latest.version) else empty end) ]
               | map(select(. != null and . != "")) | join("  ·  ")),
    changeRequest: { url: $url, state: (($pr.state) // ""), ending: $end, mergedAt: (if $end == "merged" then (($pr.mergedAt) // "") else "" end) },
    note: (if $indexName
           then ((if $url != "" then ("Published by " + $url + " under") else "A builder publish uses" end)
                 + " a name the marketplace already has. This form installs the marketplace chart of that name, not the published one; to install that one, publish it under another name.")
           elif $url == "" then ""
           elif $end == "merged" then ("Published by " + $url + ", which merged" + $on + ". " + $verb + " it once " + $released + ".")
           elif $end == "closed" then ("Published by " + $url + ", which closed without merging: nothing was released, so there is nothing to " + ($verb | ascii_downcase) + ".")
           elif $end == "closed?" then ("Published by " + $url + ", now closed. " + $verb + " it only if that change request merged and " + $released + ".")
           elif (($pr.state) // "") == "open" then ("Published by " + $url + ", still open. " + $verb + " it once it merges and " + $released + ".")
           else ("Published by " + $url + ". " + $verb + " it once that change request merges and " + $released + ".") end) }

def withLive:
  (((.catalogLive // {}) | if type == "object" then (.entries // {}) else {} end) | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $live
  | (((.catalog // {}) | if type == "object" then . else {} end)) as $cat
  | (($cat.entries // {}) | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $cur

def qstr($p): ([ $p | to_entries[] | select(.value != null and .value != "") | (.key + "=" + .value) ] | join("&")) as $s
  | (if $s == "" then "/marketplace" else "/marketplace?" + $s end);
# Presentational icon variety (honest — driven by the card's REAL helm data, not invented).
# At ~330 charts the two source glyphs (fa-layer-group / fa-gears) make the grid a wall of
# identical icons; this maps a card to a Font Awesome glyph off its own keywords first
# (the service-family signal — ec2/rds/s3/kafka/...), then its `krateo.io/category`
# annotation (compute/network/database/...), then falls back to the source glyph. Every
# value here is a plain glyph name; a card with no matching keyword/category just gets the
# source fallback (never an error, never a blank).
#   $kwIcon: keyword (lower-case, matched by substring) -> glyph. Ordered most→least
#   specific; FIRST hit wins. Keys are real tokens seen in the index keywords.
def kwIcon:
  [ ["database","fa-database"], ["rds","fa-database"], ["dynamodb","fa-database"],
    ["documentdb","fa-database"], ["memorydb","fa-database"], ["docdb","fa-database"],
    ["elasticache","fa-bolt"], ["cache","fa-bolt"], ["redis","fa-bolt"],
    ["s3","fa-hard-drive"], ["storage","fa-hard-drive"], ["efs","fa-hard-drive"],
    ["backup","fa-box-archive"], ["ecr","fa-box-archive"], ["registry","fa-box-archive"],
    ["kafka","fa-list"], ["queue","fa-list"], ["sqs","fa-list"], ["sns","fa-bell"],
    ["eventbridge","fa-bell"], ["network","fa-network-wired"], ["vpc","fa-network-wired"],
    ["route53","fa-network-wired"], ["elbv2","fa-network-wired"], ["elb","fa-network-wired"],
    ["alb","fa-network-wired"], ["loadbalancer","fa-network-wired"], ["cloudfront","fa-network-wired"],
    ["apigateway","fa-route"], ["gateway","fa-route"], ["firewall","fa-shield-halved"],
    ["waf","fa-shield-halved"], ["security","fa-shield-halved"], ["iam","fa-key"],
    ["kms","fa-key"], ["identity","fa-key"], ["certificate","fa-certificate"],
    ["acm","fa-certificate"], ["vault","fa-shield-halved"], ["eks","fa-dharmachakra"],
    ["ecs","fa-cubes"], ["cluster","fa-dharmachakra"], ["kubernetes","fa-dharmachakra"],
    ["lambda","fa-bolt"], ["ec2","fa-server"], ["compute","fa-server"], ["ssm","fa-terminal"],
    ["sagemaker","fa-brain"], ["bedrock","fa-brain"], ["ai-agent","fa-robot"],
    ["kagent","fa-robot"], ["quicksight","fa-chart-line"], ["dashboard","fa-gauge-high"],
    ["cloudwatch","fa-chart-line"], ["prometheus","fa-chart-line"], ["observability","fa-chart-line"],
    ["opentelemetry","fa-chart-line"], ["codegen","fa-code"], ["oasgen","fa-code"],
    ["kog","fa-code"], ["helm","fa-ship"], ["domain","fa-globe"] ];
#   $catIcon: krateo.io/category annotation -> glyph (the coarse fallback when no keyword hit).
def catIcon:
  { "compute":"fa-server", "network":"fa-network-wired", "database":"fa-database",
    "storage":"fa-hard-drive", "security":"fa-shield-halved", "observability":"fa-chart-line",
    "application":"fa-cubes", "generator":"fa-code" };
# iconFor: first keyword substring hit -> its glyph; else the category glyph; else the
# source fallback ($fallback). $kws lower-cased upstream.
def iconFor($kws; $cat; $fallback):
  ( first( kwIcon[] | select( . as $pair | any($kws[]; contains($pair[0])) ) | .[1] ) )
  // (catIcon[$cat]) // $fallback;
# Title-case a lower-case category token for the on-card pill (compute -> Compute).
def titlecase: if . == "" then "" else (.[0:1] | ascii_upcase) + .[1:] end;
# INSTALLED index — the honest catalog<->cluster join. Keyed by "<repoBaseUrl>|<chartName>"
# and built ONLY from helm-repo CDs (non-empty spec.chart.repo). A helm-repo CD carries
# spec.chart.repo = the chart NAME and spec.chart.url = the helm-repo BASE URL, so the key
# matches a catalog entry's own (repoBase | name). OCI/platform-component CDs have EMPTY .repo
# and are excluded entirely, so a same-named platform component (e.g. an OCI `kagent`) can NEVER
# false-light a catalog tile. On a cluster with only OCI components NOTHING matches → installed
# is false everywhere → the tile badge stays hidden (correct + honest; never fabricated).
# withLive first: the live index's newly published blueprints join the catalog (_catalog.tpl).
withLive
| ( [ (.compdefs // [])[] | select((.repo // "") != "")
    | { key: ((.url // "") + "|" + (.repo // "")),
        value: {ns: .ns, name: .name, version: .version} } ]
  | from_entries ) as $instByRepo
| ((.category) // "all") as $sel
| ((.source) // "all") as $src
| ((.q) // "") as $q
| ((.spotlight) // "") as $spot
# ?sort= reorders the grid. Only two orders the helm index actually supports:
#   "name"   -> chart name A->Z (the default; every entry has a name)
#   "recent" -> most-recently-published first (index `created` RFC3339, desc)
# The index carries NO downloads/popularity/rating field, so no "trending"/"popular"
# sort is offered (would be fabricated). Unknown ?sort= values fall back to name.
| (((.sort) // "name") | if . == "recent" then "recent" else "name" end) as $sort
| ($q | ascii_downcase) as $ql
| (
    [ (((.catalog // {}).entries) // {}) | to_entries[] | (.value[0] + {source: "blueprint"}) ]
    + [ (((.operators // {}).entries) // {}) | to_entries[] | (.value[0] + {source: "operator"}) ]
  ) as $raw
| ( [ $raw[]
      # helm-repo base URL for THIS card (its own tarball URL with the filename stripped; for a
      # card withLive added, the channel's base it carries as repoBase) and
      # the installed-join key "<repoBase>|<chartName>". Looked up in $instByRepo (helm-repo CDs
      # only); a hit means a CompositionDefinition installed FROM this exact repo+chart exists.
      | (.repoBase // ((.urls[0] // "") | sub("/[^/]+$"; ""))) as $repoBase
      | ($instByRepo[$repoBase + "|" + .name]) as $match
      | {
          name: .name,
          description: (.description // ""),
          keywords: (.keywords // []),
          tags: (.keywords // []),
          source: .source,
          typeLabel: (if .source == "operator" then "Operator" else "Blueprint" end),
          typeColor: (if .source == "operator" then "magenta" else "cyan" end),
          # CATEGORY pill (the mockup's per-tile defining signal) — the REAL
          # `krateo.io/category` annotation (compute/network/database/...), title-cased for
          # display. Empty when the chart carries no category (e.g. operators) -> the card
          # renders no pill (never invented). Type stays on the icon tint (typeColor).
          category: (((.annotations // {})["krateo.io/category"] // "") | ascii_downcase | titlecase),
          # Per-card icon: keyword service-family -> category annotation -> source glyph.
          # Presentational, driven entirely by the card's own real helm data.
          icon: iconFor(
                  ((.keywords // []) | map(ascii_downcase));
                  ((.annotations // {})["krateo.io/category"] // "" | ascii_downcase);
                  (if .source == "operator" then "fa-gears" else "fa-layer-group" end)
                ),
          maturity: ((.annotations // {})["krateo.io/maturity"] // ""),
          version: (.version // ""),
          # helm index publish timestamp (RFC3339); drives the "recently updated" sort.
          created: (.created // ""),
          url: (.urls[0] // ""),
          repoUrl: $repoBase,
          # INSTALLED-ness — the honest catalog<->cluster join ($match, keyed by repoBase|name;
          # helm-repo CDs only). true only when a CD was installed from THIS repo+chart.
          installed: ($match != null),
          installedVersion: ($match.version // ""),
          # namespace + name of the matched CompositionDefinition (for the installed-detail
          # link); empty strings when not installed.
          installedNs: ($match.ns // ""),
          installedName: ($match.name // ""),
          # at-a-glance "already installed" glyph on the tile (reuses the Listy status channel);
          # empty icon when not installed -> the card renders no glyph (exception-only badge).
          installedIcon: (if $match != null then "fa-circle-check" else "" end),
          installedColor: (if $match != null then "green" else "" end),
          installedTooltip: (if $match != null then ("Installed · v" + ($match.version // "")) else "" end)
        }
    ] ) as $cards
# The cards matching the ACTIVE facets (source + category + free-text) — computed once so
# BOTH the head-stat count and the rendered grid stay in sync (the head-stat reflects what
# is actually shown, never a fabricated total).
| ( [ $cards[] | select(
        ($src == "all" or .source == $src)
        and ($sel == "all" or ((.keywords | index($sel)) != null))
        and ($ql == ""
             or (.name | ascii_downcase | contains($ql))
             or (.description | ascii_downcase | contains($ql))
             or ((.keywords | join(" ")) | ascii_downcase | contains($ql)))
    ) ] ) as $shown
# Head-stat noun: reflects the active source facet so the eyebrow reads honestly
# ("blueprints" / "operators" / "charts" when the catalog is mixed).
| (if $src == "blueprint" then "blueprints"
   elif $src == "operator" then "operators"
   else "charts" end) as $countLabel
| {
    selectedCategory: $sel,
    selectedSource: $src,
    selectedSort: $sort,
    # Head-stat: real catalog cardinality. `total` = every card fetched from both indexes
    # (unfiltered); `count` = the cards the active facets show (what the grid renders).
    total: ($cards | length),
    count: ($shown | length),
    countLabel: $countLabel,
    categories: (
      [ {key: "all", label: "All", count: ($cards | length), active: ($sel == "all"),
         route: qstr({category: "", source: (if $src == "all" then "" else $src end), q: $q, sort: (if $sort == "name" then "" else $sort end)})} ]
      + ( [ $cards[] | .keywords[] ] | group_by(.)
          | map({key: .[0], label: .[0], count: length, active: (.[0] == $sel),
                 route: qstr({category: .[0], source: (if $src == "all" then "" else $src end), q: $q, sort: (if $sort == "name" then "" else $sort end)})})
          | map(select(.count >= 5)) | sort_by(.count) | reverse )
    ),
    sources: [
      {key: "all", label: "All", active: ($src == "all"),
       route: qstr({source: "", category: (if $sel == "all" then "" else $sel end), q: $q, sort: (if $sort == "name" then "" else $sort end)})},
      {key: "blueprint", label: "Blueprints", active: ($src == "blueprint"),
       route: qstr({source: "blueprint", category: (if $sel == "all" then "" else $sel end), q: $q, sort: (if $sort == "name" then "" else $sort end)})},
      {key: "operator", label: "Operators", active: ($src == "operator"),
       route: qstr({source: "operator", category: (if $sel == "all" then "" else $sel end), q: $q, sort: (if $sort == "name" then "" else $sort end)})}
    ],
    # Sort facet — ONLY the orders the helm index data supports (name, created). Each
    # chip's route preserves the active source/category/q filter so sort composes.
    sorts: [
      {key: "name", label: "Name (A–Z)", active: ($sort == "name"),
       route: qstr({sort: "", source: (if $src == "all" then "" else $src end), category: (if $sel == "all" then "" else $sel end), q: $q})},
      {key: "recent", label: "Recently updated", active: ($sort == "recent"),
       route: qstr({sort: "recent", source: (if $src == "all" then "" else $src end), category: (if $sel == "all" then "" else $sel end), q: $q})}
    ],
    cards: (
      # Base order per ?sort=: name A->Z (default) or created desc (most recent first).
      ( if $sort == "recent" then ($shown | sort_by(.created) | reverse)
        else ($shown | sort_by(.name)) end )
      # ?spotlight=<name> (a global-search catalog hit's hand-off): sort the matching
      # card FIRST and mark it via the EXISTING status-glyph channel (orange star +
      # tooltip) — search always lands on installable-only hits, so the installed
      # check (which this channel normally carries) is guarded, never overwritten.
      | (if $spot == "" then .
         else ( map(if (.name == $spot) and (.installed | not)
                    then . + { installedIcon: "fa-star", installedColor: "orange", installedTooltip: "Matched your search" }
                    else . end)
                | ([ .[] | select(.name == $spot) ] + [ .[] | select(.name != $spot) ]) )
         end)
    )
  }

restactions.name: builder-prs

stages.name: publishes
stages.filter:
[ (.publishes.items // [])[]
  | select(((.metadata.labels["krateo.io/publish"]) // "") != "")
  # A nightly-review proposal (krateo.io/builder: review) rides the same chain but is not a
  # builder's publish; this feed promises the Portal, Blueprint and Controller builders' own.
  | select(((.metadata.labels["krateo.io/builder"]) // "") != "review")
  | { publish: ((.metadata.labels["krateo.io/publish"]) // ""),
      # page | blueprint | controller — only the first two register through a
      # CompositionDefinition, so only their rows can lead to Install.
      builder: ((.metadata.labels["krateo.io/builder"]) // ""),
      branch: (((.status.targetBranch) // (.spec.toRepo.branch)) // ""),
      repo: (((.spec.toRepo.url) // "") | rtrimstr(".git") | split("/")
             | (if length >= 2 then (.[-2] + "/" + .[-1]) else "" end)),
      synced: ([ (.status.conditions // [])[] | select((.type // "") == "Synced") ] | first // {} | (.status // "")),
      # The REASON and MESSAGE, not just the status. Dropping them is what let five hard failures
      # render as a mild orange "Pending" for 30 hours: `synced` alone is a tri-state flattened to a
      # boolean, so "queued" and "broken for a day" became the same row.
      syncReason: ([ (.status.conditions // [])[] | select((.type // "") == "Synced") ] | first // {} | (.reason // "")),
      syncMsg: ([ (.status.conditions // [])[] | select((.type // "") == "Synced") ] | first // {} | (.message // "")),
      # Is this file the publish's root registration file — the one the install form
      # pre-fills from? A publish without one is never offered Install (see the header).
      reg: ((((.spec.fromResource.fileName) // "") == "compositiondefinition.yaml") and ((((.spec.toRepo.path) // "/") as $p | ($p == "/" or $p == "")))),
      # Identity, so a row can point at the object it is about.
      ns: ((.metadata.namespace) // ""),
      lrName: ((.metadata.name) // ""),
      created: ((.metadata.creationTimestamp) // "") } ]

stages.name: cds
stages.filter: [ (.cds.items // [])[] | ((.metadata.name) // "") ]

restactions.filter:
# ending($pr): "merged" | "closed?" | "closed" | "" — portal.builderPrEnding (_builder.tpl),
# shared with restaction.blueprint-builder-deliverables.
def ending($pr):
  if $pr == null then ""
  elif (($pr.merged) // false) == true then "merged"
  elif ((($pr.state) // "") != "closed") then ""
  elif ((($pr.mergedKnown) // false) | not) then "closed?"
  else "closed" end;
((.cdsError // null) == null) as $cdsRead
| ((.cds // []) | if type == "array" then . else [] end | map({key: ., value: true}) | from_entries) as $registered
| ([ ((.prs.items) // [])[]
   | { publish: ((.metadata.labels["krateo.io/publish"]) // ""),
       number: ((.status.number) // 0),
       state: ((.status.state) // "pending"),
       merged: ((.status.merged) == true),
       # Reported at all, as opposed to reported false — see portal.builderPrEnding.
       mergedKnown: (((.status.merged) | type) == "boolean"),
       mergedAt: (if ((.status.merged) == true) and (((.status.merged_at) | type) == "string") then .status.merged_at else "" end),
       url: ((.status.html_url) // "") } ]) as $prIndex
| ([ ((.prs.items) // [])[]
    # LEGACY PRs ONLY. Since builder-publish 1.8.21 a claim publish opens its own PullRequest,
    # labelled krateo.io/publish — those belong to the claim row below, which joins them. Without
    # this select the same publish would render twice: once as a PR row, once as a claim row.
    | select(((.metadata.labels["krateo.io/publish"]) // "") == "")
    | (((.spec.owner) // "") + "/" + ((.spec.repo) // "")) as $repo
    | ((.spec.head) // "") as $head
    | ((.status.state) // "pending") as $rawState
    | ((.status.merged) == true) as $merged
    # Domain state: a PR the provider calls merged is "merged" (green) whatever its state, a
    # closed-unmerged one is "closed" (slate); anything still open is "open" (blue);
    # pre-reconcile is "pending".
    | (if $merged then "merged" else $rawState end) as $state
    | {
        name:  (.metadata.name // ""),
        repo:  $repo,
        head:  $head,
        # Identity pill: "<owner>/<repo> · #<N>" (+ the head branch when present). The PR
        # number rides from status.number (written after the provider opens the PR).
        sub:   ($repo
                + (if ((.status.number) // 0) > 0 then (" · #" + ((.status.number) | tostring)) else "" end)
                + (if $head != "" then (" · " + $head) else "" end)),
        title: ((.spec.title) // ""),
        state: $state,
        # Sentence-cased chip label ("Open"/"Merged"/"Closed"/"Pending") — the raw lowercase
        # `state` stays for the colour-map keys.
        stateLabel: (if $state == "" then "" else ((($state)[0:1] | ascii_upcase) + ($state)[1:]) end),
        # #84 §0.2: the Table's Status cell takes a single colour (the Listy used a colour-map);
        # resolve it server-side — open→blue / merged→green (a landed deliverable) / closed→gray /
        # pending→orange. Same vocabulary the Listy's map used.
        stateColor: (if $state == "open" then "blue" elif $state == "merged" then "green" elif $state == "closed" then "gray" else "orange" end),
        # #84 §0.2: the PR "#N" cell (same derivation as blueprint-builder-deliverables); "" until
        # the provider writes status.number.
        pr:    (if ((.status.number) // 0) > 0 then ("#" + ((.status.number) | tostring)) else "" end),
        # PR open age — the raw creationTimestamp; the Table formats it `relative` ("14d ago").
        created: (.metadata.creationTimestamp // ""),
        mergedAt: (if ((.status.merged) == true) and (((.status.merged_at) | type) == "string") then .status.merged_at else "" end),
        # The GitHub PR URL (status.html_url) — the Listy row's external navigateTo. A PR
        # with no URL yet (freshly created, pre-reconcile) gets "" → the row is inert.
        url:   ((.status.html_url) // "")
      } ]) as $prRows
| ([ (.publishes // []) | group_by(.publish)[]
     | select((.[0].publish // "") != "")
     | .[0] as $p0
     | (all(.[]; .synced == "True")) as $pushed
     # A publish whose Synced condition carries ReconcileError is NOT in flight — it has stopped.
     # On krateo-057 five of seven sat here: a missing publish-<name>-git-username Secret, or a
     # stuck krateo.io/external-create-pending annotation. Neither self-heals.
     | (any(.[]; .syncReason == "ReconcileError")) as $failed
     # The publish carries its root registration file (portal.builderIsRegistrationFile).
     | (any(.[]; .reg == true)) as $hasReg
     | ([ .[] | select(.syncReason == "ReconcileError") | .syncMsg ] | map(select(. != "")) | first // "") as $failMsg
     # Claim-path row. Option A is no longer the only ending: builder-publish 1.8.21 opens the
     # change request itself once every file is committed, so a claim row can now carry a real
     # PR number, state and URL. When no PR CR exists — pullRequest.create off, the chart's CRD
     # guard on an install below github-provider-kog 0.3.0, or a publish that failed before the
     # gate opened — the row keeps exactly the behaviour it had: "Pushed"/"Publish failed", and
     # a link to the LocalResource, which is the better destination for a failure anyway.
     | ( [ $prIndex[] | select(((.publish) // "") == ($p0.publish // "")) ] | first ) as $pr
     | (($pr.number) // 0) as $prNum
     | ending($pr) as $end
     # "merged" only on the provider's word; a closed PR without it stays "closed".
     | (if $end == "merged" then "merged" else (($pr.state) // "") end) as $prState
     | ($p0.publish | sub("^publish-"; "")) as $chart
     # INSTALL: a Portal or Blueprint publish that carries its registration file, whose change
     # request merged (or closed, with no merge signal from the provider), and whose chart has
     # no CompositionDefinition here, read successfully. Controller publishes never qualify —
     # see the header.
     | ((((($p0.builder) // "") == "page") or ((($p0.builder) // "") == "blueprint"))
        and $hasReg
        and $cdsRead
        and (($registered[$chart] // false) | not)
        and ($end == "merged" or $end == "closed?")) as $register
     | { name: $p0.publish,
         repo: $p0.repo,
         head: $p0.branch,
         sub: ($p0.repo + (if ($p0.branch // "") != "" then (" · " + $p0.branch) else "" end)),
         title: $chart,
         # A change request that has ENDED outranks a LocalResource failure. The PR exists only
         # because every file reported a commit (builder-publish's PR gate), so the publish
         # itself succeeded; a failure reported after the PR closed is about the branch, and
         # must not hide a merged row's way on to Install. The failure still shows in Reason.
         state: (if $end != "" then $prState elif $failed then "failed" elif $prNum > 0 then $prState elif $pushed then "pushed" else "pending" end),
         stateLabel: (if $end != "" then ((($prState)[0:1] | ascii_upcase) + ($prState)[1:])
                      elif $failed then "Publish failed"
                      elif $prNum > 0 then (if $prState == "" then "" else ((($prState)[0:1] | ascii_upcase) + ($prState)[1:]) end)
                      elif $pushed then "Pushed" else "Pending" end),
         # COMPUTED, not the literal "orange" this used to be — the whole reason a pushed row and a
           # pending row rendered the same chip: the LABEL branched and the COLOUR did not.
           stateColor: (if $end != "" then (if $prState == "merged" then "green" else "gray" end)
                       elif $failed then "red"
                       elif $prNum > 0 then (if $prState == "open" then "blue" elif $prState == "merged" then "green" elif $prState == "closed" then "gray" else "orange" end)
                       elif $pushed then "green" else "orange" end),
           # What actually went wrong, for the new Reason column. A healthy row says nothing.
           reason: (if $failed then ($failMsg | if length > 140 then (.[0:140] + "…") else . end) else "" end),
         # What the row click does next, when that is a person's step; empty otherwise. A page
         # set's merge releases nothing, so its step starts with the tag (see the header).
         next: (if $register
                then (if (($p0.builder) // "") == "page"
                      then (if $end == "merged" then "Tag a release, then install" else "If merged: tag a release, then install" end)
                      elif $end == "merged" then "Install" else "Install if merged" end)
                else "" end),
         pr: (if $prNum > 0 then ("#" + ($prNum | tostring)) else "" end),
         created: ($p0.created // ""),
         mergedAt: (if $end == "merged" then (($pr.mergedAt) // "") else "" end),
         # A per-row destination, replacing the hardcoded "" that made every claim row SILENTLY
           # un-clickable: rowNavigateTo "{url}" plus an empty cell makes Table.tsx drop the
           # handlers entirely — no cursor, no role, no error. The LocalResource behind a
           # publish is a real object, and the generic resource-detail route renders its
           # conditions, which is exactly the "why did this fail" this table cannot fit.
           # A row that leads to Install opens the install Form instead — the step the person
           # has left — and the Ref column still names its PR (#N), which that page links.
           url: (if $register then ("/marketplace/" + $chart + "/install")
                 elif (($pr.url) // "") != "" then $pr.url
                 else ("/resources/" + (($p0.ns // "") | if . == "" then "krateo-system" else . end) + "/git.krateo.io/v1alpha1/localresources/" + ($p0.lrName // "")) end) } ]) as $claimRows
| { rows: (($prRows + $claimRows) | sort_by(.created // "") | reverse) }

restactions.name: cluster-compositions

stages.name: spokeCrds
stages.filter:
{ compositionCrds: [ .spokeCrds.items[]?
    | select(.spec.group == "composition.krateo.io")
    | { group: .spec.group,
        plural: .spec.names.plural,
        version: ([ .spec.versions[]? | select(.served == true) | .name ] | first // "") }
    | select(.version != "") ],
  hasCompositionDefinitions: ([ .spokeCrds.items[]?
    | select((.spec.group == "core.krateo.io") and (.spec.names.plural == "compositiondefinitions")) ] | length > 0) }

stages.name: spokeCompositions
stages.filter:
[ .spokeCompositions as $env
  | ($env.kind // "" | sub("List$"; "")) as $kind
  | $env.items[]?
  | { kind: (if $kind != "" then $kind else "Composition" end),
      name: (.metadata.name // ""),
      namespace: (.metadata.namespace // ""),
      created: (.metadata.creationTimestamp // ""),
      ready: ([ .status.conditions[]? | select(.type == "Ready") | (.status // "") ] | first // ""),
      synced: ([ .status.conditions[]? | select(.type == "Synced") | (.status // "") ] | first // "") } ]

stages.name: spokeCompositionDefinitions
stages.filter:
[ .spokeCompositionDefinitions as $env
  | ($env.kind // "" | sub("List$"; "")) as $kind
  | $env.items[]?
  | { kind: (if $kind != "" then $kind else "CompositionDefinition" end),
      name: (.metadata.name // ""),
      namespace: (.metadata.namespace // ""),
      created: (.metadata.creationTimestamp // ""),

restactions.filter:
# Input: snowplow's resolve dict — the request extras at the top level, each stage's (step-filtered)
# output under its name, and each stage's errors, accumulated as a list, under its errorKey.
def truthy: . != null and . != false and . != "" and . != 0 and . != [] and . != {};  # Helm `if`
# readyWhen has TWO forms and both have to evaluate here, because Helm's `readinessGuard` compiles both
# (see the composer's readyWhen.ts). Reading only the field form leaves a condition-form node waiting
# forever on a resource that is ready, with nothing to search for. `[capture(...)] | first` rather than
# a bare capture: on no match capture emits NOTHING, which drops the whole node from the array around it.
def condType($rw): [ $rw | capture("^\\.status\\.conditions\\[\\] \\| select\\(\\.type == \"(?<t>\\w+)\"\\) \\| \\.status == \"True\"$") ] | first | .t;
def readyBy($rw):                          # the condition's truth, or the field's Helm-truthiness
  if ($rw // "") == "" then true
  else condType($rw) as $t
  | if $t != null then any((.status.conditions // [])[]; .type == $t and .status == "True")
    else ((try getpath($rw | ltrimstr(".") | split(".")) catch null) | truthy) end
  end;
def readyValue($rw):                       # what the check READ: the condition's status, or the field
  if ($rw // "") == "" then null
  else condType($rw) as $t
  | if $t != null then ([ (.status.conditions // [])[] | select(.type == $t) | .status ] | first)
    else (try getpath($rw | ltrimstr(".") | split(".")) catch null) end
  end;
def errKind:
  if type == "object" then
    (if (.code // 0) == 403 or .reason == "Forbidden" then "forbidden"
     elif (.code // 0) == 404 or .reason == "NotFound" then "notfound" else "error" end)
  elif type == "string" then
    (if test("forbidden|not authorized"; "i") then "forbidden"
     elif test("not found"; "i") then "notfound" else "error" end)
  else "error" end;
def nameIn: [capture("\"(?<n>[^\"]+)\" (is forbidden|not found)")][0].n // null;
def errName:
  if type == "object" then (.details.name // ((.message // "") | nameIn))
  elif type == "string" then nameIn
  else null end;
def errs($k): [ ($k // []) | if type == "array" then .[] else . end ];
def exception:                                         # K8s-native tokens, exception-only
  (.status.conditions // []) as $c
  | ([ $c[] | select(.type == "Synced" and .status == "False") ][0]) as $s
  | ([ $c[] | select((.type == "Ready" or .type == "Available") and .status == "False") ][0]) as $r
  | if $s != null then {label: "NotSynced", reason: ($s.reason // ""), message: ($s.message // "")}
    elif $r != null then {label: "NotReady", reason: ($r.reason // ""), message: ($r.message // "")}
    else null end;

(.arch.graph // null) as $g
| (errs(.archErr) | map(errKind)) as $archErrs
| if $g == null then
    { architecture: false,
      access: (if any($archErrs[]; . == "forbidden") then "forbidden"
               elif any($archErrs[]; . == "error") then "error" else null end) }
  elif (.comp[0]? // null) == null then
    { architecture: true, chart: $g.chart, composition: ($g.composition.name? // ""), readable: false, states: $g.states,
      access: (if any(errs(.compErr)[]; errKind == "forbidden") then "forbidden" else "error" end),
      level: null, state: null, allReady: null, waitingOn: [], progress: null, since: null, next: [],
      nodes: [ ($g.nodes // [])[] | select((.lifecycle // "") == "")
               | {id, kind, apiVersion, class, level, present, forEach: (.forEach // false), readyWhen: (.readyWhen // null),
                  parents: [ .dependsOn[]? | select(.active) | .ref ], expected: (.names | length),
                  phase: (if .present then "unknown" else "absent" end)} ] }
  else
  (.comp[0]? // null) as $comp
  | ($comp.managed // []) as $managed
  | ([ .objs ] | flatten | map(select(type == "object" and (.metadata.name // "") != ""))) as $got
  | (errs(.objErr) | map(select(errKind == "forbidden") | errName) | map(select(. != null))) as $denied
  | (errs(.objErr) | map(select(errKind == "notfound") | errName) | map(select(. != null))) as $missing
  | [ ($g.nodes // [])[] | select((.lifecycle // "") == "") ] as $seq
  # 1. each instance, from what was rendered (status.managed) and what the caller could read
  | [ $seq[] | . as $n
      | [ .names[]? as $nm
          | ([ $got[] | select(.metadata.name == $nm and (.apiVersion == "" or .apiVersion == $n.apiVersion)) ][0]) as $o
          | (any($managed[]; .name == $nm and .apiVersion == $n.apiVersion)) as $rendered
          | { name: $nm,
              read: (if $o != null then "ok"
                     elif ($rendered | not) then "withheld"
                     elif ($denied | index($nm)) != null then "unreadable"
                     elif ($missing | index($nm)) != null then "missing"
                     else "unavailable" end),
              satisfied: (if $o == null then null else ($o | readyBy($n.readyWhen)) end),
              value: (if $o != null then ($o | readyValue($n.readyWhen)) else null end),
              since: (if $o != null then ($o.metadata.creationTimestamp // null) else null end),
              exception: (if $o != null then ($o | exception) else null end) } ] as $inst
      | $n + { instances: $inst } ] as $nodes0
  # 2. a rendered dependent proves its ready: true dependencies held at the last render (gate parity)
  | ([ $nodes0[] | select(.present)
       | select(any(.instances[]; .read != "withheld"))
       | .dependsOn[]? | select(.active and .ready) | .ref ] | unique) as $proven
  | [ $nodes0[] | . as $n
      | (($proven | index($n.id)) != null) as $isProven
      | (($n.readyWhen // "") == "") as $existence
      | [ .instances[] | . + { ok: (if .satisfied == true then true
                                   elif .read == "ok" then false
                                   elif .read == "withheld" then false
                                   elif .read == "missing" then false
                                   elif $existence or $isProven then true
                                   else null end) } ] as $inst
      | { id, kind, apiVersion, class, level, present, forEach: (.forEach // false), readyWhen: (.readyWhen // null),
          parents: [ .dependsOn[]? | select(.active) | .ref ],
          waits: [ .dependsOn[]? | select(.active and .ready) | {ref, all: (.all // false)} ],
          expected: ($inst | length),
          rendered: ([ $inst[] | select(.read != "withheld") ] | length),
          satisfied: ([ $inst[] | select(.ok == true) ] | length),
          unknown: ([ $inst[] | select(.ok == null) ] | length),
          unreadable: ([ $inst[] | select(.read == "unreadable") ] | length),
          inferred: any($inst[]; .ok == true and .read != "ok"),
          since: ([ $inst[] | .since | select(. != null) ] | min),
          exception: ([ $inst[] | .exception | select(. != null) ][0]),
          instances: $inst } ] as $nodes
  # 3. the level: the first level (of those this composition uses) whose nodes are not all satisfied
  | ([ $nodes[] | select(.present) | .level ] | unique) as $levels
  | ([ $levels[] as $l | select(any($nodes[]; .present and .level == $l and .satisfied < .expected)) | $l ][0]) as $cur
  | ($cur == null) as $all
  | (if $all then ($levels | max) else $cur end) as $level
  | [ $nodes[] | . + { phase: (if (.present | not) then "absent"
                               elif .satisfied == .expected then "done"
                               elif .unknown > 0 and .unreadable > 0 then "unreadable"
                               elif .unknown > 0 then "unavailable"
                               elif .rendered == 0 and .expected > 0 then "withheld"
                               else "waiting" end) } ] as $nodes2
  # 4. a withheld node whose every parent is done has an OPEN gate: the chart would render it now.
  #    It is "not created" — yet (CDC re-renders within its resync), or because the render failed
  #    (the composition's own Synced/Ready=False says why) — never "waits for" parents that are done.
  | [ $nodes2[] | . + { gateOpen: (.phase == "withheld" and (.parents | length) > 0
                                   and all(.parents[]; . as $p | any($nodes2[]; .id == $p and .phase == "done"))) } ] as $nodes2
  | { architecture: true,
      chart: $g.chart,
      composition: ($g.composition.name? // ""),
      readable: ($comp != null),
      states: $g.states,
      level: $level,
      state: (if $level == null then null else ($g.states[$level] // null) end),
      allReady: $all,
      waitingOn: (if $all then [] else [ $nodes2[] | select(.present and .level == $cur and .satisfied < .expected)
                   | {id, kind, pending: (.expected - .satisfied), phase, gateOpen} ] end),
      progress: (if $all then null else ([ $nodes2[] | select(.present and .level == $cur) ]
                   | {satisfied: (map(.satisfied) | add), expected: (map(.expected) | add)}) end),
      since: (if $all then null else ([ $nodes2[] | select(.present and .level == $cur) | .since | select(. != null) ] | min) end),
      next: (if $all then [] else [ $nodes2[] | select(.present and .level == ($levels | map(select(. > $cur)) | min)) | .id ] end),
      # Only Synced=False: the render or apply failed. Ready=False is a composition still converging.
      compositionNotSynced: ({status: {conditions: ($comp.conditions // [])}} | exception | if . != null and .label == "NotSynced" then . else null end),
      nodes: $nodes2 }
  end

stages.name: jsonschema
stages.iterator: .name as $n | .namespace as $ns | ([ .found[]? | select((try (.metadata.name == $n and .metadata.namespace == $ns) catch false)) ][0].kind // "") as $k | [ .crds[]? | select((try ($k != "" and .kind == $k) catch false)) ]

restactions.filter:
.name as $n
| .namespace as $ns
# The matched composition ($d). `.found[]?` swallows a non-array `.found`; the inner `try`
# guards a `found` item whose `.metadata` is a scalar (error body / odd shape) so a malformed
# item is skipped rather than crashing the whole filter. `[0] // {}` → composition-not-found
# still yields an object.
| ([ .found[]? | select((try (.metadata.name == $n and .metadata.namespace == $ns) catch false)) ][0] // {}) as $d
| ($d.apiVersion // "") as $av
| ([ .crds[]? | select((try (.group == ($av | split("/")[0]) and .kind == $d.kind) catch false)) ][0] // {}) as $crd
# Form fields from the blueprint's values.schema.json (in the jsonschema CM), parsed to an object
# for the Form's `schema` (form.composition-edit reads .schemaSpec). Absent/malformed CM → empty
# schema (the form shows no fields rather than erroring). Field ORDER isn't preserved (the Form
# consumes the parsed object, not a stringSchema) — same as the prior CRD-derived schema.
# A 404/absent CM can hand back a non-object `.jsonschema` (error string) or a non-object `.data`;
# type-guard each hop so it degrades to null → {} instead of a "Cannot index string" crash (the
# path that was surfacing the generic "couldn't reach the server" widget error).
| (((.jsonschema // {}) | if type == "object" then .data else {} end) // {}) as $data
| ((if ($data | type) == "object" then $data["values.schema.json"] else null end) // null) as $raw
# fromjson yields Go json.Number for numeric literals (ports/replicas/min/max in every real
# blueprint schema) — snowplow's jqutil encoder has no `case json.Number` and PANICS ("invalid
# type: json.Number"), aborting the connection with no response (the Edit drawer's "Couldn't
# reach the server" / Failed to fetch). Coerce every number back to a plain gojq int/float with
# `walk(if type == "number" then . + 0 else . end)` — the `+ 0` forces gojq arithmetic, which
# emits a native number the encoder can serialize. INSIDE the try/catch so a missing/invalid
# schema still degrades to {} (no crash path reintroduced).
| (if $raw == null then {} else (try ($raw | fromjson | walk(if type == "number" then . + 0 else . end)) catch {}) end) as $parsed
# fromjson can yield valid-but-non-object JSON (a bare string/number) → coerce to {} so the
# `.properties` lookups below never index a scalar.
| (if ($parsed | type) == "object" then $parsed else {} end) as $schema
| ([ (($schema.properties) // {}) | (if type == "object" then to_entries[] else empty end) | select((.value.title // "") | test("should be hidden"; "i")) | .key ]) as $hidden
| {
    schemaSpec: $schema,
    values: (($d.spec // {}) | if type == "object" then . else {} end),
    propertiesToHide: $hidden,
    gvr: {
      apiVersion: $av,
      resource: ($crd.plural // ""),
      name: (($d.metadata // {} | if type == "object" then .name else null end) // $n),
      namespace: (($d.metadata // {} | if type == "object" then .namespace else null end) // $ns)
    }
  }

stages.name: crds

stages.name: found
stages.iterator: if (.namespace // "") == "" or (.name // "") == "" then [] else [ .crds | arrays | .[] | objects ] | unique_by([.version, .plural]) end
stages.filter: (.extras.name // "") as $n | (.extras.namespace // "") as $ns | [.found.items[]? | select(.metadata.name == $n and .metadata.namespace == $ns) | {name: .metadata.name, namespace: .metadata.namespace, uid: .metadata.uid, compositionId: (.metadata.labels["krateo.io/composition-id"] // .metadata.uid)}]

stages.name: getEvents
stages.iterator: [ select((.name // "") != "" and (.namespace // "") != "") | { path: (.name as $n | .namespace as $ns | ([(.found // empty) | .. | objects | select(.name? == $n and .namespace? == $ns)] | first | (.uid? // "") | tostring) as $uid | "/events?limit=200" + (if ($uid | test("^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$")) then "&composition_id=" + $uid else "" end)) } ]

stages.name: apiresources
stages.iterator: [ (.getEvents // empty) | .. | objects | select(has("involvedObject")) | (.involvedObject.apiVersion // "") | select(type == "string" and test("^[^/]+/[^/]+$")) ] | unique | map({gv: .})
stages.filter: [ .apiresources as $r | $r.resources[]? | select(((.name // "") | test("/")) | not) | {group: (($r.groupVersion // "") | split("/")[0]), kind: (.kind // ""), plural: (.name // "")} | select(.group != "" and .kind != "" and .plural != "") ]

restactions.filter:
(.name) as $n
| (.namespace) as $ns
| ([ .found[]? | select(.name == $n and .namespace == $ns) ][0].compositionId // "") as $cid
| ( .getEvents | if type == "array" then . elif type == "object" then (.resources // .items // []) else [] end ) as $all
# IA F7: (group,kind)->plural resolver. Built-in kinds (no CRD) from a small static
# k8s-scoping map ($builtin); every other kind from per-group discovery (.apiresources).
# Never a lowercase(kind)+"s" guess.
| ({"core|Pod":"pods","core|Service":"services","core|ConfigMap":"configmaps","core|Secret":"secrets","core|PersistentVolumeClaim":"persistentvolumeclaims","core|ServiceAccount":"serviceaccounts","core|Endpoints":"endpoints","core|Namespace":"namespaces","core|Node":"nodes","apps|Deployment":"deployments","apps|ReplicaSet":"replicasets","apps|StatefulSet":"statefulsets","apps|DaemonSet":"daemonsets","batch|Job":"jobs","batch|CronJob":"cronjobs","networking.k8s.io|Ingress":"ingresses","rbac.authorization.k8s.io|Role":"roles","rbac.authorization.k8s.io|RoleBinding":"rolebindings","rbac.authorization.k8s.io|ClusterRole":"clusterroles","rbac.authorization.k8s.io|ClusterRoleBinding":"clusterrolebindings"}) as $builtin
| ( [ (.apiresources // empty) | .. | objects | select(has("group") and has("kind") and has("plural")) | { key: (.group + "|" + .kind), value: .plural } ] | from_entries ) as $crdPlural
| {
    list: (if $cid == "" then []
           else ( [ $all[]?
                    | select((.compositionId // "") == $cid)
                    # Resolve the involvedObject's /resources deep-link (route) BEFORE
                    # reshaping. apiVersion → group/version (1 part ⇒ core group). plural
                    # from $builtin (core/apps/batch/...) or the real CRD registry; unknown
                    # ⇒ route "" (inert, nothing fabricated). ns from involvedObject.
                    | ((.involvedObject.apiVersion // "") | split("/")) as $gv
                    | (if ($gv | length) > 1 then $gv[0] else "core" end) as $grp
                    | (if ($gv | length) > 1 then $gv[1] else ($gv[0] // "v1") end) as $ver
                    | (.involvedObject.kind // "") as $ik
                    | ($builtin[$grp + "|" + $ik] // $crdPlural[$grp + "|" + $ik] // "") as $plural
                    | (.involvedObject.namespace // "") as $ins
                    | (.involvedObject.name // "") as $inm
                    # composition.krateo.io involved objects ARE compositions → drill into
                    # the first-class /compositions detail (mirrors composition-resources'
                    # navHref rule); every other kind → the generic /resources view.
                    | (if ($grp == "composition.krateo.io" and $inm != "" and $ins != "")
                       then ("/compositions/" + $ins + "/" + $inm)
                       elif ($plural != "" and $inm != "")
                       then ("/resources/" + (if $ins == "" then "cluster" else $ins end) + "/" + $grp + "/" + $ver + "/" + $plural + "/" + $inm)
                       else "" end) as $route
                    # conform to the EventList schema (type is enum Normal|Warning,
                    # required metadata/involvedObject/reason/message/type/source);
                    # `route` is an accepted extra field (mirrors the dashboard events RA).
                    | { metadata: (.metadata // {}),
                        involvedObject: (.involvedObject // {}),
                        reason: (.reason // ""),
                        message: (.message // ""),
                        type: (if (.type // "") == "Warning" then "Warning" else "Normal" end),
                        source: (.source // {}),
                        firstTimestamp: (.firstTimestamp // .eventTime),
                        lastTimestamp: (.lastTimestamp // .eventTime),
                        eventTime: (.eventTime),
                        route: $route } ]
                  | .[0:20] )
           end),
    compositionId: $cid,
    # Echo the target back (compositions-list idiom) so the events widget can build its
    # honest empty-state text ("check kubectl events -n <ns>") server-side.
    name: $n,
    namespace: $ns
  }

restactions.name: composition-incidents
restactions.filter:
(.name // "") as $n
| (.namespace // "") as $ns
| [ ((.incidents.items) // [])[]
    | (.status.state // "Analyzing") as $state
    # keep only incidents whose analysis touched this composition
    | ([ (.status.analyzedResources // [])[]
         | select((.gvr // "") | contains("composition"))
         | select((.name // "") == $n and (.namespace // "") == $ns) ] | first) as $comp
    | select($comp != null)
    | {
        title: (if (.status.rootCause.statement // "") != "" then .status.rootCause.statement
                else ((.metadata.labels // {})["observability.krateo.io/alert"] // .spec.alertRef.name // .metadata.name // "") end),
        state: $state,
        stateColor: ({ Open: "red", Verifying: "orange", Resolved: "green" }[$state] // "gray"),
        # the incident's own namespace; a namespaced list omits it per item, so fall back to the listed one
        route: ("/incidents/" + (.metadata.namespace // "default") + "/" + (.metadata.name // "")),
        when: (.spec.triggeredAt // .metadata.creationTimestamp // "")
      }
  ] | sort_by(.when) | reverse | { rows: . }

stages.name: crds
stages.filter: [.crds.items[]? | select(.status.resource != null and .status.apiVersion != null) | {plural: .status.resource, version: (.status.apiVersion | split("/")[1])}]

stages.name: found
stages.iterator: if (.namespace // "") == "" or (.name // "") == "" then [] else [ .crds | arrays | .[] | objects ] | unique_by([.version, .plural]) end
stages.filter:
(["clusterroles","clusterrolebindings","namespaces","customresourcedefinitions","clusterissuers","persistentvolumes","storageclasses","nodes","priorityclasses","validatingwebhookconfigurations","mutatingwebhookconfigurations","apiservices","certificatesigningrequests","podsecuritypolicies","ingressclasses","runtimeclasses","csidrivers","csinodes","volumeattachments"]) as $clusterKinds | (.extras.name // "") as $n | (.extras.namespace // "") as $ns | [ .found.items[]?
    | select(.metadata.name == $n and .metadata.namespace == $ns)
    | . as $comp
    | ($comp.metadata.name) as $cn
    | ($comp.metadata.namespace) as $cns
    | ($comp.status.managed // [])[]
    | . as $m
    | ($m.path | split("/")) as $p
    | ($p[-2]) as $res | ($p[-1]) as $nm | ($p[0:-2] | join("/")) as $pre
    | ($clusterKinds | index($res)) as $cluster
    # The parent's workload projection rides on every row (_wh/_whMsg): the final
    # aggregate folds it in, and this step filter is the only place that sees $comp.
    | { _cn: $cn, _cns: $cns, _kind: $res, _name: $nm,
        _wh: $comp.status.workloadHealthy, _whMsg: ($comp.status.healthMessage // ""),
        # Real group/version for the resource-view route ($p[1] = "api" for the core group
        # → group "core", version $p[2]; "apis" → group $p[2], version $p[3]) + cluster-scope.
        _grp: (if ($p[1] // "") == "apis" then ($p[2] // "") else "core" end),
        _ver: (if ($p[1] // "") == "apis" then ($p[3] // "v1") else ($p[2] // "v1") end),
        _cluster: ($cluster != null),
        # core-provider's .status.managed[].path now ALREADY carries /namespaces/<ns>/ for
        # namespaced kinds (verified live: /api/v1/namespaces/<ns>/serviceaccounts/<n>), so
        # inject it ONLY when absent — else the URL doubles the namespace segment → 404, and
        # the fetch-miss silently defaults the resource to healthy (issue #152). Idempotent
        # for both path shapes (old omitted-ns and new included-ns).
        _getpath: (if $cluster != null or ($m.path | contains("/namespaces/")) then $m.path
                   else ($pre + "/namespaces/" + $cns + "/" + $res + "/" + $nm) end) } ]

stages.name: resources
stages.iterator:
def fetchableCore: ["configmaps", "serviceaccounts", "services", "endpoints", "persistentvolumeclaims", "persistentvolumes", "pods", "namespaces", "nodes", "events", "limitranges", "resourcequotas", "replicationcontrollers", "podtemplates"];
def fetchablePath: (tostring | (split("?") | .[0] // "") | split("/")) as $p
  | if ($p[1] // "") == "apis" then true
    elif ($p[1] // "") == "api" then
      ((if ($p[3] // "") == "namespaces" then ($p[5] // "") else ($p[3] // "") end)) as $res
      | ($res == "" or (fetchableCore | index($res)) != null)
    else false end;
.name as $n | .namespace as $ns | [ .found[] | select(._cn == $n and ._cns == $ns) | select(._getpath | fetchablePath) ]
stages.filter:
[ (.resources // .)
  | select(type == "object" and (.kind // "") != "Status" and (.metadata.name // "") != "")
  | { rkind: (.kind // ""), rname: .metadata.name, rns: (.metadata.namespace // ""), conditions: (.status.conditions // []) } ]

restactions.filter:
def fetchableCore: ["configmaps", "serviceaccounts", "services", "endpoints", "persistentvolumeclaims", "persistentvolumes", "pods", "namespaces", "nodes", "events", "limitranges", "resourcequotas", "replicationcontrollers", "podtemplates"];
def fetchablePath: (tostring | (split("?") | .[0] // "") | split("/")) as $p
  | if ($p[1] // "") == "apis" then true
    elif ($p[1] // "") == "api" then
      ((if ($p[3] // "") == "namespaces" then ($p[5] // "") else ($p[3] // "") end)) as $res
      | ($res == "" or (fetchableCore | index($res)) != null)
    else false end;
(.name) as $n | (.namespace) as $ns
| ({"serviceaccounts":"ServiceAccount","configmaps":"ConfigMap","secrets":"Secret","services":"Service","endpoints":"Endpoints","persistentvolumeclaims":"PersistentVolumeClaim","deployments":"Deployment","replicasets":"ReplicaSet","statefulsets":"StatefulSet","daemonsets":"DaemonSet","pods":"Pod","jobs":"Job","cronjobs":"CronJob","clusterroles":"ClusterRole","clusterrolebindings":"ClusterRoleBinding","roles":"Role","rolebindings":"RoleBinding","ingresses":"Ingress","networkpolicies":"NetworkPolicy","namespaces":"Namespace"}) as $kindMap
| ( [ .found[]? | select(._cn == $n and ._cns == $ns) ] ) as $managed
| ( [ .resources ] | flatten | map(select(type == "object" and (.rname // "") != "")) ) as $fetched
| ( $managed | map(
      . as $m
      | ( [ $fetched[] | select(.rname == $m._name and ((.rns == $m._cns) or (.rns == ""))) ][0] ) as $obj
      | ($obj != null) as $found
      | (($obj.conditions) // []) as $c
      | ([ $c[]? | select(.type == "Ready" or .type == "Available") ][0]) as $rc
      | ($rc.status == "True") as $ready
      | ($rc.status == "False") as $notready
      | (any($c[]?; .type == "Synced" and .status == "False")) as $unsynced
      | (($c | length) == 0) as $noconds
      | ($m._getpath | fetchablePath) as $readable
      | {
          kind: ($kindMap[$m._kind] // (if (($obj.rkind) // "") != "" then $obj.rkind else (($m._kind | .[0:1] | ascii_upcase) + ($m._kind[1:] | sub("s$"; ""))) end)),
          name: $m._name,
          ns: $m._cns,
          # healthy-by-presence applies ONLY to a child we actually FETCHED (a conditionless kind
          # like ServiceAccount/ConfigMap that exists). A managed child we could NOT fetch
          # ($found=false — 404 / API error) is NOT healthy: report it "pending" (issue #152), so
          # it neither shows a green tag nor counts toward convergence.
          state: (if ($readable | not) then "unread"
                  elif ($found | not) then "pending"
                  elif $noconds then "healthy"
                  elif $ready and ($unsynced | not) then "healthy"
                  elif $ready and $unsynced then "drift"
                  elif $notready then "failed"
                  else "pending" end),
          healthPercent: (if ($readable | not) then 0
                          elif ($found | not) then 50
                          elif $noconds or ($ready and ($unsynced|not)) then 100
                          elif $ready and $unsynced then 70
                          elif $notready then 20 else 50 end),
          # IA F5 + F5-full: composition.krateo.io children drill into the first-class
          # /compositions detail; EVERY other kind drills into the generic /resources view
          # (namespaced → its ns; cluster-scoped → the "cluster" filler; core group → "core").
          # The last-mile is now closed for every managed child, whatever its kind.
          navHref: (if ($readable | not) then ""
                    elif ($m._grp == "composition.krateo.io")
                    then ("/compositions/" + $m._cns + "/" + $m._name)
                    else ("/resources/" + (if $m._cluster then "cluster" else $m._cns end) + "/" + $m._grp + "/" + $m._ver + "/" + $m._kind + "/" + $m._name) end)
        } )
  ) as $rows
| ($rows | map(select(.state != "unread"))) as $checked
| ($checked | length) as $total
| ($checked | map(select(.state == "healthy")) | length) as $healthy
# Workload projection of the COMPOSITION itself (ridden in on _wh/_whMsg): resources can
# all match declared-vs-actual while the pods behind them crashloop — `converged` must not
# claim full convergence then, and the rail widget caps/annotates from these two keys.
# ($managed[0] on an empty list is null → null._wh == false → false: safe when the comp
# declares no managed resources.)
| ($managed[0]._wh == false) as $whBad
| (if $whBad then ($managed[0]._whMsg // "") else "" end) as $whMsg
| {
    resources: $rows,
    total: $total,
    healthyCount: $healthy,
    unreadCount: (($rows | length) - $total),
    driftCount: ($rows | map(select(.state == "drift")) | length),
    failedCount: ($rows | map(select(.state == "failed")) | length),
    pendingCount: ($rows | map(select(.state == "pending")) | length),
    convergencePercent: (if $total > 0 then (($healthy * 100 / $total) | floor) else 0 end),
    converged: (($rows | length) > 0 and $healthy == $total and ($whBad | not)),
    workloadUnhealthy: $whBad,
    workloadMessage: $whMsg
  }

      # FAILED IS Synced=False ReconcileError, never Ready=False alone: core-provider and

      # CRD does not exist yet) for as long as they are still working.
      failed: ([ (.status.conditions // [])[] | select((.type // "") == "Synced") ] | first // {}
               | ((.status // "") == "False" and (.reason // "") == "ReconcileError")) } ]

    | select(("\(.compNs)/\(.compName)") as $k | $mine | index($k))
    | { apiVersion: .cfgApiVersion, plural: ((.cfgKind | ascii_downcase) + "s") } ]
| unique

[ .configs | objects

                 | select(type == "object"
                          and ((.name // "") | type == "string" and . != "")

restactions.filter:
def ending($pr):
  if $pr == null then ""
  elif (($pr.merged) // false) == true then "merged"
  elif ((($pr.state) // "") != "closed") then ""
  elif ((($pr.mergedKnown) // false) | not) then "closed?"
  else "closed" end;
# Register (create the CompositionDefinition) is offered exactly when the blueprint RA offers
# Install, for the same reasons: the definitions could be read, the publish carries its root
# registration file, none exists yet, and the change request ended in a merge (or closed
# while the provider cannot say whether it merged).
((.cdsError // null) == null) as $cdsRead
| ((.configsError // null) == null) as $configsRead
| def registerable($cd; $end; $hasReg): $cdsRead and $hasReg and $cd == null and ($end == "merged" or $end == "closed?");
(.cds // []) as $cds
| (.prs // []) as $prs
| (.installs // []) as $installs
| (.restdefs // []) as $rds
| ((.installsError // null) == null) as $installsRead
# The Configurations of a RestDefinition's configuration kind (the list is attributed by its
# apiVersion and its lower-cased kind or plural), and whether one of them names a Secret.
# NAMES, NOT EXISTS: whether that Secret exists is not read here — no RESTAction reads Secrets
# (see the configs step) — so the row says which Secret it relies on, unverified, and the first
# reconcile is still where a missing one shows.
| ((.configs // []) | if type == "array" then . else [] end) as $configs
| def configsOf($rd): ($rd.cfgKind | ascii_downcase) as $k
    | [ $configs[] | select(.apiVersion == $rd.cfgApiVersion and (.list == $k or .list == ($k + "s"))) ];
def configured($rd): any(configsOf($rd)[]; ((.secrets // []) | length) > 0);
([ (.publishes // []) | group_by(.publish)[]
     | select((.[0].publish // "") != "")
     | .[0] as $p0
     | ($p0.publish | sub("^publish-"; "")) as $chart
     | ( [ $cds[] | select(.name == $chart) ] | first ) as $cd
     | (all(.[]; .synced == "True")) as $pushed
     | (any(.[]; .syncReason == "ReconcileError")) as $failed
     | (any(.[]; .reg == true)) as $hasReg
     | ( [ $prs[] | select(((.publish) // "") == ($p0.publish // "")) ] | first ) as $pr
     | ending($pr) as $end
     # The install claims of this controller, and the RestDefinitions each one rendered.
     | ( if $cd == null then []
         else [ $installs[] | select(.cd == $cd.name and (.cdNs == "" or .cdNs == $cd.namespace)) ] end ) as $ins
     | ( [ $ins[] as $i | $rds[]
           | select(.compName == $i.name and .compNs == $i.namespace and (.compKind == "" or .compKind == $cd.kind)) ] ) as $mine
     | (($mine | length) > 0 and all($mine[]; .ready == "True")) as $allReady
     | (any($mine[]; .failed) or any($ins[]; .failed) or ($cd != null and $cd.failed)) as $broken
     # Install is offered only when the install claims could be READ: a denied list is not
     # evidence that there is none (as $cdsRead gates Register).
     | ($installsRead and $cd != null and $cd.ready == "True" and ($ins | length) == 0) as $installable
     # A Ready RestDefinition whose API needs credentials and whose <Kind>Configuration does
     # not exist yet. Only when the configurations could be read: an unread list is not
     # evidence that there are none.
     | ( [ $mine[] | select(.ready == "True" and .auth and .cfgKind != "")
           | select(configured(.) | not) ] ) as $unconfigured
     | ($configsRead and ($unconfigured | length) > 0) as $needsCreds
     # The evidence, in the row: what is missing for the first such kind, or which Secret each
     # credentialed kind relies on once every one names one.
     | ( if $needsCreds then
           ($unconfigured[0]) as $u | configsOf($u) as $cs
           | (if ($cs | length) == 0 then ("no " + $u.cfgKind + " exists yet")
              else ($u.cfgKind + " " + $cs[0].namespace + "/" + $cs[0].name + " names no Secret") end)
           + (if ($unconfigured | length) > 1 then " (+\(($unconfigured | length) - 1) more)" else "" end)
         elif ($configsRead and $allReady) then
           ([ $mine[] | select(.ready == "True" and .auth and .cfgKind != "") | configsOf(.)[] | .secrets[] ] | unique) as $named
           | (if ($named | length) == 0 then ""
              elif ($named | length) == 1 then ("credentials configured (Secret " + $named[0] + " not verified)")
              else ("credentials configured (Secrets " + ($named | join(", ")) + " not verified)") end)
         else "" end ) as $credNote
     | ([ $mine[] | select(.genKind != "") | .genKind + " · " + .genApiVersion ] | unique) as $gvks
     | { chart: $chart,
         title: (($pr.title) // ""),
         pr: (if (($pr.number) // 0) > 0 then ("#" + ($pr.number | tostring)) else ($p0.branch // "") end),
         url: (($pr.url) // ""),
         version: (if $cd != null then ("v" + ($cd.version // "?")) else "—" end),
         status: (if $broken then "Failed"
                  # Not Ready while a credentialed kind has no Configuration naming a Secret:
                  # it would fail at its first reconcile, not here.
                  elif ($allReady and $needsCreds) then "Configure credentials"
                  elif $allReady then "Ready"
                  # Installed while its RestDefinitions are still being created.
                  elif ($ins | length) > 0 then "Installed"
                  elif ($cd != null and $cd.ready == "True") then "Registered"
                  # Any other state of a definition that exists — Creating, Unavailable while
                  # its CRD is generated, no condition yet — is progress.
                  elif ($cd != null) then "Registering"
                  elif $end == "merged" then "Merged"
                  elif ($end == "closed" or $end == "closed?") then "Closed"
                  elif ($pr != null and (($pr.number) // 0) > 0) then "Change request open"
                  elif $pushed then "Pushed"
                  elif $failed then "Publish failed" else "Publishing" end),
         statusColor: (if $broken then "red"
                       elif ($allReady and $needsCreds) then "orange"
                       elif $allReady then "green"
                       elif (($ins | length) == 0 and $cd != null and $cd.ready == "True") then "green"
                       elif ($cd == null and $end == "merged") then "green"
                       elif ($cd == null and ($end == "closed" or $end == "closed?")) then "gray"
                       elif ($cd == null and $failed and ($pr == null)) then "red"
                       else "orange" end),
         # The person's next step, when there is one; empty otherwise (exception-only).
         next: (if registerable($cd; $end; $hasReg) then (if $end == "merged" then "Register" else "Register if merged" end)
                elif $installable then "Install"
                elif ($allReady and $needsCreds) then "Configure credentials"
                else "" end),
         # The credential evidence (the Next step cell shows it beside the step).
         nextNote: $credNote,
         # The generated kinds: the first, and how many more.
         gvk: (if ($gvks | length) == 0 then "—"
               elif ($gvks | length) == 1 then $gvks[0]
               else "\($gvks[0]) +\(($gvks | length) - 1)" end),
         ns: "default",
         # Per-row destination, the Table takes it whole. The step the Next cell names first;
         # then the install, once there is one; then the change request; else nothing.
         rowHref: (if registerable($cd; $end; $hasReg) then ("/marketplace/" + $chart + "/install")
                   elif $installable then ("/blueprints/" + $cd.namespace + "/" + $chart + "/new")
                   elif ($allReady and $needsCreds) then ("/controller-builder/configure/" + $unconfigured[0].namespace + "/" + $unconfigured[0].name)
                   elif ($ins | length) > 0 then ("/compositions/" + $ins[0].namespace + "/" + $ins[0].name)
                   elif $cd != null then ("/blueprints/" + $cd.namespace + "/" + $chart)
                   else (($pr.url) // "") end),
         # The merge date (portal.builderPrMergedAt), only when the change request merged.
         mergedAt: (if $end == "merged" then (($pr.mergedAt) // "") else "" end),
         age: ($p0.created // "") } ]) as $claimRows
| ($claimRows | sort_by(.age // "") | reverse) as $rows
| { rows: $rows,
    counts: { total: ($rows | length),
              ready: ([ $rows[] | select(.status == "Ready") ] | length) } }

restactions.name: controller-configure-formdef

stages.name: crd
stages.iterator:
[ .rd | objects | ((.status.configuration // {}) | if type == "object" then . else {} end)
  | { kind: (.kind // ""), group: (((.apiVersion // "") | split("/"))[0] // "") }
  | select(.kind != "" and .group != "")
  | { name: ((.kind | ascii_downcase) + "s." + .group) } ]

restactions.filter:
(.rd | if type == "object" then . else null end) as $rd
| (($rd.status.configuration // {}) | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $cfg
| (($cfg.apiVersion // "") | tostring) as $cfgApi
| (($cfg.kind // "") | tostring) as $cfgKind
| ($cfgApi | split("/")) as $gv
| ([ (.crd.spec.versions // [])[]? | select(.name == ($gv[1] // "")) ] | first // null) as $v
| def secretField($title; $desc): { type: "string", title: $title, description: $desc };
if $rd == null or $cfgKind == "" or ($gv | length) != 2 or $v == null then
  # NOTHING TO CONFIGURE (yet): no RestDefinition named, it declares no security scheme, or its
  # Configuration CRD is not served yet. A form with no fields that says which, never a failed
  # resolve — and no write target, so nothing can be submitted.
  { stringSchema: "",
    schemaSpec: { type: "object",
                  title: (if $rd == null then "No controller kind selected"
                          elif $cfgKind == "" then "This kind needs no credentials"
                          else "This kind's configuration is still being generated" end),
                  description: (if $rd == null then "Open this page from a row on the Controller Builder."
                                elif $cfgKind == "" then "Its API declares no security scheme, so there is nothing to configure."
                                else "oasgen has not served the " + $cfgKind + " kind yet. This usually takes under a minute — reload the page." end) },
    initialValues: {},
    ready: false,
    namespace: "", rdName: "", kind: "", apiVersion: "", plural: "", specKeys: [], refPaths: [], secretName: "" }
else
  ($rd.metadata.namespace // "") as $ns
  | ($rd.metadata.name // "") as $rdName
  | (($v.schema.openAPIV3Schema.properties.spec // {}) | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $spec
  # The Secret references the Configuration declares: every *Ref object under one scheme of
  # spec.authentication (bearer.tokenRef on every kind krateo-057 generates). The FIRST
  # scheme's are the ones this form fills — each points at the Secret it writes, by the name
  # and key typed below — so they are DERIVED, not shown: a ref's own name/key/namespace
  # fields would be the Secret's name and key a second time, and could disagree with it.
  # Other schemes are left in the form, untouched.
  # OUT OF SCOPE: a scheme with two references (basic: usernameRef + passwordRef). Both are
  # pointed at the one Secret AND the one key this form writes; such a kind needs its
  # Configuration edited after saving. Every Configuration CRD on 057 is bearer.tokenRef.
  # Also left out of the form: a spec field whose key is not an identifier (it cannot be a
  # plain .json.<key> path) — none exists on 057.
  # In key order, explicitly: jq keeps a map's insertion order and gojq sorts it, so without
  # the sort "the first scheme" would depend on which one runs this.
  | ([ (($spec.properties.authentication.properties // {}) | to_entries | sort_by(.key))[]
       | .key as $scheme
       | (((.value.properties // {}) | to_entries | sort_by(.key))[] | select(.key | endswith("Ref")) | { scheme: $scheme, ref: .key }) ]) as $allRefs
  | ([ $allRefs[] | select(.scheme == ($allRefs[0].scheme // "")) ]) as $refs
  # The spec the person sees: the first scheme's refs removed, then any object left with no
  # fields (that scheme, then authentication itself) — on every 057 kind, nothing is left.
  | (reduce $refs[] as $r ($spec; del(.properties.authentication.properties[$r.scheme].properties[$r.ref])
                                  | .properties.authentication.properties[$r.scheme].required
                                      = (((.properties.authentication.properties[$r.scheme].required // []) - [$r.ref]))))
    as $trimmed
  | ($trimmed
     | (if ($refs | length) > 0 and (((.properties.authentication.properties[$refs[0].scheme].properties // {}) | length) == 0)
        then del(.properties.authentication.properties[$refs[0].scheme])
             | .properties.authentication.required = (((.properties.authentication.required // []) - [$refs[0].scheme]))
        else . end)
     | (if (.properties.authentication != null) and (((.properties.authentication.properties // {}) | length) == 0)
        then del(.properties.authentication) else . end)) as $display
  # Only identifier keys: the Form's spec override names each one as a plain path
  # (.json.<key>), the only form frontend#424 evaluates without the /jq round-trip.
  | ([ ($display.properties // {}) | keys[] | select(test("^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$")) ]) as $specKeys
  | ($rdName + "-credentials") as $secretName
  | (if ($refs | length) > 0 then ($refs[0].ref | sub("Ref$"; "")) else "token" end) as $secretKey
  | ([ ("__configuration_name__" | tojson) + ":" + ({ type: "string", title: "Configuration name",
         description: ("The " + $cfgKind + " to create in " + $ns + ". A resource of this kind names it in spec.configurationRef.") } | tojson) ]
     + [ ($display.properties // {}) | to_entries | sort_by(.key) | .[] | select(.key as $k | $specKeys | index($k)) | (.key | tojson) + ":" + (.value | tojson) ]
     + [ ("__secret_name__" | tojson) + ":" + (secretField("Secret name"; ("The Secret created in " + $ns + " to hold the credential. The " + $cfgKind + " points at it.")) | tojson),
         ("__secret_key__" | tojson) + ":" + (secretField("Secret key"; "The key the credential is stored under in that Secret.") | tojson),
         ("__secret_value__" | tojson) + ":" + (secretField("Credential"; "The token or password itself. Sent once, to the cluster, when you save; it is never shown again.")
                                                + { format: "password", writeOnly: true } | tojson) ]) as $props
  | (["__configuration_name__"] + [ ($display.required // [])[] | select(. as $k | $specKeys | index($k)) ]
     + ["__secret_name__", "__secret_key__", "__secret_value__"] | unique) as $required
  | { stringSchema: ("{\"type\":\"object\",\"properties\":{" + ($props | join(",")) + "},\"required\":" + ($required | tojson) + "}"),
      schemaSpec: ($display | .type = "object"
                   | .properties = (((.properties // {}) | with_entries(select(.key as $k | $specKeys | index($k))))
                                    + { __configuration_name__: { type: "string", title: "Configuration name" },
                                        __secret_name__: secretField("Secret name"; ""),
                                        __secret_key__: secretField("Secret key"; ""),
                                        __secret_value__: (secretField("Credential"; "") + { format: "password", writeOnly: true }) })
                   | .required = $required),
      initialValues: { __configuration_name__: $rdName, __secret_name__: $secretName, __secret_key__: $secretKey },
      ready: true,
      namespace: $ns, rdName: $rdName, kind: $cfgKind, apiVersion: $cfgApi,
      plural: (($cfgKind | ascii_downcase) + "s"), specKeys: $specKeys,
      # Where the Secret's name and key land in the Configuration: spec.authentication.<scheme>.<ref>.
      refPaths: [ $refs[] | "spec.authentication.\(.scheme).\(.ref)" ],
      secretName: $secretName }
end

restactions.name: controller-render-draft

stages.name: draft
stages.iterator: [ { namespace: ((.namespace // "") | tostring), name: ((.name // "") | tostring) } | select(.namespace != "" and .name != "") ]

stages.name: render
stages.iterator: [ select(((try (.draft.data["draft.json"] | fromjson) catch null) | if type == "object" then ((((.restDefinitions // null) | type) == "array" and (.restDefinitions | length) > 0) and ((.oas // null) | type) == "object") else false end)) ]

restactions.filter:
def errtext: if type == "array" then (map(errtext) | join("; "))
             elif type == "object" then ((.message // .error // tojson) | tostring)
             else tostring end;
def finding: ((.restDefinition // "") | tostring) as $rd | ((.field // "") | tostring) as $f
             | ([ $rd, $f ] | map(select(. != "")) | join(" ")) as $at
             | (if $at != "" then $at + ": " else "" end) + ((.message // "") | tostring);
def arr: if type == "array" then . else [] end;
(((.namespace // "") != "") and ((.name // "") != "")) as $named
| ((try (.draft.data["draft.json"] | fromjson) catch null) // null) as $draft
| (if ($named | not) then "no draft named — provide the ConfigMap's namespace and name"
   elif (.draftError != null) then ("the controller draft could not be read: " + (.draftError | errtext))
   elif ($draft | type) != "object" then "the draft ConfigMap holds no controller draft (data[\"draft.json\"])"
   elif ((($draft.restDefinitions // null) | type) != "array") or (($draft.restDefinitions | length) == 0) then "the controller draft has no RestDefinition (data[\"draft.json\"].restDefinitions)"
   elif (($draft.oas // null) | type) != "object" then "the controller draft has no OAS documents (data[\"draft.json\"].oas)"
   else "" end) as $argErr
| (.render // null) as $r
| (if $argErr != "" then ""
   elif (.renderError != null) then
     ((.renderError | errtext) as $e
      | if ($e | test("413|too large"; "i")) then "the controller draft is too large for oasgen-render: " + $e
        else "Controller preview needs oasgen-render (oasgen-provider ≥0.25.0 with render.enabled): " + $e end)
   elif ($r | type) != "object" or (($r.crds // null) | type) != "array" then
     "Controller preview needs oasgen-render (oasgen-provider ≥0.25.0 with render.enabled): the render service gave no CRDs"
   else "" end) as $svcErr
| (if $argErr != "" or $svcErr != "" then {} else $r end) as $ok
| ($ok.crds // [] | arr) as $crds
| ($ok.configurationCrds // [] | arr) as $confs
| ($ok.errors // [] | arr | map(select(type == "object"))) as $errors
| ($ok.skippedSecuritySchemes // [] | arr | map(select(type == "object"))) as $skipped
| ([ $argErr, $svcErr ] | map(select(. != ""))
   + [ $errors[] | select((.severity // "error") != "warning") | finding ]) as $problems
| ([ $errors[] | select(.severity == "warning") | finding ]
   + [ $skipped[] | (((.restDefinition // "") | tostring) + ": security scheme not supported, skipped: " + ((.scheme // "") | tostring)) ]) as $warnings
| ([ ($crds + $confs)[] | select(type == "object")
     | { apiVersion: (.apiVersion // "apiextensions.k8s.io/v1"),
         kind: (.kind // "CustomResourceDefinition"),
         name: (.metadata.name // ""),
         namespace: "",
         yaml: tojson } ]) as $objects
| { objects: (if ($problems | length) > 0 then [] else $objects end),
    problems: $problems,
    warnings: $warnings,
    crds: $crds,
    configurationCrds: $confs,
    errors: $errors,
    skipped: $skipped }
  + (if ($problems | length) > 0 then { error: ($problems | join("; ")) } else {} end)
