restactions.filter:
# fromdateiso8601 takes `...SSZ` only: drop a fractional part and fold a +00:00 offset to Z.
def epoch: (if type == "string" then (sub("\\.[0-9]+"; "") | sub("(\\+00:?00)$"; "Z")) else "" end) | (fromdateiso8601? // null);
# An absolute time, never one relative to now: the page is cached until the incident changes, and
# an Incident that does not change is not written, so "2m ago" would stay "2m ago".
def stamp: (. // "") as $s | ($s | epoch) as $t
  | if $t == null then ($s | tostring | .[0:10]) else ($t | strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC")) end;
def clean: gsub("[^ -~]"; "") | sub("^ +"; "") | sub(" +$"; "");
def alertlabel: ((.metadata.labels // {})["observability.krateo.io/alert"] // .spec.alertRef.name // "");
def when: (.spec.triggeredAt // .metadata.creationTimestamp // "");
def isnum: (type == "number");
# A result's outcome in words; exit is absent for a timeout, a pod that never ran, and a hand-run apply.
def outcome: (.script // "") as $sc | (.exit // null) as $x
  | if $sc == "apply" then (if ($x | isnum) | not then "applied by hand" elif $x == 0 then "applied" else "apply failed" end)
    elif ($x | isnum) | not then "unknown: timed out or never ran"
    elif $x == 0 then (if $sc == "verify" then "fixed" else "gone" end)
    elif $x == 1 then "still holds"
    else "unknown" end;
def fence: (if test("```") then "````" else "```" end);
# One payload leaf as Markdown: a merge patch's `null` removes the key; long values are cut.
def leafval: if . == null then "removed" else (if type == "string" then . else tojson end) | gsub("`"; "'") | (if length > 80 then (.[0:80] + "…") else . end) | ("`" + . + "`") end;
def leaves($p): if type == "object" and length > 0 then to_entries[] | .key as $k | .value | leaves($p + [$k]) else { path: ($p | map(tostring) | join(".")), value: . } end;
(.name // "") as $n
| (.namespace // "default") as $ns
| ((.incident // {}) | if type == "object" and ((.metadata.name // "") != "") then . else {} end) as $r
| (($r | length) > 0) as $exists
| ($r.spec // {}) as $sp
| ($r.status // {}) as $st
| ($r | alertlabel) as $alertName
| ($sp.alertRef.namespace // $ns) as $alertNs
| ((.alert // {}) | if type == "object" and ((.metadata.name // "") != "") and (.metadata.name == $alertName) then . else null end) as $alert
| ($st.state // "Analyzing") as $state
| ([ ($st.conditions // [])[] | select(.type == "Reproduced" and .status == "False") ] | length > 0) as $flagged
| ($st.rootCause // {}) as $rc
| ($st.sources // []) as $sources
| ($st.analyzedResources // []) as $analyzed
| ($st.missingContext // []) as $gaps
| ($st.assumptions // []) as $assump
| (($st.reasoningTrace // []) | sort_by(.step // 0)) as $trace
| ($st.howToFix // {}) as $fix
# status.lastChecks: the latest result of each script, {exit, since}, tagged with its script for outcome.
| ($st.lastChecks // {}) as $lc
| (["precondition", "apply", "verify"] | map(. as $k | ($lc[$k] // null) | if . == null then null else . + { script: $k } end)) as $lastResults
| ($st.error // "") as $err
| ($st.report // "") as $rpt
# status.howToFix.applyAction: the fix as ONE Kubernetes API write (alert-provider >= 0.2.45). Actionable
# only with a known verb, a target, and a payload object unless it deletes; the verb maps to the
# HTTP method the portal's Apply sends it with, as the signed-in user.
| ($fix.applyAction // null) as $aa
| (if ($aa | type) == "object" then ({ patch: "PATCH", create: "POST", post: "POST", put: "PUT", delete: "DELETE" }[(($aa.verb // "") | ascii_downcase)] // null) else null end) as $aaVerb
| ($aaVerb != null and ($aa.apiVersion // "") != "" and ($aa.resource // "") != "" and ($aa.name // "") != ""
   and ($aaVerb == "DELETE" or (($aa.payload // null) | type) == "object")) as $aaOk
| ([ ($fix.precondition // ""), ($fix.apply // ""), ($fix.verify // "") ] | any(. != "") or $aaOk) as $hasFix
| ((($analyzed | length) > 0) or (($sources | length) > 0) or (($trace | length) > 0) or (($rc.statement // "") != "") or $hasFix) as $structured
| ([ $analyzed[] | select((.gvr // "") | contains("composition")) ] | first) as $comp
| ((if $alert then ($alert.spec.displayName // "") else "" end) | clean) as $alertDisplay
| (if $alertDisplay != "" then $alertDisplay elif ($rc.statement // "") != "" then $rc.statement elif $alertName != "" then $alertName else $n end) as $title
| ((.incidents.items) // [] | map(. + { metadata: (.metadata + { namespace: (.metadata.namespace // $ns) }) })) as $all
| ([ $all[] | select(alertlabel == $alertName and $alertName != "") ] | sort_by([when, .metadata.name])) as $siblings
| (($siblings | map(.metadata.name) | index($n)) // null) as $ordinal
| ($sp.applied // false) as $appliedPending
# Apply sends applyAction; "I applied it" stays for an incident whose fix is only a script.
| ($state == "Open" and $aaOk and ($appliedPending | not)) as $canApplyAction
| ($state == "Open" and ($fix.apply // "") != "" and ($appliedPending | not) and ($aaOk | not)) as $canApply
# Run apply: this incident's IncidentApplies, newest first. A list that did not come back (no CRD, a 403) is no list.
| (.incidentApplies | type == "object" and (((.items // null) | type) == "array" or ((.kind // "") | endswith("List")))) as $runsOk
| ([ (if $runsOk then (.incidentApplies.items // []) else [] end)[] | select((.spec.incidentRef.name // "") == $n and $n != "") ]
   | map(. + { _when: (.status.startedAt // .metadata.creationTimestamp // "") }) | sort_by([._when, .metadata.name]) | reverse) as $runs
# A run the controller has not finished: no phase yet, or Running. It rejects a second one, so Run apply hides.
| ([ $runs[] | select((.status.phase // "") == "" or .status.phase == "Running") ] | first) as $runActive
| ($canApply and $runsOk and $runActive == null) as $canRunApply
# The newest run, when it Failed or was Rejected after the last recorded apply: the step's last run names it.
| (($runs | first) as $r0
   | if $r0 != null and (($r0.status.phase // "") | IN("Failed", "Rejected"))
        and ((($lastResults[1].since // "") | epoch) // 0) < (($r0._when | epoch) // 0)
     then $r0 else null end) as $runMissed
# What Apply writes, in words: the verb, the object and, for a patch, each field it sets.
| (if $aaOk then
    ("`" + $aa.resource + "/" + $aa.name + "`" + (if ($aa.namespace // "") != "" then (" in `" + $aa.namespace + "`") else " (cluster-scoped)" end)) as $obj
    | ({ PATCH: "update", PUT: "replace", POST: "create", DELETE: "delete" }[$aaVerb]) as $word
    | (if $aaVerb == "PATCH" then [ $aa.payload | leaves([]) | select(.path != "") ] else [] end) as $lv
    | "**" + $word + "** " + $obj
      + (if ($lv | length) > 0 then (", setting " + ($lv | map("`" + .path + "` to " + (.value | leafval)) | join(", "))) else "" end)
  else "" end) as $applyWrite
| $lastResults[0] as $lastPre
| $lastResults[1] as $lastApply
| $lastResults[2] as $lastVerify
# A flagged precondition no longer runs, so it is neither a pass nor a failure.
| (if $flagged then "wait"
   elif ($lastPre.exit // null) == 1 then "error"
   elif ($lastPre.exit // null) == 0 then "finish"
   elif $state == "Open" then "process" else "wait" end) as $preStatus
| (if $canApply or $canApplyAction or ($state == "Open" and $appliedPending) then "process" elif $lastApply != null then "finish" else "wait" end) as $applyStatus
| (if $state == "Verifying" then "process"
   elif ($lastVerify.exit // null) == 0 then "finish"
   elif ($lastVerify.exit // null) == 1 then "error" else "wait" end) as $verifyStatus
| (if $state == "Verifying" or $state == "Resolved" then 2 elif $state == "Open" then 1 else 0 end) as $fixCurrent
# "exit 1 · still holds · since 2026-10-09 09:47 UTC": a check that keeps giving the same result keeps
# its since. An apply result is one run, so it reads "at".
| ($lastResults | map(if . == null then null else
    ((if (.exit // null) | isnum then ("exit " + (.exit | tostring) + " · ") else "" end) + outcome
     + (if .script == "apply" then " · at " else " · since " end) + (.since | stamp)) end)) as $lastLines
| ([ { key: "precondition", title: "Precondition", status: $preStatus, last: $lastLines[0],
       lead: "Does the incident still hold? The controller runs this every minute in a read-only sandbox while the incident is Open: exit **1** means it holds, **0** that it is gone.",
       note: (if $flagged then "\n\n**Flagged.** Its first run exited 0: this script cannot see the problem, so a 0 from it is no evidence of a fix. It no longer runs. Apply the fix, or close the incident." else "" end) },
     { key: "apply", title: "Review & apply", status: $applyStatus,
       last: (if $appliedPending then "applied, waiting for the controller to verify"
              elif $runActive != null then ("Run apply in progress, as " + ($runActive.spec.requestedBy.username // "you") + " · " + ($runActive._when | stamp))
              elif $runMissed != null then ("Run apply " + ($runMissed.status.phase | ascii_downcase)
                + (if ($runMissed.status.exitCode // null) | isnum then (" · exit " + ($runMissed.status.exitCode | tostring)) else "" end)
                + " · " + ($runMissed._when | stamp) + " · see Apply runs")
              else $lastLines[1] end),
       lead: (if $aaOk then ("The fix is one Kubernetes API write: " + $applyWrite + ". **Apply** sends it as you, after a confirmation that shows the exact request, then marks this incident applied: the controller then runs the verify script.")
              elif $runsOk then "The fix. Read it, then click **Run apply**: the controller runs it with your Kubernetes permissions and, when it exits 0, runs the verify script. Its output is under **Apply runs**. Or run it in your own terminal and click **I applied it**."
              else "The fix. Read it, run it in your own terminal, then click **I applied it**: the controller then runs the verify script." end),
       note: "" },
     { key: "verify", title: "Verify", status: $verifyStatus, last: $lastLines[2],
       lead: "Did the fix work? The controller runs this in the read-only sandbox once the precondition exits 0 or the fix is marked applied, retrying for about 5 minutes: exit **0** means fixed, **1** that it still holds.",
       note: "" } ]
   # Rollback, only when the analysis wrote one: a human runs it to revert an applied fix. No check records it and it moves no state, so it has no last run.
   + (if ($fix.rollback // "") != "" then [
     { key: "rollback", title: "Rollback", status: "wait", last: null,
       lead: "Undoes apply. Run it only to revert an applied fix, in your own terminal. The controller never runs it, and running it leaves this incident's state as it is.",
       note: "" } ] else [] end)
   | to_entries | map(.key as $i | .value as $s
     | (($fix[$s.key] // "") | rtrimstr("\n")) as $script
     | $s + {
         i: $i,
         eyebrow: (if $s.key == "rollback" then "optional" else ("step " + (($i + 1) | tostring)) end),
         md: ($s.lead
           + (if $s.key == "rollback" then "" else ("\n\n**Last run:** " + ($s.last // (if $s.key == "apply" then "not applied yet" else "never" end))) end)
           + $s.note
           + (if $script != "" then ("\n\n" + ($script | fence) + "bash\n" + $script + "\n" + ($script | fence)) else "\n\n_No " + $s.key + " script._" end)) })) as $fixSteps
# Apply runs: a row per Run apply click, then each run's message, output and, when it is not the apply step's, script.
| ($runs | map({
    when: ._when,
    who: (.spec.requestedBy.username // "—"),
    phase: (.status.phase // "Pending"),
    exit: (if (.status.exitCode // null) | isnum then (.status.exitCode | tostring) else "—" end),
    message: (.status.message // ""),
    color: ({ Succeeded: "#389e0d", Failed: "#cf1322", Rejected: "#d46b08", Running: "#1677ff" }[.status.phase // ""] // "#8c8c8c") })) as $runRows
| ((($fix.apply // "") | rtrimstr("\n")) as $applyScript
   | $runs[0:10] | map(
    (.status // {}) as $rs
    | (($rs.output // "") | rtrimstr("\n")) as $out
    | (($rs.script // "") | rtrimstr("\n")) as $rsc
    | "#### " + ($rs.phase // "Pending")
      + (if ($rs.exitCode // null) | isnum then (" · exit " + ($rs.exitCode | tostring)) else "" end)
      + " · " + (.spec.requestedBy.username // "unknown user") + " · " + (._when | stamp)
      + (if ($rs.message // "") != "" then ("\n\n" + $rs.message)
         elif ($rs.phase // "") == "" then "\n\n_Waiting for the controller to start it._"
         elif $rs.phase == "Running" then "\n\n_Running._" else "" end)
      + (if $out != "" then ("\n\n**Output** (up to its last 4 KiB):\n\n" + ($out | fence) + "text\n" + $out + "\n" + ($out | fence)) else "" end)
      + (if $rsc != "" and $rsc != $applyScript then ("\n\n**Script** (not the apply step's current one):\n\n" + ($rsc | fence) + "bash\n" + $rsc + "\n" + ($rsc | fence)) else "" end))
   | join("\n\n")
   + (if ($runs | length) > 10 then "\n\n_The 10 most recent runs; the table lists all of them._" else "" end)) as $runsMd
| ([ $all[] | select(.metadata.name != $n) ]) as $others
| ( ([ $others[] | select($alertName != "" and alertlabel == $alertName) ] | sort_by(when) | reverse | map(. + { _why: "same alert" }))
  + (if ($rc.category // "") != "" then
      ([ $others[] | select(alertlabel != $alertName and (.status.rootCause.category // "") == $rc.category) ] | sort_by(when) | reverse | map(. + { _why: ("same category · " + $rc.category) }))
    else [] end)
  | .[0:6]
  | map({ name: .metadata.name, namespace: .metadata.namespace,
          title: (if (.status.rootCause.statement // "") != "" then .status.rootCause.statement else alertlabel end),
          state: (.status.state // "Analyzing"),
          reason: ._why,
          when: when }) ) as $similar
| ([ (if ($r | length) > 0 then $r else empty end), (if $alert != null then $alert else empty end) ] | map(del(.metadata.managedFields))) as $involvedObjs
| {
    title: $title,
    state: $state,
    flagged: $flagged,
    headerTags: (if ($exists | not) then [ { label: "Not found", color: "gray" } ] else [ { label: $state, color: ({ Analyzing: "gray", Open: "red", Verifying: "orange", Resolved: "green", Closed: "gray" }[$state] // "gray") } ]
      + (if $flagged then [ { label: "Flagged", color: "orange" } ] else [] end) end),
    # The alert chip under the title: a link to the exact alert, its live state, how long it has been OK, and this incident's number among the alert's incidents.
    alertName: (if $alertDisplay != "" then $alertDisplay else $alertName end),
    alertRoute: (if $alert != null then ("/alerts/" + $alertNs + "/" + $alertName) else "" end),
    alertStateLabel: (if $alert == null then (if $alertName != "" then "not found" else "" end) else ($alert.status.state // "PENDING") end),
    alertStateColor: (if $alert == null then "gray" else ({ OK: "green", ALERT: "red", PENDING: "orange" }[$alert.status.state // "PENDING"] // "gray") end),
    alertOkFor: (if $alert != null and ($alert.status.state // "") == "OK" and ($alert.status.okSince // "") != "" then ("since " + ($alert.status.okSince | stamp)) else "" end),
    ordinalLabel: (if $ordinal != null then ("#" + (($ordinal + 1) | tostring) + " of this alert") else "" end),
    ref: (if $comp then ((($comp.gvr // "") | split("/") | last) + "/" + ($comp.name // "") + " · " + ($comp.namespace // "")) else "—" end),
    refRoute: (if $comp then ("/compositions/" + ($comp.namespace // "") + "/" + ($comp.name // "")) else "" end),
    diagnoseHref: ("/incidents/" + $ns + "/" + $n + "?ask="
      + (("Diagnose this incident (\"" + $n + "\" in namespace \"" + $ns
         + "\"). Explain what it contains, what happened, the most likely root cause,"
         + " and how to fix it — grounded in the evidence on this page.") | @uri)),
    # Target of Close, "I applied it" and Discard, and what Run apply names, written with the user's own token.
    incidentGvr: { apiVersion: "observability.krateo.io/v1alpha1", resource: "incidents", name: $n, namespace: $ns },
    # A Resolved incident was proven fixed by its verify script; the portal offers Close only before that.
    canClose: ($exists and $state != "Closed" and $state != "Resolved"),
    canDiscard: $exists,
    canApply: $canApply,
    # Run apply: the same incidents as "I applied it", while no run of this incident is unfinished.
    canRunApply: $canRunApply,
    # Apply: status.howToFix.applyAction, normalized (verb as the HTTP method), for the button that sends it.
    canApplyAction: $canApplyAction,
    applyAction: (if $aaOk then { verb: $aaVerb, apiVersion: $aa.apiVersion, resource: $aa.resource, namespace: ($aa.namespace // ""), name: $aa.name, payload: (if $aaVerb == "DELETE" then null else $aa.payload end) } else null end),
    metaItems: ([ (if ($r | when) != "" then { label: "Started", value: ($r | when | stamp) } else empty end),
                  (if ($st.completedAt // "") != "" then { label: "Analyzed", value: ($st.completedAt | stamp) } else empty end),
                  (if ($st.resolution.at // "") != "" then { label: (if $st.resolution.by == "verify" then "Resolved" else "Closed" end), value: (($st.resolution.at | stamp) + (if $st.resolution.by == "verify" then " by the verify script" else " by a person" end)) } else empty end) ]),
    summary: {
      whatHappened: ($title + (if $comp then (" — affecting " + (($comp.gvr // "") | split("/") | last) + "/" + ($comp.name // "")) else "" end)),
      why: (if ($rc.statement // "") != "" then $rc.statement
            elif $err != "" then "Not determined: the analysis failed."
            else "Not determined yet: the analysis may still be running." end),
      howToFix: (if ($fix.apply // "") != "" then
                   ((($fix.apply | split("\n") | map(select(test("^\\s*#") and (test("^#!") | not))) | first) // null) as $c
                    | if $c != null then ($c | sub("^\\s*#+\\s*"; "")) else "Review the apply script below and run it." end)
                 elif $err != "" then "No fix: the analysis failed."
                 else "No fix proposed yet." end)
    },
    analyzedRows: ($analyzed | map(
        ((.gvr // "") | split("/")) as $parts
        | (if ($parts | length) >= 3 then ($parts[0] // "") else "core" end) as $grp
        | (if ($parts | length) >= 3 then ($parts[1] // "v1") else ($parts[0] // "v1") end) as $ver
        | ($parts[-1] // "") as $plural
        | (.name // "") as $nm
        | (.namespace // "") as $ans
        | (($nm != "") and ($plural != "")) as $ok
        | { gvr: (.gvr // ""), name: $nm, namespace: $ans, what: (.whatWasRead // ""),
            aNs: (if $ok then (if $ans != "" then $ans else "cluster" end) else "" end),
            aGrp: (if $ok then $grp else "" end),
            aVer: (if $ok then $ver else "" end),
            aPlural: (if $ok then $plural else "" end),
            aName: (if $ok then $nm else "" end) })),
    evidenceLeadIn: ("After evaluating " + (($analyzed | length) | tostring) + " resource" + (if ($analyzed | length) == 1 then "" else "s" end) + " across " + (($sources | length) | tostring) + " source" + (if ($sources | length) == 1 then "" else "s" end) + ", the agent found the following:"),
    # Each source row opens Autopilot with an ask whose verb matches the source type.
    sourcesRows: ($sources | map(
      (.ref // "") as $ref
      | ((.type // "object") | ascii_downcase) as $tl
      | (if ($tl | test("log")) then ("Retrieve the logs from " + (if $ref != "" then ("\"" + $ref + "\"") else "the source cited in this incident" end) + " and summarise what they show about this incident.")
         elif ($tl | test("event")) then ("Show the Kubernetes events for " + (if $ref != "" then ("\"" + $ref + "\"") else "the object cited in this incident" end) + " that are relevant to this incident.")
         elif ($tl | test("object|resource|manifest|spec|status|pod|deploy")) then ("Get the full details of " + (if $ref != "" then ("\"" + $ref + "\"") else "the object cited in this incident" end) + " and explain its current state in the context of this incident.")
         else ("Show me what the source " + (if $ref != "" then ("\"" + $ref + "\"") else "cited in this incident" end) + " contains and why it is relevant to this incident.") end) as $srcAsk
      | { type: ((.type // "object") | ascii_upcase), ref: $ref, excerpt: (.excerpt // ""),
          route: ("/incidents/" + $ns + "/" + $n + "?ask=" + ($srcAsk | @uri)) })),
    gapsText: (($gaps | join("  •  ")) + (if ($assump | length) > 0 then ((if ($gaps | length) > 0 then "   —   " else "" end) + "Assumed: " + ($assump | join("  •  "))) else "" end)),
    traceItems: ($trace | to_entries | map({
      eyebrow: ("step " + ((.value.step // (.key + 1)) | tostring)),
      title: (.value.statement // ""),
      description: (if ((.value.evidenceRefs // []) | length) > 0 then ("→ evidence " + ((.value.evidenceRefs // []) | map("#" + ((. + 1) | tostring)) | join(", "))) else "" end),
      status: "finish" })),
    traceCurrent: (if ($trace | length) > 0 then (($trace | length) - 1) else 0 end),
    rootCauseStatement: ($rc.statement // ""),
    fixSteps: $fixSteps,
    fixCurrent: $fixCurrent,
    fixStepsForWidget: ($fixSteps | map({ eyebrow, title, status, resourceRefId: ("incident-rem-step-" + (.i | tostring)) })),
    applyRunRows: $runRows,
    applyRunsMd: $runsMd,
    applyRunsLabel: ("Apply runs · " + ($runRows | length | tostring)),
    similar: $similar,
    # The incident and its alert as a v1 List, the shape `kubectl get -o json` prints. A JSON string, which is what the YamlViewer `json` field takes.
    involvedManifestsJson: (if ($involvedObjs | length) > 0 then ({ apiVersion: "v1", kind: "List", items: $involvedObjs } | tojson) else "" end),
    involvedManifestsDesc: (($involvedObjs | length | tostring)
      + (if ($involvedObjs | length) == 1 then " object" else " objects" end)
      + " — the incident" + (if $alert != null then " and the alert that opened it" else "" end)
      + ". managedFields stripped; status kept."),
    errorText: $err,
    # Shown only for an incident with no structured analysis: the report text, a provider error that stands in for one, or where the analysis is.
    proseMd: (
      ($rpt | test("Bad Request|token count|exceeds the maximum|no output|^ *[0-9][0-9][0-9] ")) as $dump
      | if ($exists | not) then "This incident does not exist, or you cannot read it."
        elif $structured then ""
        elif $dump then ("**Analysis could not complete.** The run ended in a provider error instead of a report. This is what the provider said:\n\n```\n"
            + ($rpt | if (. | length) > 1200 then (.[0:1200] + "\n… truncated") else . end) + "\n```")
        elif $rpt != "" then $rpt
        elif $err != "" then ""
        elif $state == "Analyzing" then "_Analysis in progress — the root cause will appear here when it completes._"
        else "The analysis produced no report and recorded no error." end),
    sections: {
      summary: $structured,
      evidence: ((($analyzed | length) > 0) or (($sources | length) > 0)),
      analyzed: (($analyzed | length) > 0),
      sources: (($sources | length) > 0),
      gaps: ((($gaps | length) > 0) or (($assump | length) > 0)),
      trace: (($trace | length) > 0),
      rootcause: (($rc.statement // "") != ""),
      fix: $hasFix,
      error: ($err != ""),
      applyRuns: (($runRows | length) > 0),
      similar: (($similar | length) > 0),
      manifests: (($involvedObjs | length) > 0),
      prose: (($exists | not) or (($structured | not) and (($rpt != "") or ($err == ""))))
    }
  }

restactions.name: incidents-list
restactions.filter:
def alertlabel: ((.metadata.labels // {})["observability.krateo.io/alert"] // .spec.alertRef.name // "");
(.status // "all" | tostring | ascii_downcase) as $sel
| ((.incidents.items) // []) as $items
| ((.alerts.items) // []) as $alerts
| ($alerts | map({ key: (.metadata.name // ""), value: (.spec.displayName // "") }) | from_entries) as $display
| ($items | map(
    (.status.state // "Analyzing") as $state
    | alertlabel as $alert
    | (($display[$alert] // "") | gsub("[^ -~]"; "") | sub("^ +"; "") | sub(" +$"; "")) as $dn
    | {
        name: (.metadata.name // ""),
        # A namespaced list omits .metadata.namespace per item; these incidents are in the namespace just listed.
        namespace: "default",
        title: (if $dn != "" then $dn elif $alert != "" then $alert elif (.status.rootCause.statement // "") != "" then .status.rootCause.statement else (.metadata.name // "") end),
        cause: (if (.status.rootCause.statement // "") != "" then .status.rootCause.statement
                elif (.status.error // "") != "" then "analysis failed"
                elif $state == "Analyzing" then "analyzing"
                else "—" end),
        state: $state,
        stateKey: ($state | ascii_downcase),
        age: (.metadata.creationTimestamp // .spec.triggeredAt // ""),

restactions.name: obs-alerts
restactions.filter:
{ rows: [ ((.alerts.items) // [])[] | {
    name: (.spec.displayName // .metadata.name // ""),
    # routeName/routeNs are the CR's OWN identity (metadata.name/namespace) — the row now
    # deep-links to /alerts/{namespace}/{name} (the new detail page), and that route keys the
    # per-name Alert GET, so it MUST be the slug, NOT the human displayName above. A
    # namespace-scoped list omits .metadata.namespace per item (redundant with the path) and
    # snowplow does not backfill it → fall back to the release namespace we just listed
    # (same reasoning as incidents-list's namespace literal).
    routeName: (.metadata.name // ""),
    routeNs: (.metadata.namespace // "default"),
    watching: ((.spec.where // "all logs") | gsub(" AND NOT "; "\nAND NOT ") | gsub(" AND "; "\nAND ") | if length > 200 then .[0:198] + "…" else . end),
    threshold: ((.spec.threshold // 0) | tostring),
    interval: (.spec.interval // ""),
    thresholdType: (.spec.thresholdType // ""),
    phase: (.status.phase // "Pending"),
    state: (.status.state // "PENDING"),
    paused: (((.metadata.annotations // {})["krateo.io/paused"] // "") == "true"),
    ask: ("Investigate the \"" + (.spec.displayName // .metadata.name // "this alert") + "\" observability alert — it is currently " + (.status.state // "PENDING") + "; explain what it watches, why it is in this state, and give me the concrete next steps.")
  } ],
  firing: ([ ((.alerts.items) // [])[] | select((.status.state // "") == "ALERT") ] | length),
  # Paused alerts (krateo.io/paused: "true") open no incidents, whatever their state.
  paused: ([ ((.alerts.items) // [])[] | select(((.metadata.annotations // {})["krateo.io/paused"] // "") == "true") ] | length),
  total: ([ ((.alerts.items) // [])[] ] | length),
  # Coverage: an alert with no hyperdxAlertId is not evaluated by anything. It sits in the list
  # looking exactly like a working one — same columns, same quiet OK-ish blank — so the only
  # place this can be seen is a count.
  synced: ([ ((.alerts.items) // [])[] | select(((.status.hyperdxAlertId) // "") != "") ] | length),
  # Outcome: an incident whose analysis failed (status.error, or a provider dump as its report)
  # or finished with neither a root cause nor a report produced nothing.
  incidentsTotal: ([ ((.incidents.items) // [])[] ] | length),
  incidentsBarren: ([ ((.incidents.items) // [])[]
      | select((.status.state // "Analyzing") != "Analyzing")
      | ((.status.report // "") | if type == "string" then . else "" end) as $t
      | select( ((.status.error // "") != "")
                or ($t | test("Bad Request|Too Many Requests|STREAM_ERROR|token count|exceeds the maximum"))
                or (($t == "") and ((.status.rootCause.statement // "") == "")) ) ] | length),
  incidentsReadable: ((.incidentsError // null) == null),
  # Always-visible "author with Autopilot" CTA for listy.alerts-hint (was empty-state-only, and
  # had no ask link — this replaces the separate "Ask Autopilot" button). askHref opens the rail
  # seeded with the alert-authoring flow; copy reworded off "your first".
  hint: [ { title: "Author an alert with Autopilot",
            detail: "Describe what to watch, the trigger value and the evaluation interval in the rail — the agent drafts the alert and you confirm before it's created.",
            askHref: ("/alerts?ask=" + (("I want to create a new observability alert. Help me define what to watch (the telemetry query), the threshold and comparison, and the evaluation interval, then create it once I confirm.") | @uri)) } ] }

stages.name: cd
stages.filter:
[ (.cd // {} | if type == "object" then . else null end)
  | select(. != null)
  | select((try (.status.apiVersion != null and .status.resource != null) catch false))
  | { version: ((.status.apiVersion | split("/")[1]) // ""),

restactions.filter:
# .installer is the single claim object (the dependent step returns it unwrapped).
(.installer // {} | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $i
| ($i.spec.components // []) as $c
| ($i.spec.componentValues // {} | if type == "object" then . else {} end) as $v
| { present: (($c | type) == "array" and ($c | length) > 0),
    rows: [ $c[]?
            # Bind the name BEFORE the object literal: inside `$v | has(...)` the `.` is $v,
            # so a bare `.name` there reads componentValues.name — a different object — and
            # errors outright on a null key. Caught against the live CR.
            | (.name // "") as $n
            | { name: $n,
                chart: (.chart // ""),
                version: (.version // ""),
                tier: (.tier // ""),
                feature: (.feature // ""),
                # Components carrying per-install value overrides are the riskier pins to
                # move: the new chart may not accept the old keys.
                tuned: (if ($v | has($n)) then "yes" else "" end) } ]
          | sort_by(.tier + "/" + .name) }

stages.name: object
stages.iterator:
def fetchableCore: ["configmaps", "serviceaccounts", "services", "endpoints", "persistentvolumeclaims", "persistentvolumes", "pods", "namespaces", "nodes", "events", "limitranges", "resourcequotas", "replicationcontrollers", "podtemplates"];
def fetchablePath: (tostring | (split("?") | .[0] // "") | split("/")) as $p
  | if ($p[1] // "") == "apis" then true
    elif ($p[1] // "") == "api" then
      ((if ($p[3] // "") == "namespaces" then ($p[5] // "") else ($p[3] // "") end)) as $res
      | ($res == "" or (fetchableCore | index($res)) != null)
    else false end;
(.group // "") as $g | (.version // "v1") as $v | (.plural // "") as $pl
| (.namespace // "") as $ns | (.name // "") as $nm
| (if ($g == "" or $g == "core") then ("/api/" + $v) else ("/apis/" + $g + "/" + $v) end) as $base
# NB jq `//` treats `false` as absent, so `.namespaced // true` would wrongly map a
# cluster-scoped resource (namespaced:false) to true. Use `!= false`: false→cluster,
# true→namespaced, null(unknown)→namespaced (the common default).
| (([ (.disco.resources // [])[] | select((.name // "") == $pl) ][0].namespaced) != false) as $nsd
| [ select($pl != "" and $nm != "" and ($ns != "" or ($nsd | not)))
    | { path: (if $nsd then ($base + "/namespaces/" + $ns + "/" + $pl + "/" + $nm) else ($base + "/" + $pl + "/" + $nm) end) }
    | select(.path | fetchablePath) ]

restactions.filter:
def fetchableCore: ["configmaps", "serviceaccounts", "services", "endpoints", "persistentvolumeclaims", "persistentvolumes", "pods", "namespaces", "nodes", "events", "limitranges", "resourcequotas", "replicationcontrollers", "podtemplates"]; def fetchablePath: (tostring | (split("?") | .[0] // "") | split("/")) as $p
  | if ($p[1] // "") == "apis" then true
    elif ($p[1] // "") == "api" then
      ((if ($p[3] // "") == "namespaces" then ($p[5] // "") else ($p[3] // "") end)) as $res
      | ($res == "" or (fetchableCore | index($res)) != null)
    else false end;
(.object // {}) as $o | (.group // "") as $g | (.plural // "") as $pl | ([ (.disco.resources // [])[] | select((.name // "") == $pl) ][0]) as $res | (($res.namespaced) != false) as $nsd | ($res.kind // $o.kind // $pl) as $kind | ($o.status.conditions // []) as $conds | {
    found: (($o.metadata.name // "") != ""),
    kindName: ($kind + " · " + ($o.metadata.name // (.name // ""))),
    eyebrow: ($o.apiVersion // (if $g == "" then (.version // "") else ($g + "/" + (.version // "")) end)),
    subtitle: (if (($o.metadata.name // "") != "") then
        ([ (if $nsd then ("namespace " + ($o.metadata.namespace // (.namespace // ""))) else "cluster-scoped" end),
           (if ($o.metadata.creationTimestamp // "") != "" then ("created " + ($o.metadata.creationTimestamp)) else empty end) ] | join(" · "))
      else
        (if (((if ($g == "" or $g == "core") then "/api/" else "/apis/" + $g + "/" end) + (.version // "v1") + "/" + $pl) | fetchablePath | not)
         then ("Not read: the portal does not read " + $pl)
         else ("Not found" + (if (.namespace // "") != "" then (" in namespace " + .namespace) else "" end)) end)
      end),
    conditions: [ $conds[] | { type: (.type // ""), status: (.status // ""), reason: (.reason // ""),
                               state: (if (.status // "") == "True" then "healthy" elif (.status // "") == "False" then "failed" else "pending" end) } ],
    # THE STUCK-CREATE ANNOTATION.
    #
    # krateo.io/external-create-pending is written by a provider before it calls the external
    # API and cleared when the call returns. If the process dies in between, it is never
    # cleared and the resource is wedged: the controller refuses to retry and reports
    #   "cannot determine creation result - remove the krateo.io/external-create-pending
    #    annotation if it is safe to proceed"
    # — an instruction addressed to a human with kubectl, printed on a page that offered no
    # way to act on it. Two publishes sat like this for 30 hours on krateo-057.
    #
    # EXCEPTION-ONLY: every field below is empty on a healthy object, so the page composes
    # nothing. The annotation being ABSENT is the normal case and says nothing.
    # NOT "the annotation is present" — that was the first cut and it was wrong. On krateo-057
      # ALL 17 LocalResources carry it and 8 are Synced=True/ReconcileSuccess: this provider
      # simply never clears it on the happy path. Firing on the annotation alone would have put
      # a scary warning and a DANGEROUS button on every healthy resource, where clearing it can
      # produce a duplicate external object. The annotation is necessary, not sufficient.
      #
      # The real signal is the annotation PLUS a condition that is actually False. A wedged
      # object reports one; a healthy one that merely still carries the marker does not.
      createPending: (
        ((($o.metadata.annotations // {})["krateo.io/external-create-pending"] // "") != "")
        and (([ $conds[] | select((.status // "") == "False") ] | length) > 0)),
    createPendingSince: (($o.metadata.annotations // {})["krateo.io/external-create-pending"] // ""),
    # The controller's own words, when it is saying this. Quoted rather than paraphrased so
    # the page never invents a diagnosis the cluster did not make.
    createPendingMessage: ([ $conds[] | select((.message // "") | test("external-create-pending")) | (.message // "") ] | first // ""),
    # Identity for the PATCH that clears it. A generic page cannot hardcode a GVR, so the
    # button resolves its target through resourcesRefsTemplate from exactly these four.
    patchApiVersion: ($o.apiVersion // (if $g == "" then (.version // "") else ($g + "/" + (.version // "")) end)),
    patchResource: $pl,
    patchName: ($o.metadata.name // (.name // "")),
    patchNamespace: (if $nsd then ($o.metadata.namespace // (.namespace // "")) else "" end),
    conditionsCount: ($conds | length),
    manifestJson: (if (($o.metadata.name // "") != "") then (($o | del(.metadata.managedFields, .metadata.annotations["kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration"])) | tojson) else "" end)
  }

restactions.name: sidebar-nav
restactions.filter:
[ ((.tier0.items // []) )
  | .[]
  | select(((.metadata.annotations // {})["krateo.io/nav-path"] // "") != "")
] as $roots | ( [ $roots[]
  | (.metadata.annotations // {}) as $a
  | (.metadata.name) as $root
  | (.metadata.name | sub("^page-"; "")) as $slug
  | (($a["krateo.io/nav-order"] // "100") | tonumber) as $ord
  | ( { path: $a["krateo.io/nav-path"], page: $slug, order: $ord, resourceRefId: $root }
      + (if $a["krateo.io/nav-label"] then { label: $a["krateo.io/nav-label"] } else {} end)
      + (if $a["krateo.io/nav-icon"]  then { icon:  $a["krateo.io/nav-icon"]  } else {} end)
      + (if $a["krateo.io/nav-group"] then { group: $a["krateo.io/nav-group"] } else {} end) ),
    ( ($a["krateo.io/nav-alias"] // "") | split(",")[] | select(length > 0)
      | { path: ., page: $slug, order: $ord, resourceRefId: $root } )
] ) as $entries | ( [ $entries[] | select(.label != null and .group != null) ]
    | group_by(.group) | map({ group: .[0].group, min: (map(.order) | min) })
    | sort_by(.min) | .[1:]
    | map({ type: "divider", order: (.min - 1) }) ) as $dividers
| { items: ( ($entries | map(del(.group)) | unique) + $dividers | sort_by(.order) ),
    refs:  ( [ $roots[] | { id: .metadata.name, name: .metadata.name, namespace: .metadata.namespace } ] | unique ) }

restactions.name: upgrade-impact

stages.name: impact
stages.payload:
${ (.compdef.spec.chart // {}) as $c
   | ({ url: ($c.url // "") } + (if ($c.repo // "") != "" then { repo: $c.repo } else {} end)) as $src
   | { base: ($src + { version: ($c.version // "") }),
       head: ($src + { version: ((.to // "") | if . == "" then ($c.version // "") else . end) }),
       values: {},
       releaseName: (.name // "preview"),
       namespace: (.namespace // "default") }
   | tojson }

restactions.filter:
(.compdef.spec.chart // {}) as $c
| ($c.version // "") as $from
| ((.to // "") | if . == "" then $from else . end) as $to
| (.impact // {}) as $d
| ((($d.error // "") | tostring) as $svc
   | if $svc != "" then $svc
     elif (.impactError != null) then (.impactError | tostring)
     else "" end) as $err
| ([ ($d.added // [])[]   | { kind: (.kind // ""), name: (.name // ""), namespace: (.namespace // ""), change: "added",    color: "green", detail: ("new object in " + $to) } ]
   + [ ($d.removed // [])[] | { kind: (.kind // ""), name: (.name // ""), namespace: (.namespace // ""), change: "removed",  color: "red",   detail: ("no longer rendered by " + $to) } ]
   + [ ($d.changed // [])[] | { kind: (.ref.kind // ""), name: (.ref.name // ""), namespace: (.ref.namespace // ""), change: "modified", color: "orange", detail: ((.summary // "") | sub("^changed top-level fields: "; "changed: ")) } ]) as $objRows
# Field-level create-form (values.schema.json) changes — synthetic "Field" rows so the
# SAME table/drawer shows WHICH form fields an Update adds / removes / newly-requires or
# changes the default of. helm-render-service >= 0.1.2 emits valuesSchemaDiff; an older
# service omits it → $sd is null → zero Field rows (back-compatible, boolean tail kept).
| ($d.valuesSchemaDiff // null) as $sd
| ([ ($sd.added // [])[]           | { kind: "Field", name: ., namespace: "", change: "added",    color: "green", detail: ("new create-form field in " + $to) } ]
   + [ ($sd.removed // [])[]        | { kind: "Field", name: ., namespace: "", change: "removed",  color: "red",   detail: ("no longer a create-form field in " + $to) } ]
   + [ ($sd.nowRequired // [])[]    | { kind: "Field", name: ., namespace: "", change: "modified", color: "orange",  detail: "now REQUIRED" } ]
   + [ ($sd.changedDefaults // [])[]| { kind: "Field", name: ., namespace: "", change: "modified", color: "orange",  detail: "default changed" } ]) as $schemaRows
| ($schemaRows | length) as $sfCount
| (if $sfCount > 0 then " · " + ($sfCount | tostring) + " form-field change" + (if $sfCount == 1 then "" else "s" end)
   elif ($d.valuesSchemaChanged // false) then " · values schema changed"
   else "" end) as $schemaTail
| (if $err != "" then [ { kind: "—", name: "render failed", namespace: "", change: "error", color: "red", detail: $err } ] else ($objRows + $schemaRows) end) as $rows
| { added: ([ $objRows[] | select(.change == "added") ] | length),
    removed: ([ $objRows[] | select(.change == "removed") ] | length),
    modified: ([ $objRows[] | select(.change == "modified") ] | length) } as $n
| ($n + { total: ($n.added + $n.removed + $n.modified) }) as $counts
| ($d.valuesSchemaChanged // false) as $schemaChanged
| {
    from: $from,
    to: $to,
    error: $err,
    rows: $rows,
    counts: $counts,
    summary: (if $err != "" then "Preview failed — the render service reported an error (see below); the update itself is unaffected."
              elif ($counts.total == 0 and $sfCount == 0) then "No manifest changes between " + $from + " and " + $to + " (chart defaults)." + (if $schemaChanged then " The values schema DID change." else "" end)
              elif $counts.total == 0 then "No object changes between " + $from + " and " + $to + $schemaTail + " (see below)."
              else (($counts.added | tostring) + " added · " + ($counts.removed | tostring) + " removed · " + ($counts.modified | tostring) + " modified"
                    + $schemaTail) end),
    note: ("Diff of CHART DEFAULTS: both versions rendered with the chart's default values as release \"" + (.name // "") + "\" — the values of real composition instances are not applied, so their objects may differ."),
    valuesSchemaChanged: $schemaChanged,
    valuesSchemaDiff: $sd
  }
